Composite benchmark scores correlate with real-world forecasting leaderboards on matched model panels, more closely than with a general-capability index, supporting its use as a proxy for real-world forecasting capability. Strong association forecasts do not consistently extend to belief inference or intervention prediction, and effect magnitudes remain poorly calibrated despite informative direction predictions. Process verification reveals errors missed by final-answer evaluation, and structured reasoning improves intervention prediction for the strongest model in the process study. Agent-play experiments identify useful assisted plans and motivate evaluating decision-relevant capabilities beyond association forecasting. These findings identify hidden-state inference, intermediate-state prediction, and effect calibration as priorities for world-model training.

</details>


### [265] [The interpreter as developer: An autoethnographic design study of building a computer-assisted interpreting tool through human-LLM co-creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16460)
*Zeming Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究人员报告了一项自动民族志设计研究，说明了一名专业口译员通过专家指导的'氛围编码'，与LLM架构师和编码代理共同创建了一个专注于本地的计算机辅助口译系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在提高计算机辅助口译工具的可用性并促进口译员的技术素养，特别是在实时AI字幕方面。

Method: 通过一项民族志设计研究，参与者是一个没有编程经验的专业口译员，与LLM架构师和编码代理合作，共同开发了一个计算机辅助口译系统。

Result: 研究结果表明，在一场公共科学活动中，通过'氛围编码'的机制，实现了一个本地化的口译系统，能够在971句话中实现中位翻译延迟0.94秒。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了利用生成AI可以促进用户导向的创新，并为未来口译员的培训和技术素养提出了潜在的改进方向。

Abstract: Real-time AI captioning now serves audiences at multilingual events, yet computer-assisted interpreting (CAI) tools are still built for interpreters, rarely by them. This article reports an autoethnographic design study in which a professional interpreter with no programming training built a local-first CAI system through expert-led 'vibe coding', co-creating with an LLM architect and a coding agent. Analysis of the complete development dialogues shows how tacit professional knowledge, from segmentation to booth infrastructure, was externalized into design after generic defaults failed in use. In a demanding public scientific event, three mechanisms of in-booth appropriation emerge under a firmly human-led division of labor; telemetry from a first fully instrumented assignment shows a fully local chain sustaining a median translation latency of 0.94 s across 971 utterances. The case is read as lead-user innovation newly enabled by generative AI, with implications for the technological literacy of interpreters and the future of interpreter training.

</details>


### [266] [PATMT2: Two-stage domain adaptation for multilingual patent translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16466)
*Xiaowei Su,Xusen Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PatMT2 v2 提出了一种两阶段 LoRA 管道，该管道将 Hy-MT2-7B 专用于四语言（中文/英文/日文/韩文）专利翻译，并在六种翻译方向上显著提升了 BLEU 分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进现有专利机器翻译模型的性能，以提高翻译质量并在多种语言对中实现更高的翻译准确度。

Method: 使用两阶段 LoRA 管道对 Hy-MT2-7B 模型进行适应和优化。

Result: 在六种翻译方向上，PatMT2 v2 的 Stage-2 分支达到了 43.39 到 43.57 的平均 BLEU 分值，超过了 Hy-MT2-7B 基础模型和Qwen3-32B、几个外部系统在相同平均值上的表现。

Conclusion: 通过测试不同语言的表现，研究确认了翻译性能的显著提高，并识别了低资源语言翻译中的失败模式，这些模式被用作诊断案例以进一步研究翻译机制。

Abstract: We present PatMT2 (Patent Machine Translation, v2), a two-stage LoRA pipeline that adapts the Hy-MT2-7B dedicated translation model to four-language (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) patent translation. On six translation directions, the Stage-2 checkpoint reaches a macro-average BLEU of 43.39 (BF16) to 43.57 (AWQ INT4), improving over the Hy-MT2-7B base by up to +8.8 BLEU and also exceeding Qwen3-32B and several external systems on the same average. We then measure the cost of adaptation: probing 38 languages absent from the fine-tuning data, the model still produces correct, fluent output on 34, while four low-resource languages collapse into distinct, reproducible failure modes. We treat these as diagnostic cases rather than retention rates, and report their mechanisms without attributing them to a single cause. Paired bootstrap tests confirm the translation gains over all baselines (p < 0.001).

</details>


### [267] [Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16474)
*Johann Pignat,Christophe Gaudet-Blavignac,Julien Ehrsam,Jean-Philippe Goldman,Cyrille Duret,Phil Cheng,Mina Bjelogrlic,Michel Cuendet,Christian Lovis,Olivier Michielin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从临床叙述中提取可查询知识图谱的方法，该方法基于扩展的SNOMED CT语法，并定义了五类关系，使用UNIGRAPHE工具构建知识图谱，解决了临床记录中信息难以大规模检索的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床肿瘤病历记录了大量的自由文本信息，但这些信息难以大规模检索和利用。现有的编码方法只记录文档提及的内容，忽视了信息之间的关系，本文开发了一种方法，可以从临床叙述中构建可查询的知识图谱。

Method: 本文提出的方法基于扩展的SNOMED CT语法，定义了五类关系，并通过UNIGRAPHE工具自动将标注的文本转换为知识图谱。

Result: 在专家标注的临床肿瘤文档中，UNIGRAPHE重建了5,299个标注成的知识表达式，共2,196个，证明了关系结构是使临床叙述能进行正式查询的关键。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够有效地从临床叙述中提取知识，并将其转化为可查询的形式，为临床数据的大规模检索和利用提供了新的途径。

Abstract: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.

</details>


### [268] [Communication, Vocalisation, and Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16490)
*Peter Wallis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文质疑当前的大语言模型是否真正理解语言，认为它们实际上是通过社会实践来应用符号的，并且这种应用与所谓的分布式表示不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者挑战现有的大语言模型（LLMs）的理解能力，强调LLMs的运作机制可能更接近于社会学中描述的社会实践，而非通过表征符号形成理解。

Method: 作者通过阐述对现有大语言模型的理解视角，与社会学中的实践进行了比较。这主要是通过对比的方式来论述的观点。

Result: 论文提出了一种新的视角来解释大语言模型的行为，认为它们更多地依赖于社会实践，而非传统的符号表征。

Conclusion: 作者认为大语言模型不能被理解和应用为具有真正的符号理解能力，而是将符号应用于社会实践中。

Abstract: The contention is that the current batch of Large Language Models don't *understand* language, but they *do* it. Rather than LLMs forming some kind of ``distributed representation'' of symbols, the claim is that LLMs are capturing ``Cultural Intelligence'' and grounding symbols in what the sociologists call practices.

</details>


### [269] [Intent-Triggered Anchoring for Multi-Token Format Units in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16516)
*Junhyeok Lee,Kyu Sung Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为意图触发锚定的新解码规则，它在无需训练的情况下，在三组不同肺部X光检查报告的基础上，使得可解析报告的比例从63.3-67.3%提高到了100%，同时未降低延时，并提高了数学答案标注的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于扩散语言模型在并行解码时不能让共同解码的多个标记相互可见，导致解析器无法解析的格式单元比例较高。因此，研究提出了一种新的解码规则，以提高报告的可解析性和数学答案标注的准确性。

Method: 研究者提出了一种名为意图触发锚定的解码规则，该规则在模型首次提交标记时就完成格式单元的填充，仅提交具有唯一且无内容填充的单元，否则在模型停止或循环时回写该单元。研究者在肺部X光检查报告和数学答案标注任务上测试了该规则的效果。

Result: 通过该解码规则，在肺部X光检查报告和数学答案标注任务中分别取得了显著效果，其中肺部X光检查报告的可解析报告比例从63.3-67.3%提高到了100%，并且提高了数学答案标注的准确性。

Conclusion: 研究得出结论，该解码规则在提高报告可解析性方面具有显著效果，同时不会影响性能，并且在数学答案标注任务中也有显著增益。

Abstract: In parallel decoding, diffusion language models commit several tokens per forward pass, so co-committed tokens cannot see each other, breaking multi-token format units that parsers need. On ECHO, an open-weight one-step chest X-ray (CXR) report generator, 32.7-36.7% of evaluation reports lack a parseable Impression heading and score as empty. We propose intent-triggered anchoring, a training-free decoding rule that completes a format unit once the model commits its first token, inserting only units with a unique, content-free completion; fallbacks write the unit when the model stops or loops without starting it. On three CXR evaluation sets, the rule raises readable rates from 63.3-67.3% to 100.0% with no regressions and a 95th-percentile latency ratio of 0.68-1.28 against official decoding. Broken headings state findings absent from the reference; adding the heading at the end leaves them in 15.5-31.0% of reports, our rule in at most 0.6%. For math answer markers, the rule raises accuracy in the most parallel setting of five diffusion language models by 5.8-20.8 points on GSM8K and 5.1-17.1 on GSM-Symbolic, held out from tuning. With lenient answer extraction, gains are 3.3-12.5 and 2.7-6.3 points; the rule adds 1.4-8.6 points over a stop-only fallback for four of the five models.

</details>


### [270] [Support or Magnitude? Characterizing Neuron Relevance for Instruction Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16531)
*Yifan Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过构建样本级的相关性配置文件和引入两种互补标准（有效相关支持ERS和正相关度量PRM），揭示了如何表征神经元相关性对于指令数据选择的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型内部信号如神经元激活和梯度被用于指令数据筛选，但神经元相关性应该如何表征仍然未被充分探索。

Method: 研究通过AttnLRP引导的归因方法构建样本级相关性配置文件，引入了有效相关支持ERS和正相关度量PRM作为标准。

Result: 研究发现，ERS和PRM虽然基于相同的底层相关性配置文件，但会产生不同的样本排名和选择偏好。在不同语言模型和下游基准上的实验表明，ERS整体平均性能更优。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调了神经元相关性分布和表征方式对指令数据选择的重要性，而不仅仅是其大小。

Abstract: Model-internal signals, such as neuron activations and gradients, have been used for instruction data selection, yet how neuron relevance should be characterized remains underexplored. In particular, should selection prioritize the magnitude of relevance or how broadly it is distributed across neurons? To investigate this question, we construct sample-level relevance profiles using AttnLRP-guided attribution and introduce two complementary criteria: Effective Relevance Support (ERS), which measures the effective support of positive relevance, and Positive Relevance Magnitude (PRM), which captures its average strength. Our analyses reveal that these characterizations produce distinct sample rankings and selection preferences despite sharing the same underlying relevance profiles. On Qwen2 models, PRM exhibits stronger associations with activation-based selection, whereas ERS produces substantially different rankings. These differences extend to task composition, within-task sample preferences, and semantic selection patterns, with varying degrees of agreement across backbones. Experiments across three language models and five downstream benchmarks demonstrate the practical value of relevance-guided selection, with ERS achieving the best overall average performance rank among the evaluated methods. Our findings highlight that how neuron relevance is distributed and characterized, rather than its magnitude alone, matters for instruction data selection.

</details>


### [271] [Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16533)
*Zhipeng Chen,Wayne Xin Zhao,Ji-Rong Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了强化学习具有验证性奖励（RLVR）对大型语言模型（LLMs）梯度结构的影响，并提出了一种新的优化原则——自适应有效谱优化（Ares），以适应梯度谱结构的变化，从而提高了准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在探索RLVR是否需要不同于传统方法的新优化器，以应对梯度能量集中形成一个收缩的有效子空间的现象。

Method: 通过研究LLMs梯度的谱结构，发现梯度能量逐渐集中到一个收缩的有效子空间，这在监督微调（SFT）和使用随机验证奖励的情况下不存在。此外，追踪固定分数下梯度能量所需的最大秩不断减少，揭示了有用的梯度维度随训练而演化。根据这些发现，提出了自适应有效谱优化（Ares），估算梯度谱能量分布的有效更新秩，并限制梯度信号到相应的低秩子空间。

Result: Ares在不同规模的LLMs上提高了准确率，并在不同的RLVR算法和任务中具有泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，有效的优化可能需要根据训练过程的几何和动态设计优化器。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is reshaping how large language models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities, yet the optimizers used remain largely inherited from teacher-forcing training. This raises a fundamental question: does RLVR induce a distinct optimization geometry that calls for a different optimizer? We investigate this question through the spectral structure of LLM gradients and find that gradient energy progressively concentrates into a shrinking effective subspace, which is characteristic of RLVR, as it is absent under supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and is largely removed when the verifiable reward is replaced by a random one. Moreover, the rank required to capture a fixed fraction of gradient energy steadily decreases over training, revealing that the effective dimensionality of useful updates itself evolves with training. These findings motivate a new optimization principle: rather than prescribing the update rank externally, an optimizer should adapt its rank to the evolving spectral structure of the gradient. We introduce Ares (Adaptive Rank-Effective Spectral Optimization), which estimates the effective update rank from the gradient's spectral energy distribution, tracks its evolution, and confines the gradient signal driving each update to the resulting low-rank subspace. Across LLMs of different scales, Ares improves accuracy over widely used optimizers and generalizes across RLVR algorithms and tasks. Results suggest that effective optimization may require optimizers to be designed around the geometry and dynamics of the training process. We release the code and data at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares.

</details>


### [272] [PatTransBench: an ipc-stratified, multi-dimensional benchmark for patent machine translation evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16538)
*Xiaowei Su,Xusen Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PatTransBench 提供了一个包含 12,000 项中英/日/韩专利机器翻译数据集，附带多维度评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了改进和评估专利机器翻译的质量和性能。

Method: 通过依据 IPC 细节层抽样和双重质量筛选从上游专利家族平行语料库构建了 6,000 个短文本和 6,000 个长文本的翻译对，并通过多维度评估协议进行评估。

Result: 展示了量化方向依赖性效应和非单调的语言失败模式，这些在单一指标评估中不可见。

Conclusion: 计划公开该基准、评估协议和案例研究，以支持可再现的专利机器翻译评估。

Abstract: We present PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation (PatMT) benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol. The benchmark comprises 6,000 short-text (sentence/claim) and 6,000 long-text (paragraph) pairs, evenly split across three language pairs and both translation directions, built via IPC-section-stratified sampling and dualthreshold quality gating from upstream patent-family parallel corpora. The evaluation protocol spans literal n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE-L, chrF), cross-lingual semantic textual similarity (CLSTS), 38-probe-language consistency testing, and serving performance under concurrency. A case study on PatMT2-7B and its fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit variants reveals direction-dependent quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns across quantization schemes that are invisible to single-metric evaluation. We plan to release the benchmark, protocol, and case-study results upon publication to support reproducible PatMT evaluation.

</details>


### [273] [Know Yourself and Know Your Neighbour: A Syntactically Informed Self-Supervised Compositional Sentence Representation Learning Framework using a Recursive Hypernetwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16547)
*Vasudevan Nedumpozhimana,John Kelleher*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一个使用递归超网络的新自我监督框架来学习句子表示，通过分析7个探针任务的性能，验证了生成的句子表示符含有比平均基线和现有最佳替代方案更多的语言信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的句子表示学习仍然是自然语言处理中的一个开放问题，现有的方法往往不能充分捕捉语言的复杂性。为此，作者提出了一个新的自我监督框架，以提供更丰富的句子表示。

Method: 作者提出了一个使用递归超网络的建模方法，该方法通过将句子表示从单词表示复合来构建，并通过语法树进行递归组成。模型中维护了语法和语义表示的分离，且语义组成由语法表示的信息引导。此外，作者提出了六种新的自我监督任务来进行模型训练。

Result: 实验结果表明，提出的模型生成的句子表示比平均基线和现有最佳替代方案编码了更丰富的语言信息。且通过消除研究评估了六种自我监督训练任务的影响。此模型生成的表示对于不同长度的句子是稳定的，且语义组合操作符能够适应不同的语法类别。

Conclusion: 作者的工作提出了一个新的自我监督框架，通过实验验证了该模型能够生成更丰富的句子表示。同时，作者也展示了该模型在句子表示的稳定性和适应性方面的优势。

Abstract: Sentence representation learning is still an open challenge in Natural Language Processing. In this work, we propose a new self-supervised framework for learning sentence representations, using a special type of neural network called a recursive hypernetwork. Our proposed model composes the representation of a sentence from representations of words by applying a recursive composition through the parse tree. We maintain a separate syntactic and semantic representation, and the semantic composition is guided by the information from the syntactic representation. To train this model, we introduce a novel set of six self-supervised tasks. By analysing the performance on 7 probing tasks, we validate that the generated sentence representation encodes richer linguistic information than both averaging baselines and state-of-the-art alternatives. Furthermore, we assess the impact of the six proposed self-supervised training tasks through ablation studies. We also demonstrate that the representations generated by our model are stable for sentences of varying length and that the semantic composition operators adapt to different syntactic categories\footnote{Code available: https://github.com/vasudev2020/codi/tree/main}.

</details>


### [274] [MixLID: Token-Level Language Identification in Mixed-Language Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16601)
*Seongtae Hong,Youngjoon Jang,Seungyoon Lee,Jungseob Lee,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MixLID 是一个支持 111 种语言-书写系统组合的分词级语言识别模型，通过两阶段训练过程显著提升了多语言文本处理的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着全球化趋势增强，多语言文本处理的需求日益增加，现有模型往往在处理混合语言数据时表现不佳，因此需要开发一种能够有效识别多语言文本中每个词的语言的新方法。

Method: MixLID 采用两阶段训练：首先通过单语言数据集学习区分单语言样本中的各个语言，然后利用现有代码混合数据和基于英语源词与借词间对应关系生成的扩充样本进行混合语言数据集训练。

Result: 实验表明，MixLID 在四种基准测试中的单语言识别上优于所有基线模型，在每种评估的语言对上都比基线模型更准确地识别混合语言文本中的单词语言。

Conclusion: MixLID 在单语言和混合语言环境中都表现出色，能够广泛应用于多语言文本分析任务中，且已公开提供。

Abstract: Processing multilingual text requires both identifying a broad range of languages and distinguishing the language of each token in inputs containing multiple languages. We introduce MixLID, a token-level language identification model supporting 111 language-script combinations. MixLID follows a two-stage training process: it first learns to distinguish individual languages using the language labels of monolingual examples, then continues training on mixed-language data. The second stage uses concatenated examples from existing code-switching data alongside augmented examples created through word substitution based on correspondences between English source words and loanwords. For monolingual identification, MixLID outperforms all baselines in both accuracy and macro F1 on four benchmarks within the language coverage shared with each baseline. For mixed-language identification, it outperforms the baselines in identifying the language of individual tokens on every evaluated language pair. MixLID achieves high performance across a broad range of languages in both monolingual and mixed-language settings. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/nlpai-lab/MixLID.

</details>


### [275] [SuPER-Mamba: Surprisal Prioritization for Extended-Context Routing in Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16636)
*Zhetong Zhang,Gayan K Kulatilleke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SuPER-Mamba 提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过使用 Surprisal 作为模型内信号进行长距离状态路由，显著提升了状态空间模型在长序列上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态空间模型在处理长序列时性能会随着上下文长度增加而下降，因此需要一种增强长距离上下文表达能力的方法。

Method: SuPER-Mamba 使用 Surprisal 值进行位置归一化，并通过局部聚合来计算全局信道更新的优先级，无需依赖查询评分或额外训练。

Result: 在 LongBench-E 测试基准上，SuPER-Mamba 提升了模型的平均得分，相比基础模型提升了 94.7%，相比之前最佳baseline提升了 13.1%。

Conclusion: SuPER-Mamba 提供了一种有效的方法，能够显著改善基于 Mamba 模型的状态空间模型在处理长序列时的表现。

Abstract: State space models provide efficient linear-complexity processing for long sequences, but their performance frequently degrades as context length grows. We propose SuPER-Mamba, a training-free framework that uses Surprisal as a model-intrinsic signal for long-range state routing in pretrained Mamba models. SuPER-Mamba computes position-wise Surprisal from next-token predictions, aggregates neighboring responses through Local Pooling, and uses the resulting scores to prioritize Global-Channel updates without query-dependent scoring or additional training. We evaluate SuPER-Mamba on three state-space models across the LongBench-E benchmark. The results show that SuPER-Mamba improves the average score from 8.06 to 15.69, corresponding to a 94.7% relative gain over the Base Models and a 13.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art prior baseline. Ablation and length-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed routing framework.

</details>


### [276] [SIREN: Situation-aware Index for Response and Emergency ActioNability in Crisis Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16646)
*Maria Carmen Staiano,Lifeng Han,Johanna Monti,Francesca Chiusaroli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 引入了SIREN框架来评估机器翻译在危机通信中的行动性，并在两种设置下分别对不同系统进行了评估，发现不同系统的翻译错误类型和对行动性的影响不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的机器翻译评估方法未能直接检测翻译是否保留了应急消息的行动性，因此引入了一个新的框架SIREN来评估这一点。

Method: 使用SIREN框架评估不同翻译系统的错误类型和对行动性的影响，并提供了一个危机翻译资源供进一步研究。

Result: 在两种不同设置下的评估中，不同翻译系统在保留行动性方面的失败类型和影响效果不同，SIREN能够捕捉到这些差异。

Conclusion: 不同翻译系统在如何保留行动性方面存在差异，这些差异不仅体现在行动性损失的频率上，也在损失的根本性质上有所区别。

Abstract: Machine translation (MT) is increasingly utilized in multilingual crisis communication, yet conventional evaluation does not directly assess whether translated emergency messages preserve their actionability. We introduce SIREN (Situation-aware Index for Response and Emergency ActioNability), a human evaluation framework assessing whether translation choices compromise protective action, directive force, and urgency of the source text. We evaluate SIREN in two complementary settings. At the error level, we apply it to HOPE-annotated Italian--English translations produced by ChatGPT-4o and Google Translate: 31.63\% and 48.73\% of errors, respectively, compromise actionability, predominantly by affecting the protective action. At the message level, we evaluate English--French translations produced by TranslateGemma-4B and Google Translate, with actionability preserved in 85.34\% and 92.67\% of translations, respectively. TranslateGemma-4B failures predominantly weaken directive force, whereas Google Translate failures more often compromise protective actions and receive Major impact ratings. These findings show that translation systems can differ not only in how often actionability is lost, but also in the nature and functional impact of these failures. Alongside SIREN, we contribute an English--French crisis-translation resource with human actionability annotations and post-edited reference translations, supporting further research on function-oriented evaluation for crisis communication. Our experimental data is available at https://github.com/mcstaiano/SIREN.

</details>


### [277] [EHR-Bench: A Chinese Multi-Task Benchmark for Recruitment AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16689)
*Ruijia Yang,Bing Xu,Zulong Chen,Zhipeng Xu,Jia Xu,Yipeng Yu,Ying Zhou,Zeyi Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一套名为EHR-Bench的中文招聘基准，包含十二个任务和六个能力家族，覆盖招聘过程中多种业务需求。该基准构建在内部招聘数据集的基础上，涉及8,336个任务实例，用于评估十二种大型语言模型。评估结果显示，不同模型在不同任务上有所侧重，且性能受输入来源、参考证据、候选人池等因素影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于招聘应用程序涉及广泛的操作，此基准的构造旨在全面覆盖这些操作，以系统性地评估大型语言模型在招聘场景中的表现。

Method: 基于内部招聘数据集定义任务，构建包含8,336个任务实例的基准，采用系统性评估方法，包括任务级、能力级和综合比较，确保模型评估的全面性和准确性。

Result: 评估结果显示，不同大型语言模型在任务表现上存在差异，且性能水平受到输入源、参考证据和候选人池等因素的影响。

Conclusion: EHR-Bench为系统性模型评估提供了可重复的基础，支持特定任务的选择，以及对招聘用大型语言模型的进一步研究。

Abstract: Recruitment applications span diverse operations, from drafting job descriptions and interpreting queries to organizing profiles, assessing fit, and recommending candidates and jobs. Systematic LLM evaluation therefore requires task coverage that reflects this range of business needs. We introduce EHR-Bench, an open Chinese benchmark comprising twelve tasks across six capability families and five recruitment scenarios. The tasks cover generation, extraction, classification, retrieval, semantic similarity, and reciprocal ranking within one evaluation framework. An internal recruitment dataset guides task definitions, the occupation taxonomy and sampling targets, output requirements, and scoring protocols. Following these specifications, we construct 8,336 task instances from public materials and controlled augmentation, with source-aware expert review and documented provenance. We evaluate twelve LLMs through task-level, capability-level, and aggregate comparisons. Closely ranked models exhibit distinct task strengths, and performance varies across input sources, reference evidence, and candidate pools. Five shared models retain the same observed Overall ordering on a private operational reference, with variation in capability and task correspondence. EHR-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for systematic model assessment, task-specific model selection, and further research on LLMs for recruitment. The project repository is available at https://github.com/EhrBench/EHR-Bench.

</details>


### [278] [Audit Before You Distill: A Controlled Workflow for Reasoning Transfer into Compact Medical Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16713)
*Tiago Martinelli,João Paulo Papa,Adriano José Pereira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估了教师理由在帮助较小模型回答医疗专业问题时的作用，并通过 Brazilian Portuguese 领域的问题进行了验证。研究发现，教师正确的理由能提高正确答案的选择概率，而错误的理由则降低这一概率。据此，提出了 Distill-SFT 方法，在保持较低训练实例数量的同时，提高了复杂推理能力。此外，研究还发现，仅基于答案的训练会导致较大的推理准确性下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进较小模型在医疗专业问题上的性能，提高其准确性和可靠性。

Method: 研究首先测量了教师理由对回答正确率的影响，然后基于此结果设计了一个 Distill-SFT 方法，并验证了其在不同训练情况下的效果。

Result: 教师正确的理由可显著提高正确答案的选择概率，而错误的理由则会降低这一概率。Distill-SFT 方法在处理以前未能解答的推理问题时表现良好，且使用较少的训练实例。此外，仅基于答案的训练方式会导致较大的推理准确性下降。

Conclusion: 提出了一个遵循理审计查、验证教师答案及高效训练小型模型的工作流程，提高了医疗专业问题回答的准确性。

Abstract: Teacher rationales can help a smaller model answer health professions questions, but they can also reinforce errors. We examined when they help and how this evidence can guide training using Brazilian Portuguese questions from medical and multiprofessional residency examinations. First, we measured how a teacher rationale changed the student's probability of selecting the correct answer and compared this effect with rationales drawn from other questions. The complete rationale increased this probability by 21~p.p. when the teacher was correct and decreased it by 14~p.p. when the teacher was wrong. By intervening on the reasoning content, we showed that shuffled rationales did not produce the same pattern. Guided by this result, we trained only with rationales attached to correct teacher answers and compared answer-only training, step-by-step distillation, and our proposed Distill-SFT method. Distill-SFT showed a modest advantage over step-by-step distillation on previously missed questions under reasoning, while using fewer training instances by combining the answer and rationale into a single target. We also investigated catastrophic forgetting using the out-of-domain ENEM dataset. Answer-only training reduced reasoning accuracy by 12~p.p. relative to baseline, compared with approximately 4~p.p. for either rationale-based training method. Together, these findings support a workflow that audits rationale content before distillation, verifies teacher answers before supervision, and trains compact models efficiently for health professions question answering.

</details>


### [279] [What Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16717)
*Yuchen Li,Zongqi Fan,Xintong Li,Ken-tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种关于大型语言模型‘自我的’全新观点，认为模型的自我是一个以其为中心的信息组织，能够区分模型记录的行为和外部提供的材料，显示了分层的来源绑定组件，而不是在整个网络中不变的向量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在探索大型语言模型‘自我’的概念，因为它们不是特定词汇或单一特权层。作者希望通过一种新的关系视角，理解模型的自我是以行为为中心的信息组织，不依赖于单一的向量表示。

Method: 模型基于27B BF16的初步观察，分析了150个匹配的邮件主体、450种角色条件以及75/75发现保留分离的数据。通过计算源定位和角色特定的信息使用来分析模型的行为。

Result: 研究发现，早期组件将用户和系统更为接近，而非助手。这一层面上的位置关系在深度内部不保持一致。因此，认为可以将早期来源编码与更深层次的角色特定信息使用和继续准备相结合，没有必要要求保持一致替换。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，功能自我可能存在于变化的表示之间的持久关系中，这联系到了动态推理、历史连续性和内容操作、来源绑定、权威和输出的计算模型分离。

Abstract: What could the "self" of a large language model be, if it is neither a particular word nor a single privileged layer? We propose a relational account: a functional self is an actor-centered organization of information that distinguishes the model's recorded actions from externally supplied material while content and reasoning operations change. Its representational candidate is a family of layer-specific source-binding components, rather than one unchanged vector throughout the network. Preliminary observations from a 27B BF16 model provide a geometric starting point. Across 150 matched message bodies, 450 role conditions, and a 75/75 discovery-held-out split, the combined Assistant-versus-external displacement transfers strongly across bodies and positions. Selected early components place User and System closer to one another than to Assistant, whereas this full-space distance relation does not persist throughout depth. These findings motivate a layered account: an early source-encoding candidate can be combined with role-specific information use and continuation preparation at later depths, without requiring monotonic overwriting of the common displacement. We connect this account to dynamic reasoning, historical continuity, and a computational model separating content operations, source binding, authority, and output. The reported evidence establishes a reproducible role-conditioned geometry; the proposed interpretation is that functional selfhood may reside in persistent relations among changing representations.

</details>


### [280] [Lost in Contrast: Instruction-Preserving Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16722)
*Haonan Zhang,Ting Jin,Wenzhong Tang,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究引入了一种称为instruction-preserving（IP）的方法，通过将指令效应和视觉对比项分开计算来保留弃权指令的影响，同时允许调整对比强度。这种方法在多种模型上均提高了决策效用（DU），即正确答案和支持弃权的数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉对比解码方法仅能纠正答案，但会误导支持弃权，研究指出弃权信息可能在对比解码的两个阶段丢失，因此为了同时支持正确答案和弃权，提出了一种新的解码方法。

Method: 通过将弃权指令在原始图像预测中的效果保持不变，同时允许对比强度自由调整，研究团队提出了两种改进的方法：IP-VCD 和 IP-M3ID。

Result: 在决策效用（DU）评估中，这两种方法均优于所有非IP对照组的模型，特别是在VizWiz和Food-101数据集上表现更为突出。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，保留弃权指令的效果可以更全面地评估模型性能，促进模型在实际应用场景中的表现提升。

Abstract: Visual contrastive decoding corrects answers using the prediction difference between the original image and a reference condition, yet the same contrast also turns supported abstentions into incorrect answers. We find that abstentions are lost at two stages: contrastive decoding with candidate filtering can exclude the abstention token before any comparison takes place, and the reference branch's response to the abstention instruction is removed when the reference prediction is subtracted. We therefore propose instruction-preserving decoding, which keeps the effect of the abstention instruction on the original-image prediction intact while leaving the contrast strength freely adjustable. Using a perturbed image and an image-free prediction as references, we obtain IP-VCD and IP-M3ID. On decision utility (DU), which credits both correct answers and supported abstentions, both methods outperform all compared non-IP baselines on every one of nine models on VizWiz, and IP-VCD also leads on eight of nine models on Food-101. Candidate measurements and paired per-question comparisons show that computing the instruction effect and the visual contrast term separately lets contrastive decoding support both correct answers and supported abstentions.

</details>


### [281] [The Multilingual Artificial Hivemind: Do All LLMs Think Alike in Every Language?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16755)
*Xaver Raphael Davey,Shubhra Mishra,Anton Adelöw,Siyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，多语言LLM生成的文本在不同语言中有不同程度的同质化现象，这种同质化与其在特定语言上的表现力存在关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于大规模语言模型（LLMs）生成的文本在多样性和人类生成的文本相比有所限制，本研究旨在探索多语言LLM生成文本的同质性问题，特别是在不同语言中的表现。

Method: 研究者通过分析23种开放权重模型和13种语言生成的文本，检验了语言对输出多样性的潜在影响。研究使用词汇度量标准，在三种不同的嵌入空间中进行分析。

Result: 研究发现，同质化现象在不同的语言模型和语言中普遍存在，但程度不一。同质化的大小与模型在特定语言上的表现力存在稳健的关联。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，多语言LLM在不同语言上的表现与同质化程度之间存在权衡关系。

Abstract: Text generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) often remains limited in diversity compared to that produced by humans. Recent advances demonstrate the presence of inter- and intra-model collapse in open-ended generation of English text, raising concerns about the long-term homogenization of LLM, and more importantly, human thought. However, our understanding of whether this homogenization extends to languages beyond English is limited. In this work, we investigate the role of language on output diversity. Specifically, we aim to understand whether multilingual LLM-generated text is also homogeneous, and whether this homogeneity matches what we observe in humans. Across 23 open-weight models and 13 languages, we find that the artificial hivemind effect is pervasive but uneven in its extent. The intra-model effect holds in three different embedding spaces and under a lexical metric that uses no embedding model, so it is not an artifact of how diversity is measured. The size of the homogenization gap is associated with a model's competence in a language, measured on a held-out translation benchmark, robustly across embedding spaces. Thus, we demonstrate a performance-diversity tradeoff in multilingual LLMs.

</details>


### [282] [A Bethe-Ansatz Source of Early Token Correlations: A marginal-preserving construction for parallel proposals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16781)
*Abraham Chachamovits*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了在语言模型解码中需要一个联合分布而非仅仅精确单个词的概率分布，通过构造一系列坐标-比泰尔-安萨兹律并计算各律之间的概率差异来验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了改进语言模型的解码过程，提出了一种新的联合分布方法，以实现在多词序列上的更有效解码。

Method: 作者通过从周期XXZ链中构造坐标-比泰尔-安萨兹律，比较其最大熵双元投影，并在特定条件下研究不同律之间的概率差异，特别是在八位、三激发态的情况下。通过非线性读取技术，将该概率差异转换到前两个词的位置，并保持其单独概率。

Result: 研究发现，当$Δ=(3+	ext{根号}3)/2$时，比泰尔-安萨兹分布与最大熵双元投影相同。在$Δ=1.5$时，二元词的确定性分布差异为0.02654573。通过精确推导，可以验证一个构造的目标在与其共享前一词概率区之间具有严格接受前缀的优势。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个数学存在的证明，但没有提供语言模型性能提升的实际证据或计算加速的确认。

Abstract: Parallel token proposals in language-model decoding need a joint law, not merely accurate token marginals. We construct a family of coordinate-Bethe-ansatz laws from the periodic XXZ chain and compare each with its maximum-entropy pairwise projection at identical one- and two-site moments. In the eight-site, three-excitation sector, symmetry makes their entire probability-law difference one-dimensional, determined by a contiguous three-site moment. Along the Bethe branch, this gap varies with anisotropy, changes sign, and vanishes exactly at $Δ=(3+\sqrt{3})/2$, where the eigenstate law becomes exactly pairwise. A nonlinear readout transfers a nonzero gap into the first two token positions while preserving their separate marginals. At $Δ=1.5$ the deterministic binary token laws differ by 0.02654573 in total variation. Exact speculative verification then gives a strict accepted-prefix advantage for a constructed target and a neighborhood within targets sharing its first-token marginal. This is a mathematical existence result. It does not establish a language-model gain or wall-clock speedup.

</details>


### [283] [A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16837)
*Pengcheng Wang,Zhexuan Zhang,Chao Lou,Kewei Tu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究了12种控制配置的句法语言模型（SLMs），涵盖不同树线性化和注意力掩码。实验结果表明，标准因果注意力机制的SLMs在下游和句法基准上能匹配或超越结构掩码版本，并且未发现需要架构修改。同时，规模扩展到10亿参数时，表现最好的SLM版本不再比计算量匹配的非结构化基线有明显优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要集中在小规模模型上，且树线性化和注意力掩码的设计空间尚未充分探索。为此，本研究进行了一项大规模实证研究，旨在探索SLMs在不同参数规模下的性能，并分析其随规模变化的表现。

Method: 研究通过对比一组不同配置的SLMs（包括一种终端基线和十一种SLMs变体），评估它们在各类下游任务和句法基准上的表现。这些模型涵盖了不同的树线性化和注意力掩码配置，并且在训练参数和数据量方面有所区别。

Result: 实验结果表明，标准因果注意力机制的SLMs在大多数情况下可以匹配或超越使用结构掩码的版本，无需进行任何架构修改，并且可以与FlashAttention兼容。然而，当模型扩展到10亿参数规模时，表现最佳的SLM变体不再显示出比计算量相匹配的非结构化基线有明显优势。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，标准因果注意力机制的SLMs在性能上具有竞争力，但随着模型的规模增加，其优势可能逐渐减弱。未来研究可以通过进一步探索和优化树线性化和注意力掩码的设计来增强SLMs的竞争力。

Abstract: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. They require no architectural modifications and remain compatible with FlashAttention. We also observe that when scaling up to the 1B-parameter scale, the top-performing SLM variant no longer shows a clear advantage over a compute-matched non-structural baseline, suggesting that SLMs may become less competitive with scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation.

</details>


### [284] [Label Collapse in Diffusion Language Model In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16839)
*Ziye Guo,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究揭示了上下文学习中标签折叠是一种普遍存在且难以仅凭准确性检测的问题，特别是在大规模语言模型中。作者通过分离度测量的方法揭示了隐藏在表面准确率下的标签折叠现象，并探讨了标签偏置、生成模型架构和安排模式等对标签折叠的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究关注指示顺序对上下文学习（ICL）任务的影响，但是对标签排列模式与模型偏见之间的相互作用缺乏系统性探讨。此篇论文旨在填补这一空白，并揭示标签折叠问题对ICL应用的影响。

Method: 作者定义了标签折叠作为生成查询独立标签的失败模式，并通过比较自回归模型（如Llama-3, Qwen3.5）与离散扩散模型（如LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct）在不同标签分布下的表现来探讨其普遍性。同时，作者提出了分离度测量作为表面准确率下的标签折叠诊断指标，并开发了抗标记器和格式问题的标签提取测量协议。

Result: 六种不同架构的模型（两种自回归、四种离散扩散）在分类平衡排列情况下均表现出标签折叠现象。分离度测量揭示了这些模型中的无偏安排依然存在标签折叠。自回归模型在多数类别偏置描述不适用的情况下依然存在标签折叠，而排列模式可以改变折叠的方向。对于离散扩散模型，作者进行系统性评估，补充了同时期关于dLLM语境理解与指示顺序敏感性研究。

Conclusion: 作者强调，仅靠准确性无法检测标签折叠，模型可能在无标签折叠的情况下仍保持低准确率，从而可能在部署中持续未被察觉。分离度测量为检测标签折叠提供了一种有效的补充方法，特别是在大规模语言模型中。该研究丰富了对ICL机制及其潜在应用挑战的理解。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) applies large language models to new tasks by prepending a few labeled demonstrations to a query. Prior work has studied how demonstration ordering affects ICL, but the interaction between label arrangement patterns and model biases has not been systematically examined. We define label collapse as the failure mode in which the model generates query-independent labels, and show that it is architecturally universal at the tested 8-9B scale: five models spanning autoregressive (Llama-3, Qwen3.5) and discrete diffusion (LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct) families all exhibit label collapse even under the class-balanced alternating arrangement, with some label word pairs collapsing in virtually every tested condition and others flipping their collapse direction with arrangement. Critically, accuracy alone cannot detect this collapse: models can achieve near-chance accuracy while generating query-independent labels, a score indistinguishable from balanced performance, so the failure can persist undetected in deployment. We measure separation, the log-odds of the two label words at the query position (the quantity that label-bias calibration operates on), as a complementary diagnostic that exposes collapse hidden beneath surface accuracy, together with a measurement protocol that guards label extraction against tokenizer and formatting artifacts. For autoregressive models, collapse persists where the majority-label-bias account does not apply, and arrangement patterns can reverse the collapse direction; for diffusion models, we present a systematic evaluation of ICL failure modes, complementing contemporaneous studies of dLLM context comprehension and demonstration-order sensitivity, and identify open questions about how iterative denoising interacts with label biases.

</details>


### [285] [ANCHOR: Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16859)
*Wenqiang Zhu,Xinping Lei,Zhiyi Lai,Zhengshuo Gong,Tianzhuang He,Songwei Yu,Weihao Li,Jingxuan Xu,Zihang Xu,Gang Wu,Zhongqiu Wang,Yuhui Bai,Jie Li,Zhao Liu,Junhao Fan,Yan Wu,Yanan Wu,Jiaheng Liu,Ariel Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ANCHOR是一个基准测试工具，用于评估代码生成代理在多语言仓库任务中的工程约束遵循能力。它涵盖了10个类别和78个叶类型的真实开发者交互，采用自动化流程生成任务相关的原子约束，并通过基于规则和LLM的框架检查代码变更和执行轨迹。结果显示，最强的系统仅达到70.1%的原子约束符合性和63.7%的关系符合性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的评估方法未能充分考虑开发人员遵循工程约束的需求，这需要一种新的基准测试工具来填补这一空白。

Method: ANCHOR通过以下步骤工作：(i)提取10个类别和78个叶类型的层次分类体系；(ii)通过自动化流程实例化任务相关的原子约束并组合成类型化的AND/THEN/PRIORITY关系；(iii)采用基于轨迹的评估框架验证代码差异和执行轨迹，并使用规则和LLM进行判断。

Result: 在19种代理配置、2种支架和10种基础模型下的358个任务中，最强的系统Claude Opus 4.8在Cline下的原子合规性为70.1%，关系合规性为63.7%，并且有19.0%的任务在所有评分检查表项下通过。约束的五工程师审计报告可行率为94%，仓库一致性为94%，现实性为96%。任务完成率在添加约束后平均增加了0.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过比较功能成功与约束遵守情况，研究者发现许多失败集中于工作流排序、工具使用纪律和报告方面，模型与支架之间存在显著交互。

Abstract: For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on naturalistic, multilingual repository tasks spanning eight language groups. ANCHOR combines (i) a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 categories and 78 leaf types distilled from real developer interactions, (ii) an automated pipeline that instantiates task-grounded atomic constraints and composes them into typed AND/THEN/PRIORITY relations, and (iii) a trajectory-grounded evaluation framework that checks both the code diff and the execution trajectory with rule-based and LLM judges. Across 19 agent configurations spanning 2 scaffolds and 10 foundation models on 358 tasks, the strongest measured system, Claude Opus 4.8 under Cline, reaches 70.1% atomic compliance and 63.7% relation compliance, while 19.0% of tasks pass every scored checklist item under the strict all-item FCCR criterion. A five-engineer audit of constraints from 50 instances reports 94% feasibility, 94% repository consistency, and 96% realism. In the primary paired set (14 configurations), the mean signed change in task completion after adding constraints is +0.7 percentage points; individual changes vary in both directions. These results distinguish functional success from constraint compliance, with failures concentrated in workflow ordering, tool-use discipline, and reporting, and substantial interactions between models and scaffolds.

</details>


### [286] [SpecGuardBench: Can Coding Agents Construct Reliable Validation Harnesses from Natural Language Specifications?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16870)
*Zhiqing Zhong,Mingyu Chen,Aoyang Fang,Yuzhong Zhang,Haoye Tian,Lionel Briand,Boxi Yu,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文章提出了SpecGuardBench，它是一个基准测试集合，包含来自13个真实软件仓库的291个任务，检查软件代理是否能够根据自然语言规范构建验证套件。结果显示，即使在功能全面的代理中，通过该基准测试的代理也未能达到63%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的基准测试未能有效评估软件代理是否能够构建反映规范的验证套件和全面的测试案例。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了SpecGuardBench。

Method: 构建涉及8种验证逻辑的任务，并提供自然语言规范、仓库上下文和参考实现，评估软件代理生成验证套件的能力。

Result: 四款编码代理（两款私有、两款开放）在SpecGuardBench上的表现不佳，未达到63%的准确性。主要瓶颈在于构造反映规范的检查，而非测试案例的探索。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，软件代理在构建反映规范的验证检查方面存在困难。未来的工作可以探索改进代理构建验证检查的方法。

Abstract: As coding agents become more capable, tests remain the primary evidence for judging whether their code is correct. Yet passing available tests does not establish that an implementation satisfies its natural language specification. Reliable validation requires checks that faithfully capture the specification and scenarios that thoroughly exercise the code, but current benchmarks provide limited insight into whether agents can construct such evidence themselves. We introduce SpecGuardBench, a benchmark of 291 tasks from 13 real-world repositories, covering 8 types of verification logic such as functional postconditions and interaction protocols. Given a natural language specification, repository context, and a reference implementation, an agent constructs a validation harness comprising executable checks and test scenarios. The checks should reject implementations that violate the specification while accepting those that satisfy it, and the scenarios should thoroughly exercise the code. Across four proprietary and open-weight coding agents, none constructs a harness scored as faithful on the benchmark's implementations for more than 63% of the tasks. The bottleneck lies less in exploring test scenarios than in constructing checks that faithfully reflect the specification. Specifically, the agents show a clear tendency to write checks that mirror the reference implementation rather than the specification, and therefore reject implementations that the specification permits.

</details>


### [287] [Estimating Uncertainty of Omnimodal Large Language Models via External Omnimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16933)
*Iacopo Ghinassi,Hy Nguyen Gia La,Luke Ong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个模型通用的不确定性量化框架，无需访问模型内部，也无需额外的模型推理。此框架能够利用外部多模态嵌入对Chain-of-Thought响应进行评分，测量推理与多模态输入之间的联系，并评估内部一致性。实验结果显示，几何分数与答案分散基线互补，但几乎重叠，其可靠性依赖于生成器和模态。该方法在UNO-Bench基准测试中，与自我一致性相比，对于封闭生成器提供系统改进，对于开放生成器则结果混合，但在开放式、多模态问题上与其他最先进的方法相比表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（OLLMs）虽然能够处理多种模态及其组合，但不确定量化（UQ）仍然是一个开放性问题。现有的方法大多仅针对最多两种模态，并且依赖于直接访问模型内部结构或重新调用模型本身。本文旨在提供一种通用方法来解决这一问题，避免了对模型内部结构的依赖，仅通过外部多模态嵌入对模型推理进行评估。

Method: 本文的方法是基于外部嵌入信号生成的不确定性量化框架，主要流程如下：1. 使用多模态嵌入处理Chain-of-Thought响应，2. 评估推理的内部一致性，3. 利用预定义的算法组合不同信号以提高鲁棒性和信息量。该框架强调信号之间的互补与冗余性，并且不需要额外的模型推理或访问模型的内部参数。

Result: 实验结果表明，文章提出的框架在UNO-Bench基准上取得了良好的性能。与自我一致性评估相比，对于封闭的生成器提供了系统性的改进，而对于开放的生成器，改进结果则不够明显。此外，在开放式的多模态问题上，该方法的表现甚至比传统的内部状态基线更为优秀。信号的可靠性取决于生成器和模态类型。该方法特别适用于开放式、多模态的场景，因为这些场景更容易受到传统方法的挑战。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种新型的模型通用不确定性量化框架，主要特点是无需访问模型内部结构，依赖于多模态嵌入信号，从而评估模型推理的可靠性和一致性。该方法能够有效提高多模态环境下模型推理的信任度，特别是在开放式、多模态的场景中表现优秀，为未来多模态大语言模型的研究提供了新的可能性。

Abstract: Recent work has investigated Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs), models which can take multiple modalities and their combinations as input, as a way forward to have systems really capable of interacting with their environment. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for OLLMs, however, remains an open problem: existing methods largely target at most two modalities at a time, require access to model internals, or re-invocation of the evaluated model. We propose a model-agnostic UQ framework that scores a Chain-of-Thought response entirely through external omni-modal embeddings, measuring the grounding of the reasoning in the multimodal input and its internal coherence. Our contribution is the family of signals and an empirical characterisation of when it is reliable, rather than any single estimator: we find the geometric scores to be largely redundant with one another (mean within-split rank correlation 0.91-0.94) but strongly complementary to answer-dispersion baselines, and their reliability to depend on the generator and the modality. The resulting confidence estimates require no access to logits, hidden states or gradients of the evaluated model and no additional inference from it; they do require segmenting the reasoning trace with an auxiliary model and, for the aggregated score, a labelled calibration set that we show can be as small as 25 examples (although we also show that such a set buys little over fixing one signal a priori). On UNO-Bench, with both a closed and an open model, our scores yield small gains over self-consistency (systematic with the closed generator, mixed with the open one) and are competitive with self-verbalisation and internal-state baselines, especially in open-ended, omni-modal questions where previous state-of-the-art baselines struggle.

</details>


### [288] [Lexical Redefinition Reveals Context-Sensitive Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16952)
*Roksana Goworek,Haim Dubossarsky*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过词汇再定义的方法，探索语言模型在处理提示中冲突的上下文证据时的行为。结果显示，词汇再定义不是固定规则的应用，而是根据指令和后续句子之间的关系，上下文使用可以保持、削弱或完全反转指令。这表明，隐含指令的解释仍然对后续的上下文证据敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在探讨语言模型如何融合冲突的上下文信息，特别是通过词汇再定义的方法来理解语言模型的信息整合机制。

Method: 研究使用了词汇再定义技术，即通过明确指令指定某词语的含义，并在后续句子中通过其使用来提供进一步的上下文证据。研究人员对870对词汇进行分析，观察不同情况下词汇再定义行为的变化。

Result: 研究发现，词汇再定义不是固定的应用，而是在指令和后续句子关系的影响下，上下文的使用可以保留、削弱或完全反转指令。这意味着语言模型对显性指令的解释仍然高度依赖于其周围的上下文。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，语言模型在处理提示中的信息时，能够根据周围的上下文动态调整对指令的理解和应用。这种方法提供了一个研究语言模型如何整合多个信息来源的有效范式。

Abstract: How do language models reconcile conflicting contextual evidence within a prompt? We study this question using lexical redefinition, where an explicit instruction specifies how a word should be interpreted and a subsequent sentence provides additional evidence through its usage. Across 870 word pairs, we find that lexical redefinitions are not applied as fixed rules. Instead, the behaviour depends systematically on the relationship between the explicit instruction and the intervening sentence: the contextualised usage can preserve, weaken, or completely reverse the instruction. These results suggest that the interpretation of an explicit instruction remains sensitive to subsequent contextual evidence. Lexical redefinition therefore provides a controlled behavioural paradigm for studying how language models integrate multiple sources of information within a prompt.

</details>


### [289] [SarcasTraps: Effect of Sarcasm on Turkish Hate Speech Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16957)
*Niyazi Ahmet Metin,Dilara Keküllüoğlu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过SarcasTraps数据集评估了 sarcasm 对土耳其仇恨言论检测的影响，发现细调模型在处理 sarcastic hate speech 时失去了召回率，而零样本模型虽然保持了较高的召回率但精确度大幅度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的仇恨言论检测数据集通常侧重于明确的负面表述，而SarcasTraps集旨在研究通过隐晦表达的方式（如讽刺）传递的仇恨言论，以弥补现有数据集的不足。

Method: 研究团队构建了SarcasTraps数据集，并使用BERTurk和XLM-RoBERTa对现有土耳其仇恨言论数据集进行模型训练，后续在SarcasTraps上进行评估，同时也零样本评估了GPT-4.1和Llama-3.3-70B。

Result: 研究结果显示，sarcasm 确实影响了仇恨言论的检测。模型在处理带讽刺的仇恨言论时召回率下降，零样本模型的精确度大幅降低。

Conclusion: 尽管不同模型在处理含讽刺的仇恨言论时表现出不同效果，但结论指出两者在包含讽刺的情况下均表现欠佳，SarcasTraps数据集提供了针对此挑战的定量证据。

Abstract: Standard hate speech detection datasets often emphasize explicit harmful language, but directed harm can also be expressed indirectly, without clearly hateful wording. Sarcasm is one such form of indirect expression, as it can convey harmful intent through mock praise, exaggeration, humor, or apparent politeness. In this paper, we introduce SarcasTraps, a targeted external test set for analyzing the effect of sarcasm on Turkish hate speech detection. SarcasTraps contains 479 entries annotated along two dimensions: hate speech and sarcasm. We train classifiers using BERTurk and XLM-RoBERTa on two existing Turkish hate speech datasets and evaluate them on SarcasTraps, using it strictly as an external test set. We also evaluate GPT-4.1 and Llama-3.3-70B in a zero-shot setting on SarcasTraps. Results show that sarcasm substantially affects hate speech detection. Fine-tuned encoder models lose recall on sarcastic hate, while zero-shot LLMs maintain higher recall but suffer substantial precision drops on sarcastic examples. These findings show that both fine-tuned hate speech detectors and zero-shot LLMs struggle when sarcasm is involved, and SarcasTraps provides quantitative evidence of this challenge through a targeted Turkish test set. Due to the presence of sensitive and hateful language, SarcasTraps will be shared upon request for academic research purposes. Warning: This paper has examples from the dataset which contains offensive and hateful content towards groups of people.

</details>


### [290] [Event Memory and Narrative Dynamics: A Large Language Model Framework for Multidimensional State Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16971)
*Joshua Sariñana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究引入了一种基于大规模语言模型的方法，从叙述中构建事件表示，并通过提取特征来表征和动态建模事件结构。这在五个参与者的故事访谈中得以验证，展示了事件表示与潜在叙事过渡之间的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究希望深入探讨事件记忆的组织方式，通过分析自传性叙述提供证据，并在大型语言模型框架下构建事件表示，揭示其结构和动力学特征。

Method: 研究使用了大规模语言模型构建事件表示，并通过提取与海马回处理事件记忆模型一致的特征，来表征和动态建模事件的结构与动态。

Result: 研究成功构建了256个事件状态，并通过多重对应分析将这些状态嵌入到基于特征的空间中。统计结果表明，连续的事件状态显著更加接近随机叙事顺序中的预期距离。在选定的4-D模型中，盆地状态特征轮廓相似度与单一路径轮廓相似度对应，这表明情节、机制和主题能区分系统路径的参与情况。

Conclusion: 研究证明了基于特征的事件表示与观察到的叙事转换以及模型中的多步组织之间的联系，并提供了一种分析自然回忆期间事件划分和预测性组织来源关联的方法。

Abstract: Studying event memory requires defining events and their relationships within remembered experience. Autobiographical narratives provide evidence of this organization, but their analytical units must first be established. This study introduces a large language model framework for constructing event representations from narratives and modeling their structure and dynamics with excerpt-level traceability. Explicit boundary rules and a feature schema informed by hippocampal models of episodic memory and navigation guide event construction. In a proof-of-concept application to interviews from five participants, the framework constructed 256 event-states. Multiple correspondence analysis embedded these states in feature-based spaces, with analyses focused on a selected 4-D geometry and 10-D and 13-D reference geometries. Consecutive event-states were significantly closer than expected under randomized narrative order. In the selected 4-D ten-basin solution, similarity between basin-state feature profiles corresponded with similarity between one-step routing profiles; context, mechanism, and theme differentiated full-system pathway engagement. A successor representation modeled expected basin-state occupancy across successive steps. Correlations between basin-centroid distances and complete successor-profile distances were positive across all five basin solutions, with exploratory tests supporting correspondence in at least two solutions across all three geometries. These findings connect feature-based event representations with observed narrative transitions and modeled multistep organization. The framework translates hippocampal principles into source-linked event boundaries and state representations, providing an analytical basis for testing neural accounts of event segmentation and predictive organization during naturalistic recall.

</details>


### [291] [Predicting Mental Health Help-Seeking Behaviour on Reddit: A Survival Analysis of Linguistic and Behavioural Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16983)
*Nisar Ahmed,Ammara Kazmi,Irtaza Bashir Raja,Didier Devaurs*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究将心理卫生求助视为时间事件问题，通过构建对照组和临床组来预测哪些Reddit用户将寻求心理卫生支持及时间紧迫程度。行为特征优于文本特征用于预测个体是否会寻求帮助，而文本特征在预测时间方面更为稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数先前的工作将心理健康求助视为已经在临床社区中活跃的用户的后事分类，而文章的研究聚焦于预测尚未接近临界值的用户，以识别出在早期阶段就可以预测的心理卫生求助者。

Method: 该研究采用对照组和临床组的两臂设计，通过用户在没有转诊行为之前撰写的帖子内容来衡量特征。行为特征和文本特征分别在Cox比例风险模型、随机生存森林和LSTM序列模型中进行评估。

Result: 行为特征在预测个体是否会寻求帮助方面表现最佳（C指数0.797），而包括行为和文本特征的组合则表现最佳（交叉验证C指数0.823，保留数据C指数0.856）。预测时间方面，文本特征表现稳定（C指数0.698），而行为特征变得不那么稳定。

Conclusion: 研究表明，行为模式在时间之前预测未来心理健康求助方面提供了额外的信息。这种方法有助于分离出“谁”会求助和“何时”会求助，提供了一种更清晰的分析方式。

Abstract: Most prior work on predicting mental health help-seeking treats it as post-hoc classification of users already active in clinical communities, which cannot tell whether someone approaching a transition can be identified in advance. We instead frame help-seeking as a time-to-event problem and ask which Reddit users will eventually seek mental health support, and how imminent that transition is. We build a two-arm cohort: a control frame of 6,337 ordinary users with genuine right-censoring (12.1% transition rate) to answer who will transition, and a clinical frame of 5,023 eventual transitioners to answer how soon. Features come only from posts written before any clinical activity, and user-grouped five-fold cross-validation plus a four-year temporal holdout guard against leakage. We compare TF-IDF, MentalBERT embeddings and behavioural activity features using Cox proportional hazards models, Random Survival Forests and an LSTM sequential model. Behavioural features alone outperform text for predicting who will seek help (C-index 0.797 vs. 0.763), and combining both is best (0.823 under cross-validation, 0.856 on the holdout). The pattern reverses for predicting how soon a known transition will happen: text remains a stable predictor (C-index 0.698) while behavioural features become unstable. Structural engagement patterns therefore carry information about future help-seeking beyond linguistic content, and separating who from when yields a cleaner analysis.

</details>


### [292] [MENTOR: Procedural Shielding of Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17039)
*Ashwani Anand,Ivi Chatzi,Ritam Raha,Anne-Kathrin Schmuck*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MENTOR是一种新方法，通过构建基于历史依赖的运行时防护机制来增强LLM代理的程序合规性，确保其在执行任务时能够做出符合程序要求的决策，并且这种合规是上下文感知的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技术难以确保LLM代理遵守复杂的程序手册，可能导致代理行为过于保守或无法了解如何正确推进任务。为此，提出了一种名为MENTOR的方法，通过为代理提供过程中的指导并确保这种合规性是上下文感知的，来解决这些问题。

Method: MENTOR方法采用了多步自形式化流水线从程序手册中构建一个新的历史依赖的运行时防护层。其核心是使用基于游戏的技术确保代理在运行时的鲁棒性，同时不过度限制代理的行为。

Result: MENTOR实现了对轻量级开源LLM模型的保护，使得这些模型的合规性超过了未保护的专有模型。此外，由于防护层在一种手册上合成后可以用于多次任务，因此保护的代理更适合重复执行的流程，可能降低部署成本。

Conclusion: MENTOR为LLM代理的程序合规提供了一个正式协助框架，旨在通过上下文感知的保护机制降低部署成本，提高整体合规率。

Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents are increasingly used to automate workflows governed by procedural manuals, such as company rules for booking travel or procuring hardware. These manuals are written in natural language for humans and describe general requirements over such complex workflows. Ensuring compliance of LLM agents with these manuals is difficult, and state-of-the-art techniques use either LLM judges or manually written rules to forbid problematic tool-calls locally at runtime. This is insufficient because (i) only blocking tool calls keeps the agent clueless about how to make correct progress towards fulfilling its task, and (ii) can lead to overly conservative behavior of the agent, as tool calls might only be problematic in certain contexts. To overcome these challenges, we introduce MENTOR, which (i) additionally provides guidance for the agent to make procedural-compliant progress on the task, and (ii) ensures that this compliance is context-aware. We achieve these goals by building a novel history-dependent runtime shield that is obtained from the procedural manual via a multi-step autoformalization pipeline. At its core, MENTOR utilizes a game-based technique to ensure robustness against runtime uncertainty without over-resticting agents' behavior. This yields a formally assisted framework for procedural shielding of LLM agents that improves compliance well beyond existing methods. In particular, MENTOR lifts the compliance of shielded light-weight open-source LLMs above that of non-shielded proprietary models. Since a shield is synthesized once per manual and then serves every task, a MENTOR-shielded agent becomes a viable choice for repeatedly executed workflows, potentially reducing deployment costs when the offline construction cost is amortized over repeated tasks.

</details>


### [293] [Beyond Model Bias: Cross-Entropy Based Rankings in Literary and Academic Texts Remain Stable across Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17040)
*Ankit Bhattacharjee,Indrasabarna Hari,Krityapriya Bhaumik,Arka Das,Piyush Sarangi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过四个不同小规模的变压器模型，发现基于交叉熵相关度量（如均值和方差）的排名在两种文本环境（现代诗歌和学术研究论文）中具有稳定性，证明了文本的不可预测程度相对独立于所使用的语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨不同规模的语言模型在预测文本可预测性时排名的稳定性，以及这种稳定性是否与文本复杂度或特定模型有关。

Method: 使用四个小规模的变压器模型在两种文本环境下进行试验，计算每个数据点的交叉熵的均值和方差，并与六个无参数的压缩基准进行对比。

Result: 研究发现，不同模型之间的均值和方差具有高度的跨模型排名相关性（ρ>0.90），且这种一致性高于模型基准间的比较。

Conclusion: 虽然在学术环境中存在特定模型的敏感性，但总体而言，模型计算出的文本不可预测性的相对程度独立于所使用的模型。

Abstract: While language models provide powerful mechanisms for evaluating textual predictability, it remains unclear whether the relative extents of LM surprisal remain stable across models. This study presents empirical evidence of the invariance of ranking based on cross-entropy related measures (e.g. mean, variance of each data-point), across four distinct small scale transformer-based models, for a given dataset of text sources. We consider two stylistic environments: a corpus of contemporary poetry and a corpus of academic research papers. We demonstrate that mean and variance of cross-entropy maintain robust cross-model rank correlation ($ρ> 0.90$) across both regimes. To test whether this agreement merely reflects generic differences in textual complexity, we compare it against six parameter-free compression baselines. The extent of agreement among language models is found to be substantially higher than that among model-baselines, for most of the measures. Geometric analysis of the structurally constrained academic regime reveals that higher-order moments are sensitive to specific models, although strong agreement persists. The findings suggest that relative extents of textual unpredictability may be independent of the language model they are computed against.

</details>


### [294] [AD4EDU: Benchmarking University Lecture Audio Description across Accessibility Standards, Metrics, and Learner Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17042)
*Psychias Stylianos,Gao Yingqiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对高等教育环境的音频描述标杆AD4Edu-Bench和一个诊断性评价指标AD4Edu-Eval，以弥补既有的生产指南、评估标准和基准数据集主要针对娱乐内容的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的音频描述生产指南、评估指标和基准数据集主要针对娱乐内容，不适合于基于幻灯片的高等教育讲座，因此需要新的解决方案。

Method: 本文结合了现有的可访问性指导，包括WCAG 2.2, DCMP描述键和NCAM的STEM描述实践，并通过盲人及视力受损人士的反馈优化模型。

Result: 本文提出了一个称为AD4Edu的新基准和一个称为AD4Edu-Eval的新评价指标，这些指标可以用来生成和评估适用于高等教育的音频描述。

Conclusion: 我们的研究结果表明，虽然这个评价指标可以可靠地检测标准的违反，但符合标准的音频描述并不一定能满足盲人及视力受损人士的主观偏好，特别是在描述长度方面，这强调了BLV人士在设计包容性AI解决方案中积极参与的重要性。

Abstract: Audio description (AD) aims to enhance the accessibility of visual media for blind and low-vision (BLV) persons. However, in higher education, where slide-based lectures are a default mode of teaching, lecture AD remains largely underexplored. The main reason is that existing production guidelines, evaluation metrics, and benchmark datasets are oriented toward entertainment content and do not transfer to lectures, where ADs must complement the lecturer's speech, resolve deictic references, and fit within narrow pauses. In this work, we propose AD4Edu, consisting of an AD benchmark, AD4Edu-Bench, and a rule-diagnosable evaluation metric, AD4Edu-Eval, for generating and evaluating ADs in higher education. Specifically, we consolidated established accessibility guidance, including WCAG 2.2, the DCMP Description Key, and NCAM's STEM description practices. We further collected silver reference ADs, judge-ordered preference pairs, and pairwise preferences from four BLV raters, and post-trained models with direct preference optimization (DPO) for detailed analysis. Our findings indicate that while the metric reliably detects violations of the standard, ADs that comply with it do not necessarily fulfill the subjective preferences of BLV persons, most notably on description length, underscoring the necessity of active participation of BLV persons in co-designing inclusive AI solutions.

</details>


### [295] [UZHCL_for_the_win at Touche: Encoder Fine-Tuning, Synthetic Augmentation, and an Underpowered Encoder-LLM Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17077)
*Psychias Stylianos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了在Touche 2026挑战赛中对Reddit衍生语料库进行的三项子任务实验结果。采用自定义微调的RoBERTa-large模型，并结合少量LLM生成的合成对比样本，以及增强赛道的置信度过滤伪标签样本。研究发现，在特定语料库规模下，RoBERTa-large优于其他模型，但在增强赛道上，提升主要来自于标注材料的改进而非模型性能的显著增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用Reddit作为研究环境，检测在线讨论中的逻辑谬误，旨在增强线上讨论的质量。

Method: 使用了基于RoBERTa-large的微调模型，并结合少量LLM生成的合成对比样本，以及增强赛道中置信度过滤的伪标签样本。同时在DeBERTa-v3、ModernBERT及Qwen变体等多基础框架上进行了对比实验。

Result: 在官方Touche 2026测试集上，采用的模型在所有测试轨道中均取得了良好的表现，特别是增强赛道上的分类任务。

Conclusion: 研究指出ST3中单一模型难以识别罕见类逻辑谬误的问题，并建议未来的跟进研究重点应当放在这一问题上。

Abstract: Online discussions on platforms like Reddit are a productive testbed for fallacy detection: short texts, broad topical range, and the full inventory of informal fallacies. The Touche 2026 lab at CLEF formalises this as a shared task on a Reddit-derived corpus that combines fallacy detection with argument-scheme classification. This paper describes our participation in all three subtasks (ST1 binary fallacy detection, ST2 eight-way fallacy classification, ST3 four-way argument-scheme classification) and both evaluation tracks. Our submitted systems are fine-tuned RoBERTa-large encoders with task-specific heads, augmented with a small batch of LLM-generated synthetic contrastive pairs; for ST2 and ST3 on the enhanced track we additionally added confidence-filtered pseudo-labelled examples from the unlabelled pool. A wider backbone comparison spanning additional encoders (DeBERTa-v3, ModernBERT) and an LLM track (four Qwen variants from 3B to 32B, zero-shot through CoT-LoRA) showed no validated benefit over RoBERTa-large at this corpus scale, with 5-fold variance wide enough that we call the comparison underpowered rather than settled. We also characterise how much of the enhanced track's lift reflects organiser-rewritten inputs carrying label information rather than genuine argument clarification. On the official Touche 2026 test set our systems ranked first on both base-track classification cells (ST2 and ST3) and second on both binary-detection (ST1) tracks, with the two enhanced-track classification cells topped by cascaded and multitask systems. We close with the rare-class limitation on ST3 and the most useful follow-ups. Code: https://github.com/psychias/fallacy_detection_clef_2026

</details>


### [296] [Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17113)
*Yang Wang,Hanlin Xiao,Yanan Ma,Chenghao Xiao,Chenghua Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CalOn 是一个统一的 0.6 亿参数编码器，应用于实体、关系和事件提取。该模型能同时处理多种数据集和模式，通过联合编码文本和类型定义来识别实体跨度、跨度之间的关系以及事件触发和论元。在 40 个基准测试中，CalOn 大多数情况下优于基线模型，特别是在关系提取和事件触发及论元方面取得了最佳的平均 F1 值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息提取模型在迁移学习方面存在挑战，CalOn 提出了一种统一方法，以处理多种实体、关系和事件提取任务，提升模型跨数据集和模式的性能。

Method: CalOn 使用联合编码方法对文本和类型定义进行编码，然后直接识别实体跨度、关系和事件触发及其论元。模型集成训练多样性数据源，并结合监督学习和奖励机制进行优化。

Result: CalOn 在 40 个基准测试中表现优异，特别是在关系提取和事件提取中取得了最佳的平均 F1 值。经过校准后，模型对实体、关系和事件论元的自信心估计有所提升，同时保持了较高的 F1 分数。

Conclusion: CalOn 提供了一种新的统一框架，通过联合编码实现了跨数据集和模式的实体、关系和事件提取，同时保持了良好的性能和泛化能力。

Abstract: Information extraction models often perform well on the datasets they are trained on, but transferring to new domains and annotation guidelines remains challenging. Supporting user-specified types alone does not resolve this problem. We present CalOn, a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder for entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas. The model jointly encodes text and type definitions, then directly identifies entity spans, relations between spans, and event triggers and arguments. Its extraction decisions consider the requested types together, using their combined evidence to identify relevant candidates before assigning a type. This gives all three tasks a common probabilistic formulation while keeping every extracted mention anchored to the input text. We train on diverse sources, and supplement supervised learning with a reward that encourages correct extractions and penalises incorrect ones. Across 40 benchmarks, CalOn outperforms the evaluated baselines on most benchmarks. It leads all reported relation extraction benchmarks and achieves the highest average F1 for event triggers and arguments with gold triggers. The same model also performs strongly on aspect sentiment triplet extraction and pronoun resolution through its span-pair formulation. A correction for the probability bias introduced during training improves confidence estimates for entities, relations, and event arguments after calibration, with little change in F1.

</details>


### [297] [Gluing Local Contexts into Global Meaning: A Sheaf-Theoretic Decomposition of Transformer Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17117)
*Bryce Grant,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的方法，通过细胞层来评估文本表示在词序变化时是否保持相同的内容。该方法显著提高了模型的解释能力，并揭示了模型的重要脆弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性工具无法测试当文本表达形式改变时，其表示是否保持相同的内容。因此，研究者采用了一种基于网络层的可解释性评估方法，以增强模型的解释性和鲁棒性。

Method: 研究方法主要分为三个部分：首先，将每个同义词对视为局部证据，构建一个细胞层于同义词图上；然后，利用细胞层的拉普拉斯矩阵来评估在未训练的模型上是否保持相同的表示；最后，通过评估基于同义词样本的谱补全来集中因果影响，并探讨了层叠模型的代数1-周期对于模型性能的影响。

Result: 该研究发现，基于同义词网络层的方法在不同架构的模型中显著提高了内容保持能力。研究还揭示了模型的重要脆弱点，即通过对同义词相关变量的改变来影响模型输出。此外，采用层叠结构的模型在同义词变量下的模型表现与其鲁棒性存在显著相关性。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的新方法为评估和改进模型的解释性和鲁棒性提供了有效工具，为未来研究提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Existing interpretability tools do not test whether a representation keeps the same content when only the phrasing changes. We treat each paraphrase pair as a local witness that two activations should agree and build a cellular sheaf over the paraphrase graph; its Laplacian $L_\mathcal{F}$ answers the question on a frozen model with no training. The kernel $H^0$ is a content subspace: at 20 dimensions it beats the preserved subspace of the concept eraser LEACE on held-out CounterFact fact retrieval across eight architectures by a mean $+17.1$\,pp, and constraining all paraphrases of a fact jointly adds a further $+6.5$\,pp. The spectral complement concentrates causal influence: ablating the most paraphrase-variable coordinates, a coordinate-wise proxy for it, changes model outputs $5.6$ to $26.5\times$ more than ablating coordinates of matched per-coordinate variability, across nine models from 124M to 13B parameters. Stacking layers into a grid creates $b_1 = N(L-1)$ algebraic 1-cycles, and the resulting model-derived harmonic mass varies by nearly three orders of magnitude across six architectures and ranks them as their steering fragility does (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$, exact one-sided permutation $p = 0.014$). The same paraphrase graph yields the content subspace, the influence directions, and the fragility measure. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/

</details>


### [298] [D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17124)
*Cheng-Kuang Chang,Alexander H. Liu,Brian Kingsbury,Hilde Kuehne,Rogerio Feris,Samuel Thomas,James Glass,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Dialogue-to-Duplex（D2）框架，将预训练的全双工互操作能力较低的半双工语音语言模型转换为高能力的全双工语音语言模型。该框架通过解码器无损表征蒸馏和监督微调实现这一目标。结果显示，在12.5Hz更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2达到了99.2%的轮流成功率，521毫秒的延迟，99.5%的打断成功率和70.1的VoiceBench评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音模型（FD-SLMs）虽然能够同时监听和说话，但在一般功能上通常落后于半双工语音模型（HD-SLMs）。因此，需要一种框架来提高FD-SLMs的能力。

Method: D2框架通过解码器无损表征蒸馏和监督微调，将预训练的HD-SLMs转换为高能力的FD-SLMs。研究了不同块大小对全双工交互、通用能力和推理计算的影响。

Result: D2框架被应用于两种不同的HD-SLM架构，Qwen3-Omni和LLaMA-Omni 2。结果显示，Qwen3-Omni-D2在12.5Hz更新率下达到了99.2%的轮流成功率，521毫秒的延迟，99.5%的打断成功率和70.1的VoiceBench评分。

Conclusion: 通过D2框架，半双工语音语言模型能够被有效地转换为高能力的全双工语音语言模型。这展示了D2框架的有效性和潜力。

Abstract: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

</details>


### [299] [ToolHACE: A Dataset for Detecting Hallucinations in Tool-Based LLM Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17125)
*Nikolay Ivanov,Sergey Pletenev,Elisei Rykov,Anatolii Frolov,Bogdan Monogov,Alexander Potekhin,Maria Marina,Daniil Moskovskiy,Viktor Moskvoretskii,Alexander Panchenko,Ilseyar Alimova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一个针对工具增强语言模型的语义级谬误检测基准ToolHACE，旨在专门检测工具调用后生成的谬误，通过实验证明该领域存在挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型在调用正确工具并获得准确信息后，仍可能产生谬误。当前的谬误检测基准主要集中在工具调用阶段，忽略了调用后反应生成中的错误。

Method: ToolHACE包含五个细粒度的谬误类别，并通过现代谬误检测工具进行广泛的实验，证明了需要针对工具增强语料库进行专门训练。

Result: 发现调用工具后的谬误普遍且难以检测，并证实了工具增强语料库的专门训练比工具无意识数据集的迁移效果更好。

Conclusion: 强调需要特定基准和模型来可靠地检测工具增强语言系统的谬误。

Abstract: Tool-augmented language models ground their responses in external tool outputs, improving reliability beyond parametric knowledge alone. However, even when the correct tool is called and returns accurate information, models may still contradict such outputs, omit critical details, or generate unsupported claims. Existing hallucination benchmarks for tool-augmented dialogue primarily focus on the tool-calling stage, evaluating whether the correct tool and arguments are selected, while overlooking errors that arise during post-tool response generation. To address this gap, we introduce ToolHACE, a span-level benchmark for hallucination detection in tool-augmented LLM responses, covering five fine-grained hallucination categories. Through extensive experiments with modern hallucination detectors, we show that post-tool-call hallucinations are widespread and remain challenging to detect. Our results further demonstrate that effective detection requires training on specialized tool-augmented corpora, while transfer from tool-agnostic hallucination datasets performs poorly in this setting. These findings highlight the need for dedicated benchmarks and models for reliable hallucination detection in tool-augmented language systems.

</details>


### [300] [DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17184)
*Shubham Agarwal,Akshat Gupta,Mike Heddes,Dilara Soylu,Rui Meng,Patrick Tser Jern Kon,Jiefeng Chen,Mert Cemri,Shu Liu,Abe Gonzalez,Akanksha Jain,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Linfeng Song,Vilobh Meshram,Xiangru Tang,Jinsung Yoon,Aditya Parameswaran,Ion Stoica,Vahab Mirrokni,Burak Gokturk,Parthasarathy Ranganathan,Tomas Pfister,Nanyun Peng,Chun-Liang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DuoDiscover 是一种自主发现系统，用于优化从软件到芯片架构的目标。该系统通过三机制协作，包括worker共同发现优化目标和高效代理评估器、持续准确性检查以及无中心问题分解，提高了性能并节省了评价成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的自主发现面临的一个主要瓶颈是评估成本过高。面对实际环境中的长时间真实评估，搜索过程只能进行有限的真实评估次数。DuoDiscover通过引入新的机制，以较低的成本实现了高效的自主优化。

Method: DuoDiscover 主要采用三种机制：每个Coding Agent同时发现优化目标和快速定制的代理评估方法（称为yardstick），持续检查yardstick的准确度并在其偏离真实目标时失效；底层自管理团队模式，自主启动和终止Agent，并用最新成果培训正在运行的Agent；无中心分解问题的自下而上策略，让轻量级协调器负责任务的分配和终止。

Result: 在两个repository级别的基准测试中，DuoDiscover使人类专家的平均加速比翻倍。在SWE-fficiency和SOL-Exec基准测试中，DuoDiscover在大多数情况下优于或接近人类设计的最佳性能。特别是在对vLLM和SQLite等高度优化的引擎进行优化时，DuoDiscover实现了显著的性能提升，超越了基于AlphaEvolve的ArchAgent v2和最佳人类设计。

Conclusion: DuoDiscover展示了在从软件到芯片架构的整体自主优化过程中的潜力，能够显著提升性能并显著降低评价成本，对未来的自主设计领域具有重要意义。

Abstract: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate progress efficiently, through three mechanisms. First, each worker in a fleet of coding agents co-discovers an optimization target and a fast, tailored proxy evaluator, which we call a yardstick. The agent then hill-climbs the yardstick rather than the true evaluation. Second, since search can exploit gaps between a yardstick and the true objective, fidelity tests continually recheck each yardstick's ranking and invalidate any that drift. Third, the fleet is bottom-up, with no central decomposition of the problem. A lightweight orchestrator spawns and terminates agents, briefs running ones, and seeds new agents with others' confirmed work. DuoDiscover enables autonomous optimization from software to chip architecture. We demonstrate DuoDiscover on two repository-level benchmarks and four GPU and TPU kernel suites covering hundreds of kernels. On SWE-fficiency, it doubles the average speedup of human experts. On SOL-Exec, it ranks first on 121 of 235 kernels and in the top three on 212. On the heavily optimized vLLM and SQLite engines, DuoDiscover achieves 1.92$\times$ and 1.38$\times$ gains over the base code. On a CPU microarchitecture optimization task with evaluations of up to 28 hours, DuoDiscover surpasses both AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and the best human design, with 1.65$\times$ ArchAgent v2's gain in 16.7 days versus more than 40 days, advancing the frontier of autonomous chip design.

</details>


### [301] [Soft Teacher Forcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17189)
*Mohammad Fahes,Cordelia Schmid,Anurag Arnab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF)的简单训练算法，通过随机凸组合将教师强迫嵌入与软标记结合。与传统监督微调相比，这种方法在多个数学推理数据集上表现出明显的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软标记在过去的链式思维方法中被用来替代离散的链式思维，尽管它们在某些场景下表现不佳，但这种方法需要多阶段训练和可能需要额外的模型模块。因此，本文提出了一种新的方法——Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF)，以期直接改善监督微调训练，而不依赖于中间的链式思维模块。

Method: 该方法通过单次并行的前向传播计算软标记，并通过随机凸组合将它们与教师强迫嵌入结合。Soft Teacher Forcing不增加额外参数，也不依赖外部模型或学习曲线，训练过程相对简单。

Result: 实验结果表明，使用Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF)在GSM8K、MATH、MathQA和AQuA等数学推理数据集上均取得了显著性能提升，在GSM8K数据集上，平均提高了2.1到4.1个分数点。

Conclusion: 该工作提出的方法证明了即使不是通过替代传统的内部推理机制，软标记也可以增强监督微调的效果，且方法简单直接。

Abstract: Soft tokens have so far been used to replace discrete chain-of-thought in latent reasoning methods. These approaches typically require multi-stage training and, in some cases, auxiliary modules, yet they still underperform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on <input, chain-of-thought, output> triples. In this paper, we ask whether soft tokens can be used to improve SFT itself, instead of as an avenue for latent reasoning. We introduce Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF), a simple training algorithm that combines teacher-forced embeddings with soft tokens through random convex combinations. The soft tokens are computed in a single parallel forward pass over the ground-truth sequence. Soft-TF adds no parameters, no external model and no curriculum, and leaves inference unchanged. Experiments show that Soft-TF improves over SFT on GSM8K, MATH, MathQA and AQuA, by +2.1 to +4.1 points on GSM8K across seven Gemma, Llama and Mistral models.

</details>


### [302] [Welcome to the Age of Agent Ads: Using On-Policy Attacks to Steer Agentic Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17195)
*Tim R. Davidson,Marija Šakota,Joshua Joseph,Robert West*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了一种名为on-policy的新型攻击方法，该方法可引导AI代理决策而无需偏离其本来的对齐行为。作者通过一个实例展示了这种攻击，并评估了其在实际应用中的有效性，揭示了某些前沿模型的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人们越来越多地将选择排序任务（如购物、求职、旅行）委托给AI代理，这种新型攻击方法能够帮助揭示如何防御针对AI代理的操纵攻击，同时为监管这类广告活动提供参考。

Method: 通过在产品描述中引入对虚构概念的否定声明，触发代理搜索相关概念，进而使平台上的广告展示包含虚假信息，使得AI代理对相关选项进行惩罚。

Result: 研究评估了这种新型攻击方法在四个真实世界列表数据集上的效果，发现某些先进的模型存在缺陷，可以被这种攻击所利用，从而让广告方能够违规操作，尽管他们并没有违反现有的平台列表规则。

Conclusion: 研究提出了监管面向AI代理的广告活动所面临的更广泛挑战，并为模型开发者和平台提供商提供了相关建议。
