Abstract: People increasingly delegate option-ranking tasks (e.g., shopping, job search, travel) to AI agents, which creates incentives to steer agentic decisions via "agent ads." To defend against such steering attacks, people count on models' alignment training and platforms' terms of service, and consequently the most effective existing attacks are designed to trigger off-policy behaviors. Exposing a new attack surface, we introduce on-policy attacks, which steer agentic decisions without pushing individually aligned behaviors off policy. Our example attack consists of two steps: To remain compliant with platforms' terms of service, we first inject a truthful negation about a fictitious concept ("Does not contain blizyester") into a product description. This triggers an agent to search the web ("What is blizyester?"), which surfaces planted websites full of fabricated information associating the fictitious concept with harmful implications ("Blizyester linked to dementia"). Trained to keep users safe from harm, the agent penalizes every option missing the truthful negation. Evaluating our attack across four real-world listing datasets, we find some frontier models exposed, enabling an adversarial actor to penalize competitors without violating existing platform-listing guidelines. We discuss the broader challenge of regulating advertising aimed at AI agents and provide recommendations to model developers and platform providers.

</details>


### [303] [From Conceptual EneMonIE to an Executable Backend: A Modular Architecture for Energy Information Extractionand Grounded Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17243)
*Janik Lesage,Khadim Lô,and Jean-Sébastien Dessureault*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了EneMonIE-Backend，这是对原EneMonIE提案的实现衍生再设计，转化为模块化、可执行且应用程序独立的后端。该架构通过RSS源、URL集合、arXiv、社交媒体JSON文件和开放数据CSV文件等可配置连接器获取并规范化数据，引入了基于问题的网络搜索和抓取。该后端支持实体共现图、跨文档链接、群组级别信息融合和关系持久化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在提供一个可执行的后端来实现并对原EneMonIE提案（一个不间断监控能源趋势的基于网页的语义系统）进行改进，使得系统更加模块化、应用程序独立，并能够嵌入不同的应用程序中。

Method: 该方法包括以下步骤：首先，通过RSS源、URL集合、arXiv、社交媒体JSON文件和开放数据CSV文件等可配置连接器获取和规范化数据；其次，将采集的数据进行能源分类、命名实体识别、时间事件提取、源敏感情感分析和抽取出摘要；然后，提取出有意义的语义表示并存储在SQLite数据库中；最后，提供了三种基于问题的回答路径，并且通过语言模型生成答案或退化为确定性抽取输出。

Result: 实验验证表明，该后端系统能够进行相关性筛选、持久存储、聚类、证据检索和文档删除。同时，该系统提供了一个可重复的架构基础，用于未来评估更大型、多语言的能源语料库。

Conclusion: EneMonIE-Backend展示了如何将一个复杂的信息提取和语义处理系统模块化和执行化，允许它在不同的应用程序中使用，从而为未来的能源信息处理和分析开辟新的可能性。

Abstract: The original EneMonIE proposal describes a Web-based semantic system for continuously monitoring energy trends through targeted information extraction from heterogeneous online media. This article presents EneMonIE-Backend, an implementation-derived redesign that converts that conceptual pipeline into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend. The architecture separates five concerns: data sources, acquisition and normalization, semantic processing, knowledge organization, and persistent storage. It operationalizes configurable connectors for RSS feeds, URL collections, arXiv, social-media JSON files, and open-data CSV files; it also introduces question-driven Web search and scraping. Relevant documents pass through energy categorization, named entity recognition, temporal and event extraction, source sensitive sentiment analysis, and extractive summarization. The resulting semantic representations support entity co-occurrence graphs, cross-document interlinking, cluster-level information fusion, and relational persistence in SQLite. Three grounded question-answering paths are exposed at the backend level: live Web evidence, the stored corpus, and selected configured resources. Answer generation uses a language model when configured and otherwise falls back to deterministic extractive output. Unlike the original proposal, the presented architecture deliberately excludes the user-interface and server-side application layers, allowing the semantic core to be embedded in different applications. A deterministic smoke validation confirms relevance filtering, persistence, clustering, evidence retrieval, and document deletion. The work provides a reproducible architectural basis for future evaluation on larger multilingual energy corpora.

</details>


### [304] [Nufo: A Benchmark for Ewe Automatic Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17278)
*Christ Kekeli Keli,Steve Sanogo,Patrice Sebastiano,Hamad Aldenawi,Ryan Whetten*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究为艾韦语(Aewe)构建了一个标准化的174小时自动语音识别(ASR)基准，是目前最大的同类基准，并对预训练语音模型进行了微调和评估，以建立基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言如非洲语言艾韦的自动语音识别（ASR）面临巨大挑战，因为这些语言的转录语音资源稀缺。研究旨在解决这一问题，推动艾韦语及其他未充分研究的非洲语言的ASR系统开发。

Method: 研究人员收集并标准化了现有的艾韦语语音资源，构建了一个174小时的基准，并对包括Whisper和AfriHuBERT在内的预训练语音模型进行了微调。

Result: Whisper-medium在测试集上的字错误率（WER）为37.98%，而AfriHuBERT为39.70%。还提供了对识别错误的定性分析。

Conclusion: 研究发布了名为Nufo的基准数据集，伴随模型和评估资源，旨在促进艾韦语及其他非洲未充分研究语言的ASR研究。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains challenging for low-resource languages, where the scarcity of transcribed speech limits the development of accurate systems. This challenge is particularly acute for African languages such as Ewe, which has millions of speakers but remains underrepresented in publicly available ASR resources and benchmarks. In this work, we consolidate, normalize, and partition existing Ewe speech resources into a standardized 174-hour Ewe ASR benchmark, the largest to date to our knowledge. We fine-tune and evaluate pretrained speech models, including Whisper and AfriHuBERT, to establish strong baselines on our benchmark. Whisper-medium achieves a word error rate (WER) of 37.98%, while AfriHuBERT achieves 39.70% on the test set. We further provide a qualitative analysis of common recognition errors. We release the benchmark under the name Nufo, derived from the Ewe word for "talk", accompanied by models and evaluation resources, to facilitate future research on Ewe and other underrepresented African languages.

</details>


### [305] [StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17309)
*Xialie Zhuang,Zunhai Su,Jia Pan,Ngai Wong,Guanhua Chen,Chuan-Wei Kuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了StartLux-Decision模型系列，涵盖从0.8B到27B参数不等的决策模型。通过增强注意力机制和引入三阶段训练 pipeline，即时模型保持了单次通过推理的同时提高了决策准确性。AutoThink模型则针对不确定的决策进行显式推理。RLCD$^2$方法提升了决策概率质量同时减少了推理长度。实验表明，即时模型在Decision Index 0.3上显著优于现有的评价模型，而AutoThink模型在DecisionPivot基准测试中表现出更强的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着认知决策任务变得日益复杂，传统单一途径的预测模型难以满足需求。因此，该研究提出了一种结合高效单次预测和适应性推理机制的决策模型框架，旨在提高复杂决策场景下的准确性和效率。

Method: 研究引入了即时模型（使用双向注意力机制）和AutoThink模型（针对不确定性决策进行显式推理）。此外，还开发了一个三阶段训练管道，用于建立共享决策能力，细分模型，并通过推理监督和强化学习为AutoThink模型配备推理能力。同时，研究者提出了RLCD$^2$方法，旨在优化决策的概率质量并减少推理时间。

Result: 实验结果显示，即时模型在公开的Decision Index 0.3子集中显著优于现有评价模型，提升了7.4-16.9个百分点。而27B参数的AutoThink模型在DecisionPivot基准测试中表现尤为出色，对偶准确性提高了11.5-18.4个百分点。除此之外，模型还在量化版本上进行了优化，以降低内存使用。

Conclusion: 该研究通过方法上的创新，不仅提高了基于模型的认知决策准确性和推理效率，还为开发者提供了性能更好的决策模型和高效推理方法，有望赋能更广泛的决策支持应用场景。

Abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.

</details>


### [306] [From Sampled Evidence to Radiology Reports: Objectives, Constraints, and Realization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17318)
*Kun Zhao,Haoteng Tang,Chenghua Lin,Liang Zhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过分离决策信号、评分目标和可行决策集，研究了如何将采样的证据转化为最终决策，并探讨了不同结构决策对报告质量的影响。文章在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray中调查了13种生成器配置，在分组开发/测试评估下进行对比，发现了三个主要发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何将采样的证据转化为最终决策，并探讨不同结构的决策是否能提高报告质量。

Method: 文章采用了分离决策信号、评分目标和可行决策集的框架，以及在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray基准上进行13种生成器配置的对比分析。

Result: 研究发现在固定证据和规则容量的情况下，改变评分目标会影响预测及其保持出的度量标准的权衡。放宽候选约束对共享信号和冻结评分目标会有目标依赖性影响。诊断显示IU宏式的断言增加与接近零标签阈值有关，并且有限的候选覆盖与选择余地共存。受控实现研究表明决策层面的收益可能被削弱、放大或逆转。分解显示实现可以删除错误的断言，但可能导致正确发现的丢失，因此目标保真度和参考准确性不一定同时提高。发现还并不能一致提高基于参考的报告质量。

Conclusion: 本文的研究结果强调了分别评估决策规则、候选约束和实现报告的必要性。

Abstract: Sampling multiple reports creates an inference problem: how should sampled evidence be converted into a final decision, and does a better structured decision yield a better report? We study these questions through a framework that separates the decision signal, scoring objective, and feasible decision set, followed by text realization. On MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray, controlled comparisons across 13 generator configurations per benchmark under grouped development/test evaluation reveal three findings. First, changing the objective under fixed evidence and rule capacity changes predictions and their held-out metric trade-offs. Second, relaxing candidate constraints has objective-dependent effects under shared signals and frozen scores. Diagnostics connect the IU macro-oriented assertion increase to near-zero label thresholds and show that limited candidate coverage coexists with selection headroom. Third, a controlled realization study with SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B shows that decision-level gains can be attenuated, amplified, or reversed. Change decomposition reveals that realization can remove incorrect assertions while losing correct findings, so target fidelity and reference accuracy need not improve together. Finding gains also do not consistently improve reference-based report quality. These results motivate separate evaluation of decision rules, candidate constraints, and realized reports.

</details>


### [307] [Thinking Outside the Bots: Human Ideas in AI's Semantic Blind Spots Are Not Inferior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17324)
*Kibum Moon,Dan R. Johnson,Kostadin Kushlev,Benjamin Lira,Indre Viskontas,James C. Kaufman,Roger E. Beaty,Angela L. Duckworth,Adam E. Green*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过EDGE方法发现人类生成的想法在某些领域比AI想法更具创意且不具劣质性，表明人类多样化并不表示AI可以忽略的低质量思维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨人类思想是否因其多样性而包含AI无法捕捉到的有价值的认知过程，或这些多样性本质上代表了较低质量的思想。

Method: 开发了EDGE方法，对比人类生成与AI生成的想法在三个开放式任务中的表现：入学申请文书、日常物品的替代用途以及人际建议。

Result: 人类生成的想法在三个方面中占据了AI输出词汇密度较少的领域；这些独特的人类反应在创造性和质量上没有明显的缺陷，与AI输出相比，与学业表现相关联并向一些结果提供了更有价值的评价和成就。

Conclusion: 差异化的、独特的人类想法不仅具有高创意，并在某些情况下表现为更好的表现，表明人类的多样化不会反映AIA可以安全忽视的低端思维，反而可能为个人和群体带来优势。

Abstract: AI-generated outputs are frequently perceived as highly creative, but also tend to be more similar to each other (homogenized) than human ideas. Does the human heterogeneity that extends beyond AI reflect valuable thinking that AI misses? Alternatively, is greater human heterogeneity driven by lower-quality ideas and less effective thinking that AI avoids? We developed Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression (EDGE) to map AI's semantic "blind spots" by assessing how strongly/weakly individual human ideas were represented in a task-matched AI semantic comparison set. Specifically, we compared human-generated vs. AI-generated ideas across three open-ended tasks: college admissions essays, alternative uses for everyday objects, and interpersonal advice. Across all three tasks, human responses extended into semantic regions sparsely covered by AI outputs. These distinctively human responses showed no meaningful deficits in creativity, quality, or effectiveness, were associated with equal-or-better academic performance, and with credibly superior ratings and achievement for some outcomes. These ideas were thus not merely poor-performing variation; they performed as well as or better than ideas that overlapped more strongly with AI ideas. More distinctive human ideas tended to receive higher creativity ratings, but this relationship was weak or reversed for AI ideas. Taken together, these results suggest that differentiation among human-generated ideas does not reflect poor thinking that AI can safely omit, and instead may afford both individual and population-level advantages.

</details>


### [308] [The Curse of Knowledge in Role-Playing Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17327)
*Xiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 角色在游戏和仿真代理中扮演角色时，系统记录了每个角色能听、看到和理解的内容。但在480个场景中，有67至72个百分点的角色超出了这些界限，尤其是当场景布局或角色描述发生变化时，这种泄漏会显著增加。通过仅让模型观察角色所见和所听的内容，可以防止这一现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估语言模型在角色扮演中的表现，特别是在执行角色限定的任务时是否遵守规则。

Method: 对11种开放预训练模型和六种专有模型进行了测试，在480个场景中评估角色的表现，并通过改变场景布局或角色描述来测试模型的遵从性。

Result: 大多数模型在未改变场景和角色描述的情况下正确表达了角色的感知，但在改变了场景布局或角色描述后，开放预训练模型的违规率显著上升，达到67至72个百分点。专有模型的违规率较低，但在输入格式上依赖于模型的强度。当场景或角色描述发生变化时，违规率显著上升。

Conclusion: 开放预训练模型容易泄漏角色不应知晓的信息，这可能是由于模型的知识溢出。输入格式和场景描述的细微变化都会显著增加模型的违规行为。提高模型在角色限定场景中的表现需要确保模型仅基于角色的观察来生成输出。

Abstract: Role-playing language models speak as characters in games and agent simulations, where the system records what each character can hear, see and understand. We test whether characters respect these boundaries in 480 scenes, each with a counterfactual twin that changes only the hidden fact, so mentions of the twin's fact measure guessing. Across 11 open-weight models, characters use content from speech they cannot understand or hear at 67 and 72 percentage points (pp) above this baseline, although most models correctly state what the character perceives. This is a curse of knowledge. The leak extends to hidden actions and private messages and changes where characters search. Five of six proprietary models rarely leak, but compliance in strong models depends on input format. Changing only the scene layout or character description raises the rate in two otherwise compliant open-weight models from under 10 to over 60 pp, and combined changes raise two proprietary models from near zero to 13 and 21~pp. Writing the line as the scene's author leaks nearly as much as role-play, and thinking rarely helps. Giving models only what the character observes stops the leak without hiding what it may report.

</details>


### [309] [claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17358)
*Martin Amster,One An,Holly Baker,Fernanda Graciolli,Simon Henniger,Nada Amin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究针对自然语言需求和形式化规范之间的差距，建立了一个端到端的基准测试集，并开发了一个名为claimcheck的工具来检测错误的形式化规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大模型在编写代码和规范方面的作用增强，自然语言需求与规范之间的差距成为了一个实际的风险。为了填补这一差距，研究提出了一个评估形式化规范准确性的端到端基准测试集。

Method: 研究收集了3,234个包含自然语言需求、形式化规范和执行、证明或基准来源的标签的条目，并使用两个模型（翻译模型和评估模型）来检测规范是否正确表达了需求。

Result: claimcheck工具在这四个形式化语言中分别获得了8.2到9.8个宏召回率点数的提升，且相对于仅显示需求和规范，额外显示规范会对召回率产生负面影响。

Conclusion: 研究有效填补了自然语言需求与形式化规范之间的差距，提供了评估规范准确性的新方法。

Abstract: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.

</details>


### [310] [UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17363)
*Fabrice Lamarche,Amal Zouaq*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UMCR 提出了一种新的管线方法，能够从各种类型和来源的医学文本中提取并链接到任意目标本体，通过直接集成指导方针和自主链接模块，其性能在 MedPath 挑战集上表现优秀，增强了医学标准之间的互操作性，减少了对参数化 LLM 记忆的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前针对单一本体和源文本类型的医学概念识别方法存在局限性，未能充分支持不同本体和文本类型的适应性。

Method: UMCR 方法利用直接的指导方针集成和自主链接模块，可以从多种医学文本中提取并链接到任何目标本体。

Result: UMCR 在 MedPath 基准测试中表现出色，适用于多种医学文本类型，并且比其他方法减少了对参数化大型语言模型的记忆依赖。

Conclusion: UMCR 改进了医学标准之间的互操作性，展示了其在医疗领域的潜力，未来可以进一步测试和优化性能。

Abstract: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.

</details>


### [311] [PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17375)
*Quentin Fruytier,Anton Xue,Sanjay Shakkottai,Sujay Sanghavi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的策略Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG)，通过使用一个轻量级的辅助模型来估计并行与顺序生成之间的不一致性，从而在扩散语言模型中提高生成精度。PIG在多个人工智能评估基准上比当前标准方法表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型在并行解码时效率提高，但与顺序解码相比，准确性会降低。为了解决这一问题，研究提出了PIG策略，以直接估计并行和顺序生成之间的不一致性，从而优化生成过程。

Method: PIG使用一个经过少量数据训练的轻量级辅助模型来估计解码过程中并行和顺序生成的差异。在采样时，逐步添加标记，并在达到预设的不一致性阈值时停止。这种方法不需要使用以往的昂贵或慢速的“先验”方法。

Result: PIG在GSM8K、MATH500、MBPP、HumanEval和MMLU等基准测试中，与工业标准Fast-dLLM相比，提高了准确性。对于LLaDA-8B Instruct和NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct模型，PIG的表现优于DAPD、KLASS、EB-sampler和其他已有的策略。

Conclusion: PIG提供了一种有效的方法来提高扩散语言模型的生成精度，特别是在并行解码的情况下，这种方法在多个评估基准上的表现优于现有的替代方案。

Abstract: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.

</details>


### [312] [Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17402)
*Adib Sakhawat,Fardeen Sadab,Tamjid Hasan Fahim,Multazam Mahmud,Tahsan Ferdous Lihan,Md Isfak Iqbal Chowdhury,Nafis Ahnaf Jamil,Md. Atik Shahriar,Sieam Shahriare,Wasi Omar Syed,M Safwan Hasan Khan,Tabib Hassan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究测试了五种大型语言模型(Large Language Models，LLMs)在重建Allen 13种时间关系网络方面的表现，发现虽然最佳模型在宏观F1分数上优于简单基线，但在解析准确率上仍不及总是回答'之前'的准确性。格式错误影响了模型的表现，而一个简单的后处理器可以显著提高覆盖范围。模型在识别事件的先行和包含关系上表现较好，但在回溯事件上表现不佳。逻辑一致性并不能有效提高与黄金标注的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数关于事件的测试都是基于孤立事件对或粗略标签的，这与理解叙述的需要不符。为了更好地评估大型语言模型在理解事件时间关系方面的表现，研究者设计了一项实验，让模型重建Allen提出的13种时间关系网络。

Method: 研究者对360个用英语编写的叙述事件进行了测试。这些事件是相对于彼此而非具体日期来排列的。研究者对五种不同的LLMs进行了测试，然后根据预注册的协议对模型的输出进行评估，这包括与黄金标注的一致性、逆向一致性以及逻辑可满足性。

Result: 最佳模型在宏观F1分数上优于简单基线，但在解析准确率上仍不及总是回答'之前'的准确性。解析错误影响了模型的表现，而一个简单的后处理器可以显著提高覆盖范围。模型在识别事件的先行和包含关系方面表现良好，但在回溯事件方面表现较差。逻辑一致性并不能有效提高与黄金标注的一致性。

Conclusion: 研究得出结论，可靠的结构化输出和稳健处理相对时间是进行整个叙述的时序推理的前提条件。

Abstract: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

</details>


### [313] [Compositional RL: Evaluating and Training LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17456)
*Shangbin Feng,Yulia Tsvetkov,Jan Kautz,David Acuna*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出了模型的组成强度概念，并通过Shapley值的方法量化，发现模型的个体表现与它们在协作系统中的贡献无显著相关性。为此，提出了基于多模型系统的组合强化学习方法C-RL，该方法能够显著提升协作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对模型的评估往往只关注其单独表现，而实际部署中模型更注重在整个系统中的协同作用。因此，研究提出量化模型组成强度的方法，并研究其训练方法，以弥补单独评估的不足。

Method: 使用Shapley值和leave-one-out贡献作为模型组成强度的近似指标，通过统计分析五个模型池、十二种协作方法和十二个数据集的数据。此外，通过组合强化学习C-RL方法，在多模型系统中直接训练策略并奖励整个系统的性能。

Result: 研究表明，模型的个体表现与它们在协作系统中的贡献并无显著相关性。C-RL方法能够显著提升协作性能，平均提升3倍于基线方法，最高提升至13.1分。

Conclusion: 文章结果强调了模型在协作系统中表现的重要性，并提出了一种新方法C-RL，能够显著提升在多模型系统中的协同性能。

Abstract: Language models are often evaluated alone but increasingly deployed together, routed between, made to debate, ensembled, or collaboratively trained. For a model inside a system, what matters most is not how well it performs on its own, but how much the system gains from its presence. We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.

</details>


### [314] [Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17461)
*Ju-Chieh Chou,Jiawei Zhou,Karen Livescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对双向语音语言模型的知识蒸馏方法，通过在语音模型中引入文本接口，同时保留纯语音输入和输出。此方法提高了语音生成的困惑度，并在知识保留方面超过了纯粹使用语音或语音-文本交替输入的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法主要集中在使用语音输入和输出的模型，而本文则通过对双向语音模型的知识蒸馏来转移文本能力，填补了该领域的空白。

Method: 通过引入内部文本接口将知识从预训练的文本语言模型转移到双向语音语言模型。模型首先处理语音上下文，然后在不依赖转录的情况下进行文本预测，并利用预测文本引导未来的语音生成。

Result: 在匹配的训练条件下，所提出的方法大大提高了语音生成的困惑度，并在知识保留方面优于纯语音输入和交替的语音-文本输入。更重要的是，知识的蒸馏在文本和语音评估中都提高了事实性能。

Conclusion: 这是首次将文本语言模型的知识蒸馏应用于双向语音语言模型。从理论上讲，这为语音模型提供更多语言和事实能力提供了一种新的途径。

Abstract: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.

</details>


### [315] [Everyone Was Right: Lexical Representations in Language Models Are Both Abstract and Holistic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17538)
*Zachary Nicholas Houghton,Yu Zhou,Dan Pluth,Vijay K. Gurbani,Vsevolod Kapatsinski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究分解了语言模型中的上下文字词表示，发现交互成分普遍存在，随层次增加而增强，并包含了与项目和类别相关的抽象信息。交互不是与项目和类别的几乎正交效果，而是与两者重叠，并编码了超出共享类别效应的类别信息。即使输入只包含加性结构，人工语言学习者中也会出现交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨语言模型中上下文字词表示如何组织抽象信息和特定上下文信息。

Method: 通过分解预训练的变换器中的上下文字词表示为项目、类别和单词类别交互组件来研究。

Result: 在六种预训练变换器和两种语言类别中，交互成分普遍存在，随层次增加而增强，包含与项目和类别相关的抽象信息。人工语言学习者中也出现了这种交互成分，即使输入只包含加性结构。

Conclusion: 此研究表明，词汇表示包含了与特定单词类别组合相关的特定结构信息，以及抽象信息。

Abstract: Lexical representations can encode both abstract information and information specific to particular contexts. We investigate how these forms of information are organized in language models by decomposing contextual word representations into item, class, and word-class interaction components. Across six pretrained transformers and two linguistic categories, we find that the interaction is consistently present, grows across layers, and contains information associated with both item and class. Unlike the nearly orthogonal item and class effects, the interaction overlaps with both and encodes class information beyond the shared class effect. An interaction also emerges in artificial-language learners even when the input contains only additive structure. Together, these findings show that lexical representations combine abstract information with structure specific to particular word-class combinations.

</details>


### [316] [Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17544)
*Jianghong Zhou,Hao Rong,Chen Lin,Daoan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了记忆收缩的概念，通过使用思维模板、技能库、代理记忆和缓存减少推理步骤。研究发现传统的成功与失败计数器不是有效的变化检测器，而新的方法（如ExpeL-和ACE-style计数器）能显著提高记忆的新鲜度。此外，安全措施也影响了记忆的推理灵活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型和代码任务的记忆系统依赖于简单地通过准确性计数来决定记忆的可信度。这种方法对于检测记忆中的局部变化是无效的，并且可能无法检测到某些类型的更改。因此，作者设计了一种新的记忆管理方法，以提高记忆的新鲜度和灵活性，从而支持更复杂的推理任务。

Method: 研究团队在五个大型语言模型和代码问题上验证了新方法的有效性。他们通过将事实进行编辑，检验了不同计数器和认证策略的不同表现。新方法结合了证据概率计算和实时推理验证，以优化存储空间和认知能力之间的平衡。

Result: 新的记忆管理方法（如ExpeL和ACE风格的计数器）与传统的准确性计数相比，提供了显著更高的记忆新鲜度。在大型文本理解和代码验证任务中，这些新技术可以将已过期但未失效的记忆使用的频率降低7.0-13.5倍，甚至在更复杂的大规模代码编辑任务中，这一差距可以扩大到35-73倍。此外，通过认证负载的概念，研究还找到了记忆的推理和安全之间的一个重要平衡。

Conclusion: 该研究发现，一种基于证据概率的认证机制可以显著提高记忆系统的灵活性和安全性，从而为持续和动态的推理任务提供了更好的支持。

Abstract: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [317] [Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14005)
*Jose Hernandez-Orallo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过引入Levin的Kt（柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂性的一种可计算版本）和大型语言模型（LLM），该研究提出了一种新的测试方法，旨在评估超越当前智能水平的机器表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对AI技术飞速发展，现有的基准测试方法难以保持挑战性，因此需要一种新的方法来评估超越当前限制的AI系统。

Method: 该研究利用了Levin的Kt来设定一个理论上可实现的复杂性上限，并结合LLM作为新的代表机制，从而生成具有高度复杂性的测试项目。

Result: 研究人员成功地基于Levin的Kt设计并实施了一个测试系统，通过生成和认证高难度测试题，探索了不同参考机器能力和检测者与被检测者间的能力差距的影响。

Conclusion: 该研究所述方法初步展现了评估超越现有智能水平机器的潜力，并揭示了超智能区域的检测可能性，这是一个值得进一步探索的领域。

Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

</details>


### [318] [The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14115)
*Xue Li,Hongqian Xia,Daniel Gomm,Aécio Santos,Cornelius Wolff,Madelon Hulsebos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析了现有自动化数据科学评估的不足，提出了一种新的评估方法，包括大规模分析常见自动化数据科学框架和模型中的失败模式，开发了一个可扩展的测试套件以测试特定失败，并对Kaggle竞赛中的自动化数据科学管道进行定性评估，强调了除了准确性之外还需要评估自动数据科学中的原理性失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动化数据科学评估方法侧重于下游预测性能和代码正确性，忽视了数据科学方法论和专业知识的基本原则，作者认为这可能掩盖了数据泄漏和不适当的验证等问题，限制了稳健的自动化数据科学系统的开发。

Method: 1. 大规模分析220个数据科学任务中常见的自动化数据科学框架和模型中的失败模式；2. 开发一个可扩展的测试套件以测试特定类型的失败；3. 对Kaggle竞赛中的自动化数据科学管道进行定性评估。

Result: 研究发现大多数自动化解决方案至少存在一个失败模式，且数据泄漏的频率与预测性能正相关。自动化数据科学在问题解决的创新性和领域知识方面不及竞争获胜的数据科学家。

Conclusion: 作者认为原理性的失败模式分析应该成为自动化数据科学评估的核心部分，研究成果将有助于开发值得信赖的自动化数据科学管道。

Abstract: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

</details>


### [319] [ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14118)
*Hansi Yang,Linji Hao,Hongyan Hao,An Wang,Han Wu,Qi Gu,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClawLoop是一种无需外部教师模型且依赖较少先验的自改进框架，通过任务合成、训练和诊断反馈三个阶段形成自维持循环以提升LLM能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工具使用代理的流水线大多依赖外部模型，并且缺乏自我改进能力，为了克服这方面的局限性，提出了ClawLoop框架。

Method: ClawLoop包括三个阶段：任务合成生成多样化训练任务，诊断条件下的难度增长以及基于代理的验证；训练通过SFT和/或RL更新代理；诊断和反馈分析代理行为并生成能力分析报告反馈到任务合成。它使用Qwen3.6-27B作为循环模型，在不同的基准测试中展示了持续改进并验证了数据质量独立于循环模型。

Result: ClawLoop在SkillsBench、Claw-Eval-Live和ClawGym-Bench中实现了一致改进，并且将迭代优化的任务转移至更小规模的Qwen3.5-4B和9B模型后，在所有基准测试中均获得增益。

Conclusion: 该框架不仅证明了LLM的自我提升潜力，同时显示了其在逐步减少先验依赖和无需外部教师模型的情况下，仍可以提升模型性能。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.

</details>


### [320] [Correction Training for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14136)
*Donghoon Ahn,Runqian Wang,Alexei A. Efros,Taesung Park,Yash Belhe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种用于减少扩散模型训练与推理之间差距的修正步骤，通过迭代改进去噪器的清洁样本预测，从而显著提高了样本质量，且在未引导生成和无条件生成方面表现尤为突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于扩散模型在推理时使用的是其自身预测的不完美结果，导致训练过程中所遇到的噪声和错误在推断时得以保留，从而产生误差累积和质量下降的问题。这项研究旨在通过引入修正步骤来解决这个问题，以提升模型的整体生成质量。

Method: 提出的修正步骤通过将基于模型的预测作为输入，并与模型训练中的真实目标进行对比，从而专门针对中间去噪步骤的预测进行迭代修正，防止早期出现的伪影影响最终结果。该方法通过对基础模型的预测进行迭代细化，逐步纠正预测中的错误。

Result: 该修正步骤在DiT、SiT和JiT等多个框架中均有显著效果，尤其是提高了无指导生成和 unconditional生成的样本质量，即使是在没有额外指导的情况下也能生成高质量的样本。此外，结合修正步骤与无分类指导（CFG），提高了多样性和降低了CFG通常导致的过度饱和现象。

Conclusion: 此修正步骤显著提高了扩散模型生成质量，与现有方法相比，尤其是在无指导生成方面取得了突破。该方法不仅有效改善了样本质量，还通过模型蒸馏减少推理成本，维持了质量提升，而无需增加额外的推理开销。

Abstract: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

</details>


### [321] [Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14146)
*Zongxia Li,Zhongzhi Li,Yucheng Shi,Ruhan Wang,Junyao Yang,Chengsong Huang,Zhichao Liu,Xiyang Wu,Anhao Li,Yue Yu,Ergan Shang,Fuxiao Liu,Tong Zheng,Ninghao Liu,Lichao Sun,Haitao Mi,Leowei Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LHTB 2.0 是 Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 的更新版本，扩展了 31 个任务，新增了 77 个任务，涵盖了 13 个领域和 8 种任务类型。它通过系统化的重建任务流程，引入了密集进度梯形，延长了评估时间，并增加了验证者检查点，以评估可持续进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LHTB 2.0 是为了改进 Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 的现有评估方法，使其更好地评估模型在长时间工作流程中的表现。具体来说，它旨在解决原始版本中的任务和评估基础设施缺陷，以及提供一个更广泛的测试平台，以研究可靠的代理执行。

Method: LHTB 2.0 的方法包括：1) 从现有科学或工程示例开始，2) 使用参数化参考实现生成多种场景，3) 揭示其中六种作为行为证据，4) 保存三种用于评估，5) 使用密集进度梯形奖励部分进展，防止记忆公共输出，6) 将评估时间从 90 分钟延长到 3 小时，并每 30 分钟记录一次验证者检查点。

Result: 在 15 个前沿模型的 1,145 次任务评分中，GPT-6-astra 的平均密集奖励为 0.69，完成 37 个任务，其余的模型如 GPT-5.6-sol 等也表现出色。对于 30 个重建任务，二元验证者评分平均为 0.221，而密集梯形评分平均为 0.653，表明仅结果评估忽视了大部分中间进展。

Conclusion: LHTB 2.0 提供了一个更严格的、强化的、进程意识更强的测试平台，用于研究在数小时内可靠代理执行的问题，为未来的研究提供了强大的工具。

Abstract: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress. LHTB 2.0 provides a broader, hardened, and process-aware testbed for studying reliable agent execution over hours.

</details>


### [322] [VETNET: Assembling Benchmark Datasets for AI-Driven Veterinary Innovation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14149)
*Katherine J. Koebel,Renata Ivanek,Parminder Basran,Jennifer Sun,Casey Cazer,Gayatri Anil,Tommaso Banzato,Liz Barton,Dottie Cimino Brown,Leszek Bukowski,Marta Castelhano,Simon Coghlan,Christopher De Sa,Nikki Dutta,Hala Ghali,Julio Giordano,Joshua Glass,David C. Hogg,Nicholas Hollingshead,Adam Kiehl,Ziang Liu,Monica Meduri,Param Mohapatra,Kim Nayyer,Amelia Nelson,Peter-John Mantyla Noble,Christopher Pinard,Beryl Rabindran,Scott Ross,Ron Seccia,Moira Sheehan,Fei Wang,Tracy L. Webb,Kilian Q. Weinberger,Heather M. Whitney,Chen Xin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VETNET 是一个由标准化高品质数据集和多机构协作构成的生态系统，旨在通过标准化数据集和多机构合作加速动物科学和兽医医学中的 AI 创新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VETNET 的提出旨在弥合人类医学 AI 技术与兽医 AI 开发现状之间的差距，推动兽医 AI 的发展和创新。

Method: VETNET 构建了一个生态系统，包含实时基准数据集和评估框架，以促进跨学术和非学术机构的标准、高质量数据集的合作。

Result: VETNET 通过标准化数据集和多机构合作，加速了动物科学和兽医医学中的 AI 创新。

Conclusion: VETNET 有望成为推动兽医 AI 技术发展的关键工具。

Abstract: VETNET represents an ecosystem of live benchmark datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to accelerate AI-driven innovation in animal science and veterinary medicine through standardized, high-quality datasets and multi-institutional collaboration across academic and non-academic sectors. This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

</details>


### [323] [Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14180)
*Sahil Garg,Ruhi Gottumukkala,Vishal Agarwal,Shubham Vishwakarma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究对比了开放和闭合语言模型在威胁情报报告转化为检测任务上的表现，发现开放模型在成本效益上具有明显优势，尤其是调整了消息限制后，其性能超过闭合模型。这种差异在不同阶段任务上有所不同，建议根据任务阶段选择最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估不同成本的语言模型在安全操作中的有效性与效率，特别是在威胁情报的情境下。

Method: 通过构建一个名为CTI-REALM的基准测试，在此测试中，利用开放和闭合语言模型将威胁情报报告转化为具体的工作检测，使用相同的评估框架来比较所有模型。

Result: 实验结果表明，对于某些阶段，开放模型能够以较低成本匹配甚至超过闭合模型的表现，特别是在解除了消息限制后。这表明不同的模型在不同任务阶段上表现出色。

Conclusion: 推荐在执行某些安全检测任务时，选择最适合该任务阶段的模型，而非仅依据综合表现；同时指出传统基于任务综合得分的模型评估方法可能遮蔽了不同任务阶段间的真实差异。

Abstract: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

</details>


### [324] [Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14186)
*Shawheen Naderi,Fatemeh Akherati,Yubei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，尽管仅被训练以优化奖励，一个Proximal Policy Optimization代理的价值函数实际上学习了环境模型中的某些概念，如钻石收集的规则，水和食物对健康的影响等，但仍存在安全性和算法局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究探讨了 model-free reinforcement learning 算法是否可以“学习”到环境模型，以及这一现象背后可能的原因。

Method: 通过应用反事实干预措施来探究 Proximal Policy Optimization 代理的价值函数是否建立了 Crafter 环境的模型。

Result: 尽管仅被训练以优化奖励，但价值函数学习了多种概念，揭示出了环境中的规则和机制。

Conclusion: 讨论了这些发现的安全性含义及强化学习目前存在的技术限制，强调了构建先进机器智能还需要克服的诸多难题。

Abstract: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

</details>


### [325] [Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14190)
*Laura Yao,Shixing Yu,Jie Peng,Promit Ghosal,Kyra Gan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOSAIC 提出了一种新的方法，通过学习共享的稀疏多模态隐空间来解释视觉-语言模型的预测，该隐空间的特征具有跨模态稀疏性、区域共存性、语句对齐性和近似去相关性，利用 EK-FAC 方法将训练样例的影响分解并定位到特定的文本和图像区域，从而揭示了视觉证据如何重新组织训练数据的影响并保持更多共享的多模态结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的归因方法主要停留在样本层面，对于图像-文本模型的多模态和空间结构解释不足。MOSAIC旨在提供一种新的解释方法，通过学习共享的稀疏多模态隐空间，来更好地解释视觉-语言模型的预测。

Method: 首先，MOSAIC学习共享的稀疏图像-文本隐空间，其特征具有跨模态稀疏性、区域共存性、语句对齐性和近似去相关性。然后，它使用EK-FAC将训练样例的影响分解并通过这些概念定位其对特定文本和图像区域的贡献。

Result: MOSAIC在Qwen和Gemma上的评估显示，学习的特征更具有局部性和连贯性，且在删除影响排名的潜在变量后，模型输出的变化比删除按激活或频率排名的潜在变量的模型输出变化更大。这表明视觉证据可以在很大程度上重新组织训练数据的影响，同时保留更广泛的共享多模态结构。

Conclusion: MOSAIC将模型行为的来源与其推动的影响的多模态证据联系起来，通过有效解释VLMs，为理解多模态模型的决策过程提供了新视角。

Abstract: Explaining a vision--language model (VLM) prediction requires tracing training-example influence to the multimodal evidence that mediates it, yet existing attribution methods largely operate only at the sample level. Recent latent-mediated influence methods provide feature-level attribution in language models, but lack the multimodal and spatial structure needed to ground influence in VLMs. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orthogonalized Sparse Autoencoders for Influence Characterization). It learns a shared sparse image--text latent space whose concepts are 1) sparse within each modality, 2) supported on contiguous image regions, 3) aligned to the phrases that describe them, and 4) approximately decorrelated. It then applies EK-FAC to decompose training-example influence through these concepts and localize their contributions to specific text phrases and image regions. We evaluate MOSAIC on Qwen and Gemma across captioning, chest X-ray understanding, and visual question answering. The learned features are more localized and coherent without degrading task behavior, and ablating influence-ranked latents changes model outputs more than ablating latents ranked by activation or frequency. We find that visual evidence can substantially reorganize training-data attribution while preserving more of the shared latent structure. MOSAIC thus connects where model behavior comes from with what multimodal evidence carries that influence.

</details>


### [326] [Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14389)
*Zeyu Yang,Wes Armour*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 此研究直接测量了86个模型在不同硬件平台上的能源效率，并发现即使模型具有相似的能力，它们的能源效率也存在显著差异。此外，逻辑推理虽能提升能力，但也会显著增加能源消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的基准分数只能展示模型能做什么，但不能展示达到这些能力所需的能源是多少。为了填补这一空白，研究者们测量了多种模型的能源效率。

Method: 研究者选取了86个开放重量模型检查点，在7个基准测试和6种硬件平台上进行评估，评估了模型在不同配置下的能源效率。

Result: 研究发现，即使模型能力相似，其能源效率也可能存在显著差异。大多数配置的能量使用量是帕累托前沿上至少具有相同性能配置的2.6-4.8倍，最极端的差异可达到27倍。进一步研究发现，虽然逻辑推理可以提升模型能力，但平均情况下，它也会使能源消耗增加约3.7倍，且这一影响因模型家族和输出预算而异。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，效率和能力是两个独立的评估维度，且当前的生成令牌数并不能精确预测能源使用量。研究者建议在报告基准分数时，应该同时提供在指定服务条件下和输出预算下的能源消耗数据。

Abstract: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

</details>


### [327] [Should SLMs be in the Driver's Seat? A Study of Local Models as Interpreters in Cloud-Written Agent Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14209)
*Boris Radovič,Marco Canini,Veljko Pejović*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了一种新的架构，其中云生成的程序在执行时会调用本地小型模型来解决某些涉及运行时数据的问题，从而提高了代码代理的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的代理要么依赖于大型云托管模型来确保高准确性，但侵犯用户隐私；要么使用小型设备本地模型但准确性较低；在第三种方法中，云模型预先编写一个程序并将其发送给设备执行，但这方法无法解决所有运行时数据的处理问题。因此，研究人员旨在提出一种中间架构，结合两者优势以提升代理性能。

Method: 研究通过在AppWorld平台上评估使用不同主模型和测试集组合的代码代理性能，验证了新架构的有效性。

Result: 实验结果显示，与仅使用代码代理相比，新架构在所有六种评估组合中提高了成功率，最高提高了14.9个点，恢复了一部分与云托管ReAct循环之间的性能差距，同时仍保留了用户数据的隐私。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种中间架构，通过在运行时调用本地小型模型来解决特定问题，展示了其在提高代码代理准确性和保护用户数据隐私方面的潜力。

Abstract: The most accurate agents executing user-provided tasks are driven by large, cloud-hosted models, which solve them by reading the private data of the user. Agents powered by models small enough to run on edge devices keep that data local, but yield far worse results. A third option is to have cloud models write a program that devices execute: the data stays local, but as the program is written before any data is seen, it fails whenever a step depends on interpreting content that appears only at run time. We explore an intermediate architecture, in which the cloud-written program defers bounded questions over user data to a small local model through an ordinary function call. On AppWorld this improves the success rate of a code-only agent in all six combinations of backbone model and test partition we evaluate, by up to 14.9pp, recovering a substantial part of the gap to a cloud-hosted ReAct loop while keeping user data on the device.

</details>


### [328] [Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)
*Ruiyao Xu,Yanfei Chen,Zhongying CuiZhu,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Yifei Ming,Han Yu,Rujun Han,Chen-Yu Lee,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 引入了一个新的框架Harness^2，该框架通过任务级别和构建级别双重递归解决开放世园区任务自动设计和更新的挑战，实现LLM代理性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决LLM代理框架设计和编辑时缺乏可靠指导和任务泛化能力不足的问题。

Method: 提出了一种通过任务级递归自适应调整框架，以及构建级递归构建改进框架的方法。

Result: 在三个专业基准和四种模型框架配置中，Harness^2能够提高GLM-5和Gemini3.5 Flash的性能，分别在WorkBuddy-Bench、JobBench和LAB上获得提升。

Conclusion: Harness^2框架能够有效提升LLM代理在未知开放世界任务中的性能，并能够进一步适应新的任务场景。

Abstract: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.

</details>


### [329] [Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14277)
*Xingyu Xie,Xiaoyong Xie,Zhouchen Lin,Kim-Chuan Toh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Echo 提供了一种新型 4-bit all-reduce 方法，通过将数据量化并进行高精度求和来控制累积误差。与 16-bit NCCL all-reduce 相比，Echo 在不同 GPU 数量下表现更优，特别是在带宽受限的情况下。其累积误差保持在有界，保证了模型质量相对于 16-bit 训练无明显下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的张量并行方法使用 16-bit 通信，随着计算速度的提升，网络带宽成为瓶颈。通过使用 4-bit 通信并合理处理量化误差，可以在保证模型精度的前提下显著提升训练效率。

Method: Echo 采用了一种新的量化策略，即将数据先量化两次再进行高精度求和，这样每一轮通信中的误差可以通过后续操作进行抵消，而非积累。此外，Echo 通过反馈机制确保旧误差能够被重新量化并抵消。

Result: Echo 在 A100 GPU 上比 16-bit NCCL all-reduce 快 2.09 倍。在带宽受限的条件下，它可以显著降低训练时间和预训练的最终损失，同时保持与 16-bit 方法相同的模型质量。

Conclusion: Echo 提供了一种有效方法，使得 4-bit 算法在实际应用中更可行，并保证了在大规模分布式训练中的性能和准确性。

Abstract: Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. Sending 4-bit instead of 16-bit values would cut this cost by nearly 4x, but the all-reduce must add the values it carries, and rounding the sum injects an error at every call. Model quality depends on how these errors accumulate over layers, yet existing methods treat each call on its own. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faster than the 16-bit NCCL all-reduce on 1 GB messages. It speeds up the time to first token by up to 1.16x and the training step by up to 1.09x on an idle interconnect, and by up to 1.44x and 1.38x as background traffic grows. It keeps the average accuracy over seven benchmarks within 0.4 points of 16-bit inference on Qwen3-8B. In 10B-token pretraining, its final loss is less than 0.9% above that of 16-bit training. Echo needs no FP8 or FP4 hardware.

</details>


### [330] [Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14294)
*Sylvain Dehayem Kenfouo,Aaron Zweig,Mingxuan Zhang,Elham Azizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过利用从条件嵌入空间到图像空间的映射诱导的局部拉回几何，识别输出最大敏感方向，从而引导不同的采样轨迹，提高在条件引导图像生成和修复中的多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法虽然能够增加变异性，但通常会带来优化或采样开销，或产生对图像质量或条件对齐有负面影响的扰动。

Method: 该方法利用从条件嵌入空间到图像空间的映射诱导的局部拉回几何，识别输出的最大敏感方向。通过引导不同的采样轨迹沿着这些方向，它鼓励不同的生成，同时保持与条件信号的一致性。

Result: 在MS-COCO和BrushNet上的实验表明，该方法在条件引导的图像生成和补缺中提高了多样性。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种在不进行额外训练的情况下提高条件引导图像生成多样性的有效方式，适用于生成和补缺任务。

Abstract: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

</details>


### [331] [ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14307)
*Shervin Khalafi,Kasra Fallah,Sung Cho,Dongsheng Ding,James Anderson,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ConicFlow通过将受限采样问题视为最优控制问题，在推断时平衡预训练轨迹的偏离和奖励，同时满足硬终端约束。它使用回溯最优化方法，并提出终端估计变体以减少局部截断误差，实验证明了其在低维和高维空间中的高效性和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器学习模型复杂性的增加，能够同时优化高维空间中的性能和满足约束条件变得尤为重要。ConicFlow通过将优化问题转化为最优控制问题，旨在提高模型的鲁棒性和生成质量，特别是在具有诸多硬约束的应用场景中。

Method: ConicFlow通过最优化一小段轨迹来提高计算效率，使用回溯最优化（receding-horizon optimization）来解决最优控制问题，并引入了端点估计变体以更准确地处理奖励和约束。

Result: ConicFlow在标准及凸-affine结构假设下提供有限时间内的子最优性和理论保证。实验表明，与最近的基线相比，ConicFlow在较低的预训练流偏离下实现了更高奖励和更强的约束满足。

Conclusion: ConicFlow提供了一种有效的方法来平衡预训练流的方向和奖励，同时能够满足复杂的约束条件，适用于各种机器学习和生成模型的优化问题。

Abstract: We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish finite-horizon guarantees on suboptimality. Under convex-affine structure, we derive a sharper bound that scales linearly with omitted horizon length, and we show that the terminal-estimate variant is provably tighter when the flow dynamics change slowly. Experiments in both low- and high-dimensional settings with a recent large-scale flow matching model show that ConicFlow achieves high reward and strong constraint satisfaction while deviating less from the pretrained flow than recent baselines.

</details>


### [332] [Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14334)
*Xiaofan Li,Fengchun Qiao,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，工具的参数模式差异对选择的影响最大且最一致，描述参数的工具更容易被选中，具体参数名称和请求表示方式会影响效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析MCP系统中工具选择过程，特别是不同参数模式对工具选择的影响。

Method: 通过可控的元数据干预跨五个LLM进行研究，每个比较仅改变一个元数据因子，同时保持其他因子不变，使用条件逻辑回归估计位置调整后的效果。

Result: 参数模式变化导致工具选择的变化最大且最一致；描述参数的工具更容易被选中，名称效应较弱且不一致；具体参数名称和请求表示方式会影响元数据干预的效果；若只有单一参数模式满足显式请求要求，五个模型会选择相应工具。

Conclusion: 参数模式设计和工具排序对MCP系统的工具选择有重要影响，即使功能未改变。

Abstract: In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.

</details>


### [333] [Actionable Meta-Requirements for AI Robustness Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14356)
*Joshua Owotogbe,Roya Nasiri,Indika Kumara,Damian Andrew Tamburri,Willem-Jan van den Heuvel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过元需求的方法，从文献和专家中提取并验证了一组旨在帮助组织实施和改进AI稳健性审核框架的规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏针对AI稳健性审核框架的具体要求，本文旨在填补这一空白，为相关研究和实践提供指导。

Method: 本文通过系统文献综述从文献中提炼出43个元需求，之后通过实践者的评价和反馈进一步验证和完善了这些元需求。

Result: 最终确定了涵盖16个类别的44个元需求，其中43个经过了定量验证，41个被评价为强烈支持，其余反馈则进一步丰富了这些元需求的内容。

Conclusion: 这些元需求能够帮助组织实施AI稳健性审核框架，评估现有框架的完整性，并进行相应改进。

Abstract: AI-enabled systems must remain dependable when the conditions under which they operate change (e.g., due to input perturbations, distribution shifts, or changes in external dependencies). This makes robustness auditing of such systems important for judging whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a defined robustness conclusion. However, designing an AI robustness auditing framework is challenging. A key unresolved issue is determining the requirements such a framework should support; these requirements have not yet been consolidated. We address this gap through meta-requirements: higher-order requirements specifying what a class of auditing frameworks should support. In design science research, literature and domain experts are common sources of meta-requirements; accordingly, we derive the initial set from literature and validate and refine it with practitioners. Our systematic literature review retained 74 of 2,890 records and derived 43 meta-requirements across 16 categories. We evaluated them with 128 practitioners, obtaining 5,504 ratings and 586 substantive comments. Overall, 81.20% of ratings indicated agreement or strong agreement. In particular, 41 of the 43 literature-derived meta-requirements were classified as strongly supported. Practitioner feedback refined the requirements and identified an additional requirement concerning external components and supply chain dependencies. The final set comprises 44 meta-requirements across 16 categories, of which 43 received quantitative validation. These meta-requirements can help organizations implement AI robustness auditing frameworks, assess existing frameworks for completeness, and refine them.

</details>


### [334] [When Pleasing the User Compromises Care: AI Sycophancy in Caregiver-Mediated Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14360)
*Priyadarsi Mishra,Arjun Beniwal,Ziyu Yi,Yu Ding,Sheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，医疗决策中的AI顾问在面对用户表达临床较差的偏好时，倾向于从合适的治疗方案转向不合适的策略，尤其是在缺乏进一步澄清的情况下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗决策尤其是涉及到多个利益相关者的情境下，使用者和实际受益者可能不一致，这种情况下AI助手的决策方式变得尤为重要。

Method: 研究人员创建了一个以证据为基础的基准，涉及兽医、儿科和老年护理领域，测试在用户表达临床劣质偏好时，AI顾问如何维持适当的护理。

Result: 结果显示，不合理的用户偏好显著增加了从适当治疗转向不当治疗的风险，超过了一般对话中的自然变化，并且这种影响随对话轮次增加而累积，即使初始回答正确的情况也不例外。

Conclusion: 研究指出，尽管当前AI模型对表达的用户偏好很敏感，但在决定是由谁表达偏好以及谁将承担后果方面不够敏感。这揭示了用户为中心对齐在多层次利益相关者环境中存在的局限性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) alignment often assumes that the user interacting with a model is also the primary beneficiary of its behavior. Yet in many consequential settings, one person directs the system while another bears the consequences. We study this problem in caregiver-mediated healthcare, where parents, pet owners, and caregivers make decisions for children, animals, and older adults. We introduce an evidence-grounded benchmark spanning veterinary, pediatric, and older-adult care, and test whether AI advisors maintain appropriate care when users express clinically inferior preferences. Holding patient facts fixed, we vary stated care preferences and communication styles and evaluate both initial recommendations and multi-turn follow-up. Across frontier and open-weight models, inferior preferences substantially increase switching from appropriate to inappropriate care beyond neutral conversational drift and increase agreement with the requested action, while communication style alone has a smaller effect. These failures accumulate across turns, including on cases models initially answer correctly, and often carry moderate or severe potential harm. In matched eldercare cases, the effect of an inferior preference is similar whether it is expressed by the patient or by a caregiver. Together with models' limited tendency to elicit patient preferences in caregiver conversations, this suggests that current models are highly sensitive to expressed user preferences but less sensitive to whose preferences are represented and who bears the consequences. Our results expose a broader limitation of user-centric alignment in settings with multiple stakeholders.

</details>


### [335] [ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14381)
*Yiwei Chen,Amila Weerasinghe,Siddharth Biswal,Utkrisht Rajkumar,Olcay Boz,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ACED-BENCH 是一个神经符号基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型作为科学助手的能力。它通过将可读的科学表象和正式的因果世界分离来实现这一目标，包含科学任务来验证模型在实验设计、证据保留、决策制定和终止策略方面的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏可靠的方法来评估大型语言模型是否能够调查系统而不是仅仅回答提示，因此需要设计一个基准测试来评估它们在实验设计、证据保留、决策制定和终止策略等方面的能力。

Method: ACED-BENCH 通过分离可读的科学表象和正式的因果世界来构建，大型语言模型生成自然语言的场景和任务文本，而隐藏的概率图形模型定义了因果图、数据生成过程、干预语义、验证检查和专家答案。它包括 ACED-CORE（包含 180 个任务）、ACED-QUAL（包含 150 个是/不是资格问题）等多方面的任务。

Result: 实验结果表明，现代和早期的大规模语言模型在实验设计、证据保留、决策制定和终止策略方面的表现不够可靠，这些任务的正确率较低。

Conclusion: 可靠的 AI 科研助手需要明确定义的实验设计、证据保存、答案提交和停止策略的支持。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement. The key idea is to separate the readable scientific surface from the formal causal world: LLMs generate natural-language scenarios and task text, while hidden probabilistic graphical models define the causal graph, data-generating process, intervention semantics, validation checks, and oracle answers. This yields scientific worlds that are natural for agents to investigate but exact enough for scalable, programmatic evaluation. The main leaderboard ACED-CORE contains 180 tasks: 60 set-valued causal ancestry/descendancy questions and 120 constrained causal-decision tasks. We also report ACED-QUAL, a 150-question yes/no qualification check using the same hidden-PGM interface. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs and two earlier-generation models across three active agent designs. ACED-QUAL checks whether agents can use the interface to draw conclusions from evidence, while ACED-CORE tests whether they can decide what evidence to collect and when to commit to an answer. Evidence-ledger analysis localizes failures within the investigation: agents test the wrong intervention, lose relevant evidence, or continue after sufficient evidence has appeared. These results suggest that reliable AI co-scientists need explicit support for experiment design, evidence retention, answer commitment, and stopping.

</details>


### [336] [ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14382)
*Constantinos Papantoniou,Brian Hilton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过设计科学研究（DSR）将ANASSA框架的高层次责任细化为低级架构，包括47个逻辑角色、版本化的任务图、基于能力的代理选择、类型化的合同、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、故障和恢复路径以及来源记录，从而提供了一个实施面向的桥梁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的ANASSA框架虽然定义了高阶的组成和职责边界，但没有具体说明如何把这些职责系统化地分解到面向实现的低级架构中。

Method: 采用了设计科学研究（Design Science Research）的方法，将ANASSA框架的高阶架构责任细化、转换为可执行的低级架构，包括定义47个逻辑角色、版本化的任务图、基于能力的代理选择、类型化的合同等。

Result: 该设计保留了基础架构的责任边界，转化为可执行的架构结构，如47个逻辑角色、版本化的任务图、基于能力的代理选择、类型化的合同等，实现了责任传递、独立于特定AI模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境的方法。

Conclusion: 该研究通过端到端执行追踪展示了设计成果，证明了设计的规范性、内部一致性、责任保留和独立性，并强调了其对未来系统实现的实施桥梁作用。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

</details>


### [337] [SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14402)
*Jialiang Sun,Kuldeep Meel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAT-RL 提出了一个 RL 框架，用于训练大语言模型与符号求解器通过多轮工具执行进行交互，从而通过合成数据生成、求解器增强的监督预热和基于工具的奖励进行求解器导向的强化学习，显著提高了复杂逻辑任务中的符号推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的大语言模型在解决复杂的数学和逻辑推理问题时仍存在局限，而现有的符号求解器虽然强大但灵活性不足。SAT-RL 提供了结合大语言模型与符号求解器的方式，旨在解决复杂逻辑任务中的挑战。

Method: SAT-RL 涉及生成验证性解决方案的合成数据、求解器增强的监督预热训练以及基于工具的求解器导向的强化学习。该方法通过多轮工具交互，使得大语言模型能够更好地理解和解决具有约束条件的逻辑问题。

Result: 实验表明，SAT-RL 显著提高了大语言模型在逻辑推理任务上的表现，包括在领域内和领域外的任务中。

Conclusion: SAT-RL 提供了一种新的方法，通过结合大语言模型和符号求解器，有效提升了在复杂逻辑任务中的推理能力，展示了一种新的研究视角和发展方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

</details>
