### [338] [Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14428)
*Istok Bako,Bonan Min,Tiffany Shao,Claire Cheng,Yashar Mehdad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了一种简单的替代方案，使用自然语言指令、轻量级工具和富含LLM生成的导航层的语料库来构建企业工作流自动化。这种方法在客户服务解决流程生成中表现出色，但在吞吐量方面较慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在客户支持场景中，员工需要准确了解政策文档以确定正确的解决步骤。传统的复杂文档处理机制要求大量的工程投入。因此，研究者提出了一种简单实现的小技能，旨在降低复杂性、提高便携性，并在满足需求的情况下保持高准确性。

Method: 本研究采用了基于代理的检索-生成架构（RAG），利用了来自LLM的生成式导航层，构建了一个轻量级工具集，包括检索API和格式检查脚本。这种架构通过文本和数据的编辑而非模型再训练进行维护。

Result: 该方法在客户服务解决流程生成任务上表现出高度的程序准确性和证据充分性，精确度达到人类专家批准的99.2%，并且在证据充足性方面达到了83.3%。然而，它在吞吐量方面较慢，比部署的生产助手慢一个数量级。

Conclusion: 尽管该方法运行速度较慢，但在成熟的、内容经过精心整理的语料库中，对于延迟容忍的工作流和需要逐案审查的环境中，这种方法非常适合，因为它减少了模型训练需求，将维护工作集中于文本和数据编辑，简化了需求理解过程。

Abstract: Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. There, the skill did the work of a complex RAG stack, and maintenance became a matter of editing text and data rather than retraining models.

</details>


### [339] [AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14487)
*Zhuoxuan Zhang,Jinhao Duan,Xinyu Zhao,Jinduo Guo,Shuai Shao,Rui Li,Luke Simon,Zhun Deng,Tianlong Chen,Bo Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现基于自回归解码的生成推荐模型在面对有目标的恶意注入攻击时非常脆弱。通过分析恶意交互的合成机制，提出了一种名为AlignPoison的框架，能够在不直接访问模型参数的情况下发现并利用对推荐系统有有利影响的前缀。实验结果显示该框架能显著提高恶意目标的推荐概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统大多依赖于排名方法，在应对数据篡改攻击时存在不足，而生成模型由于其灵活性在对抗恶意注入攻击方面仍是一个未被充分研究的领域。本文旨在揭示针对生成推荐模型的条件针对性恶意注入攻击的脆弱性，并提出相应的防御方法。

Method: 研究通过设计实验，使用对抗样本模拟攻击场景，并具体分析了生成推荐模型在面对恶意输入时的反应机制。进一步提出了一个名为AlignPoison的框架，该框架能够从API输出中发现具针对性的数据特征来放大推荐效果。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的AlignPoison框架能有效提升恶意目标的推荐概率，相较于其他方法，最高可提升16.3个百分点，展示了生成推荐模型在解码和上下文敏感方面的中毒脆弱性。

Conclusion: 本文讨论了生成推荐模型在面对条件针对性的恶意注入攻击时的脆弱性问题，并提出了相应的对抗方法，为未来推荐系统的安全性研究提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Results show that these prefixes outperform competitive baselines, improving ASR lift by up to 16.3 percentage points and highlighting a decoding-dependent, context-sensitive poisoning vulnerability in generative recommendation models.

</details>


### [340] [HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14489)
*Jiaqi Wang,Wei Chen,Xiaoyu Li,Lexian Xia,ShuaiLong Tang,Chenran Zhang,Donglin Xie,Guangpu Zhu,Yelei Li,Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HiPPT 提出了一种生理学导向的框架，通过将不同监督来源与适当的证据范围匹配，成功地在多种下游任务中提高了可穿戴PPG数据的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的预训练目标通常在录制或配对级别应用监督，未能充分利用不同概念在不同波形证据范围内变得可靠的特点。HiPPT 理论上解决了这一问题，构建了一个包含400多万记录和文本描述的PPG-Text语料库。

Method: HiPPT 采用了一种结合录音级别形态对齐和跨录音上下文对齐的方法，同时利用波形指导的文本建模从PPG片段表示中恢复出隐藏的上下文概念，提供精细的波形-文本监督。

Result: 在六个下游任务中，包括血压、血管弹性、生理属性和跨数据集心率估计，HiPPT 在主要线性探测指标上取得了最佳结果。此外，对齐的空间支持年龄组、性别和BMI类别的零射击画像，表现随聚合记录的增加而改善。

Conclusion: 总体而言，HiPPT 的研究结果表明，证据范围匹配可以产生可迁移且语义上可访问的可穿戴PPG表示。

Abstract: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

</details>


### [341] [Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14495)
*Wei Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Reels-RSI，这是一个开放源代码的录像导演工具，适用于任何代理框架。其改进发生在程序级别而非权重或提示中。工具通过编码快照记录每次修订，通过静态检查总结经验教训，确保修复的规则能够通过测试案例。该工具通过盲判断对外判内容进行过滤，确保新规则仅在表现优于之前规则时才会采纳。研究结果显示，在规则学习过程中，新规则能够发现之前不存在的问题，但在新规则适用后，此类问题不再出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释者视频通常作为像素视频生成的目标，但本文将解释者视频视为一种程序，即通过编排脚本、故事板和每一帧动画代码来生成视频的执行程序。程序可以被阅读、比较、测试和审计，而像素视频只能被观看。Reels-RSI旨在通过程序层面提高自改进性与透明度，以解决现有文本生成方法在审计和修复时的局限性。

Method: 文章首先展示了Reels-RSI的工作流程，强调每次修订都会记录代码快照，通过编译检查将静态检查规则编译为可执行的规范，并在实践中应用这些规范来验证新规则的有效性。该方法结合了盲判断和人类决策，确保规则的高质量采纳。此外，研究包含了多个层面的实验，包括导演的流程改进、记忆删除测试、不同导演能力的比较以及裁判者可靠性研究。

Result: 研究表明，通过Reels-RSI学习的新规则能发现之前作者之前不存在的缺陷，且发现这些缺陷的规则能够确保更强的导演不出现故障，并在较弱的导演中仅出现少量错误。同时，经验和教训缩短了修订循环，尽管无法累积，但对裁判者没有显著影响。此外，研究还描述了偏好信号的四种失败模式，检测方法和修复之道。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入Reels-RSI，展示了利用程序自改进提升视频生成质量的方法，该方法强调开放性与透明性，通过编码快照、静态检查和人类决策确保新规则的有效性，并通过多个实验验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

</details>


### [342] [MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14507)
*Sudarshan Regmi,Nabaraj Subedi,Arvind Pillai,Yu Yvonne Wu,Yuliang Chen,Michael V. Heinz,Lisa Marsch,Nicholas C. Jacobson,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为MontageFlow的模型，通过强制输出满足精确线性身份，确保生成的脑电图数据的有效性，同时结合生理状态向量条件，提高了数据的 fidelity，尤其是在TS-FID指标上显著优于其他模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在受严格隐私保护的临床环境中，脑电图（EEG）数据非常稀缺且标签不足。传统的生成模型虽然在生成保真度上取得了显著进步，但忽视了EEG信号必须遵循的精确线性身份，导致生成的数据不准确。因此，该研究提出了MontageFlow模型，旨在解决这一问题。

Method: MontageFlow通过限制生成的信号来满足精确线性身份，确保生成的EEG数据有效。同时，还结合了基于整个EEG窗口编码的生理状态向量作为条件，以保持数据的真实特征。生成过程使用先验在潜在空间中抽取生理状态向量。

Result: 在三项大规模基准测试中，MontageFlow模型在TS-FID指标上分别提高了1.6-3.6倍的保真度，同时确保了生成数据的有效性。

Conclusion: MontageFlow模型通过确保生成EEG数据的有效性和特征准确性，显著提高了生成保真度，表明该模型在隐私保护临床环境中生成高质量EEG数据方面具有重要的应用价值。

Abstract: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

</details>


### [343] [ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14523)
*Lingsen You,Yujun Guo,Xinyu Zhong,Zijie Feng,Wentong Wang,Li Shen,Junbo Ge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ScienceBuddy-PV 采用结构化的证据记录、设备-血管本体词汇表等方法，通过递归优化和外循环模型学习来增强泛血管介入研究，但未执行实际操作。该研究在固定组件上进行了审计，使用了特定的语法和狭窄任务，显示出一定的性能指标，但未达临床设备推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着泛血管介入研究的重要性日益增加，需要一种更结构化、系统化的研究平台来组织和分析相关的临床证据和设备数据，以加速该领域的研究进程。

Method: 科学勇士-PV通过引入结构化证据记录、设备-血管本体词汇表、不执行协议和保留失败库的方法，采用递归优化和外循环模型学习技术，尤其是强化学习。研究过程中，使用了特定的语法和狭窄任务进行审计。

Result: 该研究在狭窄任务上训练了一个共享的任务屏蔽卷积模型，并达到了语法Dice 0.475，狭窄Dice 0.231，狭窄像素AUROC 0.957和AUPRC 0.180。通过接受和拒绝狭窄帧输出，支持和不执行策略被明确量化，并提供了未来协作代理研究的可复制协议。

Conclusion: 科学勇士-PV的研究为泛血管介入研究提供了一种新的分析方法，但仍需进一步验证其在实际应用中的有效性，以及是否能提供有效的临床设备推荐。

Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

</details>


### [344] [Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14525)
*Tianle Liu,Fan Lyu,Tingliang Feng,Chenggong Ni,Tianqi Wang,Zhang Zhang,Fuyuan Hu,Rui Yao,Tao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Energy Ring的方法，通过将已知和未知类锚定在两个不同的能量环上，稳定它们之间的能量差距，从而改善了部署后的持续学习问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的测试时发现（TTD）方法过于保守，导致已知和未知特征在测试时难以区分。

Method: 作者从能量角度重新审视了TTD问题，提出了一种名为Energy Ring的方法，通过一个轻量级适配器和一个扰动一致性模块来稳定已知和未知类之间的能量差距。

Result: 实验结果表明，Energy Ring方法在TTD任务上显著优于现有的TTD方法。

Conclusion: Energy Ring方法通过引入能量环机制，有效地解决了已知和未知类的区分问题，从而提高了部署后的持续学习性能。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

</details>


### [345] [FDE-Bench: Evaluating End-to-End Delivery from Underspecified Real-World Business Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14539)
*Huaiming Li,Can Huang,Chufan Wu,Danyu Liu,Xiaomin Yuan,Qinze Li,Yui Lo,Wenhui Bai,Qianlong Wang,Zengle Ge,Xiyu Yan,Yuheng Cheng,Jinhui Ren,Guokai Chen,Jiaqun Liu,Haoran Li,Qianhui Liu,Annan Li,Jianmin Wu,Dawei Yin,Dou Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FDE-Bench 是一个基于真实客户项目的基准，评估代理在包含交互式需求澄清和迭代优化的端到端交付任务中的表现。该基准涵盖了组合优化和机器学习场景，显示了当前方法在处理未充分说明的实际业务任务时的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化基准通常依赖明确的目标设定，而FDE-Bench旨在填补这一空白，专注于实际业务场景中未明确说明的需求澄清任务。它通过模拟真实世界中的工程师和前线人员互动，为发展能够有效沟通并解决实际问题的智能代理提供了新的挑战。

Method: FDE-Bench 通过挖掘从真实客户项目中获得的实际案例数据，构建了一套包括49个案例的任务集合。每个案例都包含多轮的交互式需求澄清过程，最终生成的解决方案会通过特定评估者进行评估，以确定是否满足客户接受的标准。这种方法不仅考验了代理的决策能力，还强调了沟通和迭代优化的重要性。

Result: 在FDE-Bench上的测试中，不同配置下的代理得分均值仅为0.5510，且仅6.12%的计划运行能够达到FDE参考值1.0。这一结果表明，当前智能代理在处理未充分解释的实际业务需求时仍然存在较大挑战。

Conclusion: 尽管FDE-Bench提供了一个有价值的框架来评估代理在复杂、实际业务任务中的表现，但它也揭示了现有技术尚未解决的重要问题。进一步的研究可能需要探索新的方法来增强代理的沟通能力以及优化迭代流程。

Abstract: Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

</details>


### [346] [Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14542)
*Shiqi Zhang,Weixin Zeng,Ziheng Zhang,Jiuyang Tang,Xiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SRCoD 是一种结构-响应共同校准诊断框架，用于多模态基准上的项目级诊断，能够细化基准分析并提供可解释的诊断结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基准评估方法往往依赖于项目的内在结构或模型的外在响应行为，但这些方法不足以全面诊断多模态基准的项目依赖性，因此需要提出SRCoD框架，来解决这一问题。

Method: SRCoD通过从基准内容和目标答案估计样本级的多模态信息结构，并使用此信号作为模态条件项目的软结构基准，用于模态条件项目响应建模。这种方法能生成一种校准了的项目级诊断概貌，反映项目对不同形式的模态证据的依赖强度。

Result: SRCoD在两个互补的实验协议下，即基准优化导向验证和人工标注项目验证中，显示出超过现有最佳基准诊断方法的效果。

Conclusion: SRCoD框架能够在多模态基准项目依赖性诊断中提供更加精细和可解释的分析，有助于提高基准的评估和标准。

Abstract: Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

</details>


### [347] [PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14570)
*Wenji Zhang,Xilong Cheng,Yunxiao Qin,Mai Tu,Tongye Zhu,Yuhao Zhou,JingBo Ji,Yuting Tan,Duoyin Li,Hongjiang Xiao,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PsyMemBehav 使用心理启发的用户配置文件和检索的记忆，通过两级身份到行动的推理来模拟社交媒体用户的行为，构建了一个包含5.57M交互的数据集，这些交互来自5,862名真实用户，每个交互都被建模为目标选择后紧接着评论、点赞或转发，并可选地生成响应。PsyMemBehav 在个体水平上的多项指标中表现最佳，优于GPT-5.4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的大语言模型需要在真实用户行为建模中更准确地重现真实的用户互动，以支持社会模拟。PsyMemBehav 的目的是提供一种方法，通过合理的用户配置文件和记忆检索来支持这种更高层次的真实行为模拟。

Method: PsyMemBehav 涉及心理启发的用户配置文件和检索的记忆，通过两级身份到行动的推理。该方法使用41维用户描述符、BM25记忆的前5个版本，并受到逆COT监督和基于评分计划的DPO指导。所有推理-行动轨迹都被全面地建模。

Result: 与GPT-5.4 相比，PsyMemBehav 在12项个体指标中的11项中取得了第一名。它提高了平均响应质量，从54.28提升到59.68，并且获得了所有模拟系统中最低的小组级别MAE（0.081）和MSE（0.009）。

Conclusion: 结果支持基于证据的用户建模对于实际线程的延续。然而，PsyMemBehav 基于记录的互动，而不考虑无行为决策的模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. Experiments show that PsyMemBehav 27B ranks first in 11 of 12 reported individual-level metrics, improving average response quality over GPT-5.4 from 54.28 to 59.68 (9.95% relative), and obtains the lowest group-level MAE (0.081) and MSE (0.009) among simulated systems. These results support evidence-grounded user modeling for observed-thread continuation; the benchmark remains conditional on recorded engagement and does not model no-action decisions.

</details>


### [348] [Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14573)
*Yufeng Tian,Jiahao Tang,Minghao Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 执行后学习的方法利用执行结果作为中间状态进行额外的学习交互，提高策略的表现并产生纠正能力，而不依赖于持续的一阶段训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前学习方法主要依赖于终端反馈，本文提出执行后学习以优化这一过程，通过利用执行结果提供额外的学习交互，增进策略的表现。

Method: 采用了Image-to-TikZ作为可执行的视觉测试平台，通过比较学习后执行和继续单阶段训练的结果来验证方法的有效性。

Result: 学习后执行方法在单次渲染成功率上比继续单阶段训练的GRPO提高了4.45%，并且生成了依赖中间状态的纠正能力。

Conclusion: 研究展示了可执行任务中除了终端奖励之外还包含有价值的学习结构，且开发的代码可供其他研究使用。

Abstract: Execution is often used as terminal feedback: it scores a generated program, but the resulting state is not used for another learning action. Learning after execution instead uses the execution result as an intermediate state that supports an additional learning interaction for the same policy. This creates a credit-assignment problem because the two actions share the same final objective but play different roles in the trajectory. Accordingly, action-specific credit assigns the initial action credit from the final trajectory outcome and the corrective action credit for improvement over the intermediate state. Image-to-TikZ serves as an executable visual testbed for this setting. On 945 held-out examples, learning after execution strengthens the shared policy under single-call inference and also produces a post-execution corrective capability. Single-call render success reaches 92.70\%, compared with 88.25\% for continued single-stage GRPO after the same number of additional training iterations. This corrective capability is not reproduced by continued single-stage training and depends on the intermediate state. Alternative credit definitions also induce different group-relative preferences over the same trajectories. Together, these results suggest that executable tasks contain useful learning structure beyond a terminal reward. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyufengcn/Learning-after-Execution.

</details>


### [349] [CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14574)
*Qingyue Zhang,Huaze Tang,Minyu Zhang,Yuxiang Yan,Wenbo Ding,Shao-Lun Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的在上下文学习（ICL）技术，称为CB-Agent，能够提取专家决策并生成可复用的评分规则，该规则用于顺序动作选择，从而在TextWorld、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld等多个基准测试上实现了最高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于ICL的技术在处理新情况时存在直接输入全部轨迹会使用完所有提示空间和制约了整体效果，以及使用自然语言总结要求代理将一般指导转化为具体行动选择的问题。因此，研究人员探索了一个新的方法，利用专家的行动选择直接监督一个可复用的评分规则，以解决这些挑战。

Method: CB-Agent通过从专家的轨迹中提取环境-动作决策，并使用最大似然法拟合概念向量以表示给定上下文下候选动作的条件分布。此模型结合了概念与冻结的语言模型特征和先验。在交互中，代理利用该分布进行动作选择，而不将演示包括在动作评分上下文中。

Result: CB-Agent在TextWorld、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld等多个基准测试上实现了最高的跨基准平均性能，在所有测试的模型尺寸下都排名第一，并且ALFWorld实验表明学习到的概念对于提升性能具有贡献。

Conclusion: CB-Agent的研究表明，通过提取专家行为决策来直接监管可复用评分规则的方法有效，能够显著提高代理在新情况下的学习效果。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models to use demonstrations without updating their parameters. For interactive agents, demonstrations are trajectories of reasoning, actions, and observations that illustrate how to complete a task. Reusing demonstrations in new situations is challenging: directly inputting full trajectories consumes limited prompt space and constrains the overall effectiveness, while natural-language summaries require the agent to translate general guidance into specific action choices. Therefore, we study whether expert action choices can directly supervise a reusable scoring rule. We propose CB-Agent, which extends concept-based ICL to sequential action selection. We extract environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fit a concept vector by maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions given the context. This model combines the concept with frozen language-model features and priors. During ReAct interaction, the agent uses this distribution to select environment actions without including demonstrations in the action-scoring context. Across TextWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld, CB-Agent achieves the highest cross-benchmark average among the evaluated methods at all three tested model sizes and ranks first on TextWorld and ScienceWorld at each size. ALFWorld experiments support the learned concept's contribution beyond prior-only scoring and show further gains when combined with Reflexion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CB-Agent-DFF9/.

</details>


### [350] [Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14576)
*Keegan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种使用大模型开发所需行为，然后通过监督微调将生产行为提炼到小型语言模型中的方法，通过案例证明该方法能够快速构建、实时反馈和经济高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着先进语言模型的不断发展，运行成本日益增加。小模型虽然成本较低，但在实现特定行为方面存在局限。本文通过结合大模型的即时反馈能力和小模型的成本效益优势，提出了一种新的开发和部署方法。

Method: 首先在先进模型中开发所需行为，利用实时反馈；然后将实际生产中的行为通过监督微调提炼到小模型中。

Result: 在家庭护理代理的案例中，使用LoRA-调优后的Qwen3-8B模型，通过监督微调获得了高达0.913的一致性，相较于教师模型自我一致性仅72.7%，一致性提高显著。此外，小模型的中位延迟降低了约2.5倍，成本也有了极大降低。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法为其他类似系统提供了快速开发、实时反馈和成本效益较高的蓝图。

Abstract: As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.

</details>


### [351] [Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14605)
*Haodong Chen,Shengtao Wen,Dong Liang,Lingbing Guo,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种称为FASD的方法，旨在克服当前多模态去学习方法的两个关键限制：知识抑制技术引发的虚构现象以及拒绝训练仅改变表面行为而不消除潜在知识。该方法通过两个互补通道实现真诚的无知状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多模态去学习方法仅关注模型是否停止输出目标信息，但未能解决知识抑制技术引发的虚构现象及拒绝训练仅改变表面行为而不消除潜在知识的问题。

Method: FASD方法分为行为和知识两个通道，行为通道从由知识提示生成的模型副本中提取适当的拒绝行为，防止目标标记影响教师分布，从而避免重新教授忘记的概念；知识通道则独立地抑制正确答案区间，进一步避免信息泄露。

Result: 实验表明，FASD能够成功地去学习目标知识，防止在开放式任务中出现信息泄露，并在保留数据集上保持性能。

Conclusion: FASD方法不仅使模型忘记了指定的信息，还能准确识别自身知识的边界。

Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [352] [From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14625)
*Leijun Zhou,Yanke Yu,Zhihao Liu,Qu Xiang,Tiancheng Hu,Yiru Dong,Yihan Wu,Yangxi Xiang,Xuejun Wu,Xi Chen,Buyue Qian,Yaowei Zheng,Junhao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从统一分类和传统深度学习借鉴两个角度探讨了递归自我改进（RSI）的方法，提供了一种九个设计维度的分类框架，并回顾了评估自我改进的标准，旨在激发新的RSI研究想法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在从统一的视角、借鉴传统深度学习方法等角度深入探讨递归自我改进的方法，帮助研究人员生成新的研究想法。

Method: 本文提出了一个九个设计维度的统一分类框架，用于放置现有的RSI方法，并探讨了这些方法如何借鉴如优化、正则化、数据增强、持续学习等传统深度学习技术。

Result: 本文为RSI领域提供了一种新的视角，并回顾了评估自我改进的标准。此外，作者还提供了RSI方法和资源的汇总，方便研究人员参考。

Conclusion: 本文通过提供一个统一的分类框架和多角度的见解，帮助研究人员获得新的RSI研究想法，并从不同维度和学习机制中汲取灵感。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. RSI papers and resources are available at https://prism-shadow.github.io/awesome-rsi/.

</details>


### [353] [PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14636)
*Jie Yang,Mianqiu Huang,Yiwei Zhao,Bo Wang,Yang Liu,Yuxin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEARL 提出了一种改进局部奖励归属的方法，无需额外的评论家，通过历史轨迹的分歧构建特征表示，并利用这些模式记忆有选择地增强较低奖励决策的负面优势，从而在 AppWorld 和 ALFWorld 上优于 ARPO 等基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步骤智能体在没有步骤级注释的情况下难以训练，尽管组相对优势不能指导中间决定的调整。失败的轨迹中仍包含合理的动作，不利的决策模式可能会反复出现。因此，需要一种方法来改进局部奖励归属。

Method: PEARL 通过比较两个具有不同结果的历史轨迹的延续来定位第一个分歧，构建每个分支的局部决策特征表示，并在最近的失败和成功记忆中进行聚类，以识别重复的局部模式。然后，使用这种模式记忆，有选择地增强较低奖励决策的负面优势。

Result: 在 AppWorld 上，PEARL 在 Normal 和 Challenge 任务中，无论是 4B 还是 8B 规模上都优于 ARPO。在 ALFWorld 上，它在 4B 规模下达到 97.9% 的平均成功率，并比最强基准高 2.7 分，在 8B 规模上仍然具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 实验表明，在构建模式记忆和选择性强化较低奖励决策的负面优势方面，PEARL 是有价值的。消融实验验证了行为塑造位置、成功银行过滤和记忆窗口的价值。

Abstract: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.

</details>


### [354] [AegisVox: Factorized Privacy and Clinical Preservation for Long-Form Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14643)
*Praphul Singh,Akshat Agarwal,Ratul Ghosh,Aashna Kanuga,Devashish Khatwani,Anurag Dwarakanath,Sri Gadde,Krishnaram Kenthapadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AegisVox是一种框架，它通过使用一致的替代声音并编辑包含标识符的对话部分来保护临床语音，即使是在实现替代表述方面略显不足时，也能保持临床信息和对话者联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语音不仅包含语音识别信息，还包括停顿、传达方式和角色等细节，这些都是有价值的临床证据，因此需要提供更全面的保护措施。

Method: AegisVox框架采用了一种因素分解的方法，为一致的替代声音分配并编辑包含标识符的对话部分，利用文档一致性的替换进行操作。

Result: 在390个公开的模拟或非患者对话总时长为63.6小时中，与基于编码器的语音编辑器相比，文本转语音渲染实现了535/601计划的替代，而基于编码器的编辑器实现了453/601；尽管总体上临床信息和对话者联系的保护相似，但对模型标签的矛盾更多，且整体评分也掩盖了更差的对话者联系。

Conclusion: AegisVox支持针对特定用途的评估，以权衡替代表达与临床信息保留和对话者联系之间可能出现的权衡关系，但并不能保证标识符的完全去除或绝对的安全。

Abstract: Clinical speech reveals identity through both spoken identifiers and voice, yet its pauses, delivery, and speaker roles can also carry useful clinical evidence. Protecting that speech therefore requires more than preserving its words. We present AegisVox, a factorized framework that assigns consistent surrogate voices and edits identifier-bearing turns using document-consistent replacements. Across 390 public simulated or non-patient conversations totaling 63.6 hours, a matched comparison of two speech renderers separates replacement realization from retained identifiers, speaker linkage, and clinical preservation. Text-to-speech rendering realizes 535/601 planned replacements versus 453/601 for the codec-based speech editor. However, similar aggregate clinical preservation conceals more model-labeled contradictions, and conversation-wide speaker scores conceal greater edited-speech linkage under a score-direction sensitivity analysis. Fresh transcription of original audio provides a reference for interpreting the clinical measurement chain; an independent judge tests sensitivity to model-based assessment. Better replacement realization can therefore coexist with worse clinical or speaker-linkage measurements. AegisVox supports use-specific evaluation of those tradeoffs, not a guarantee of identifier removal or clinical safety.

</details>


### [355] [Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14644)
*Yaoxiang Wang,Kai Zhang,Ruobing Xie,Lanrui Wang,Guoliang Zhao,Junhui Li,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LatentMoE通过将专家计算转移到低维空间，使输入维度和中间宽度成为显式设计选择。研究显示平衡这两个维度可以最大化固定每个专家参数下的秩上限。此外，使用逐层内在维度指导容量分配，实现了更低的验证损失和更强的下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的MoE模型通常通过缩小专家数量来增加总体专家数量，隐式地决定了专家形状。LatentMoE模型尝试将专家计算转移到低维空间，使输入维度和中间宽度成为设计者可直接调整的参数，从而增强模型设计的灵活性。

Method: 该研究通过理论分析展示了专家局部雅可比秩与输入维度和中间宽度之间的关系，并在模型和路由粒度上进行控制形状扫面，同时利用逐层内在维度指导层间专家数量和形状的调整。

Result: 研究表明，平衡输入维度和中间宽度可以最大化秩上限，而控制形状扫面结果显示接近正方形的专家在各模型规模和路由粒度下表现最佳。基于逐层内在维度的专家分配方法，验证损失更低，下游任务表现更强。

Conclusion: 研究证明了专家形状和逐层容量分配作为有效MoE设计参数的重要性，并提供了实际的设计指导建议。

Abstract: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

</details>


### [356] [RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14659)
*Daijin Hu,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RASSG 提出了一种方法，在流式语音助手中联合控制工具的启动和取消，以减少无效执行。实验表明，它能有效降低无效执行率，即使在不受控制的环境中也优于其他基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统在用户尚未完成说话时就开始执行工具，这可能导致后续的自我纠正无效，产生不可撤销的错误执行。因此，提出 RASSG 来在流式语音助手中同时控制工具的启动和取消，以减少这种错误执行。

Method: RASSG 在收到连续三次结果且非空参数相同后启动工具，然后结合论证无效的风险修正评估和执行成本来决定在不可撤销影响发生前的最后一次可能取消时间。

Result: 在 ReCAST, FDB-v3 和 Audio2Tool 上的实验显示，相对于 LocalAgreement-2，RASSG 的无效执行率减少了 94.15%，平均延迟仅为 3.676s。另外，即使在公共语音数据集上不受控制的环境中，RASSG 的表现也优于所有早期启动的基线。

Conclusion: RASSG 通过减少错误的执行实例并通过在不影响最终效果的前提下取消工具执行，确保了流式语音助手的稳定性和准确性。

Abstract: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

</details>


### [357] [A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14680)
*Pushp Garg,Himangshu Sarma,Mrinmoy Ghorai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构感知的混合框架，用于高效地识别印度手语的轴向形式。该框架通过使用熵驱动的SVD采样器动态提取关键帧来减少计算冗余，并利用连续双位置编码和距离感知弹性变换保持自然的手语节奏。为验证框架，创建了一个包含9,453个视频的120类ISL数据集。采用物理节点下采样和ArcFace优化措施，该框架达到了89.8%的准确率，为复杂手语建模奠定了基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISL难度在于其双手动特性及大词汇量标注的稀缺，标准模型难以处理不规则的手语速度。因此，需要一种有效的ISL识别框架来提高识别精度并减少计算冗余。

Method: 使用熵驱动的SVD采样器来动态提取关键帧，以减少计算冗余。通过连续双位置编码和距离感知弹性变换来保持自然的手语节奏。此外，还采用了一种统一体节特征的体动条件自适应GCN来显式地建模双手动形状。

Result: 提出的框架在120类ISL数据集上达到了89.8%的准确率，并通过物理节点下采样和ArcFace优化措施提高了性能。

Conclusion: 该研究为复杂手语建模建立了一个强大的基准，并为ISL识别提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

</details>


### [358] [AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14693)
*Nan Wu,Yee Hung Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ACROSSVAM2.0引入了一系列设计来解决视频生成中的显式对应问题，通过实验表明，冲突感知的适应能够提高对应一致性和跟踪效果，但对感知质量的影响有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频生成模型依赖于大型预训练模型的学习，但可能忽略显式的点对应信息。ACROSSVAM2.0旨在通过引入透明追踪和可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和不对称PCGrad来保护主要更新，以更好地处理这一矛盾。

Method: ACROSSVAM2.0结合了信心加权追踪和可见性头，零初始化残差反馈和不对称PCGrad，这些方法在共享LoRA参数的辅助组件上排除了与主要流动匹配梯度相反的成分。这种方法能够在初始化时精确地保持生成器，并保护其主要更新。

Result: 四组消融实验结果显示，ACROSSVAM2.0在三个种子下的KLT前向后方循环误差均低于对照组，并且整体保持锐利。在24张提示的216个视频评估中，ACROSSVAM2.0的CoTracker3循环误差低于对照组，并在六个VBench维度上接近匹配性能，然而不同种子的跟踪效果有所不同。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，这种冲突感知的适应可以提高对应一致性，但不会广泛降低感知质量，对于视频质量的改善并不总是均匀的。

Abstract: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

</details>


### [359] [Joint Discrete and SE(3) Diffusion for Protein Interface Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14699)
*Zhenqiao Song,Jianwen Xie,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PIDiff是一个新的蛋白质-蛋白质复合物设计框架，通过结合离散序列空间和连续结构流形上的扩散，它能够设计出高亲和力和目标特异性蛋白质配体，优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的蛋白质生成方法在同时实现几何和物理化学互补性方面存在局限，PIDiff旨在解决这一挑战，通过引入一个增强的物理化学多模态扩散框架，提高蛋白质配体的亲和力和特异性。

Method: PIDiff使用了一个创新的架构——PIFormer，该架构交替使用几何感知不变点注意力和全局序列自我注意力。框架通过在PIBench数据集中进行预训练，并针对迷你配体设计和抗体设计两个治疗相关应用进行微调，从而实现蛋白质序列和结构的同时设计。

Result: PIDiff在序列设计成功率、结构结合能和序列-结构共设计性等多个任务上均优于现有基线方法，展示了其在蛋白质配体设计领域的优势。

Conclusion: PIDiff通过增强的物理化学多模式扩散框架和创新的PIFormer架构，显著提升了蛋白质配体的设计能力，为现代药物开发提供了新的工具和方法。

Abstract: The design of high-affinity, target-specific protein binders is central to the development of modern therapeutics. However, existing protein-generation methods remain limited in this setting, as many generated designs fail to simultaneously achieve geometric and physicochemical complementarity at binding interfaces. To address this challenge, we introduce PIDiff, a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework for protein-protein complex design. PIDiff jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling diffusion in discrete sequence space with diffusion on the continuous (SE(3)) structural manifold. At its core, PIDiff employs PIFormer, a novel architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention. We further curate PIBench, a protein-protein complex dataset with diverse target scaffolds derived from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We first pretrain PIDiff on PIBench and subsequently fine-tune it for two therapeutically relevant applications: minibinder design and antibody design. PPFrame consistently outperforms baseline methods across sequence design success rate, structure binding energy, and sequence-structure co-designability on all tasks.

</details>


### [360] [DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14700)
*Jinlong Luo,Haoran Wu,Bo Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DSABench 是一个评估模型在多数据库环境中联合执行任务能力的基准测试，展示了仅路由时的高度不精确，同时澄清信息显著提高了表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估模型在真实数据场景中选择和协调多个数据库的能力。

Method: 通过设计815个人工审查的任务，涵盖Spider，BIRD和LiveSQLBench的多个数据库集成和模糊解释，引入可执行合同定义数据库参与和跨数据库依赖，并使用RouteEnv工具允许代理在不透露正确注释的情况下检查公共目录证据。

Result: 在仅路由研究中，最高RA-Set得分为60.55%，而包括协调要求时RA-Graph最高得分为34.66%。执行要求下，四后端的中位数无特权Route+Exec-Graph成功范围从6.69%到7.98%，加上澄清信息后的范围从11.44%到13.25%。在含糊的任务中，澄清信息提高了精确分支-数据库恢复的得分为39.8-43.2百分点。

Conclusion: 研究表明，仅从潜在数据库中检索信息或生成正确的本地SQL是不够的，代理需要在整个跨数据库流程中保持正确信息。

Abstract: Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

</details>


### [361] [How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14707)
*Xiaofan Wu,Xi Zeng,Miaoxia Chen,Peishan Chen,Shuyan Li,Chen Wang,Jiyun Yao,Hanyong Zhong,Jiahao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了TasteBench，一种基于专家判断的基准测试，旨在减少评分中的偏见。研究揭示了三项有效性威胁，包括位置偏好、词汇泄漏和难度天花板效应，其中位置偏好和词汇泄漏可以通过调整解决，但难度天花板可能是一个固有难度限制，需要后续研究解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的评分基准存在容易被游戏的风险，无法准确反映人类专家的判断。因此，需要一个能够限制评分游戏行为、保持评分公平性的新基准。

Method: 研究提出了TasteBench，并描述了如何以专家为主导构建基准测试，包括使用专家专享的黄金标准、控制协议分离技术判断与测试游戏行为，以及一个随机化装置来消除位置偏见和其他潜在的评分漏洞。

Result: 研究揭示了TasteBench面临的主要制约因素，包括位置偏好、词汇泄漏和难度天花板。通过对TasteBench进行调整，成功消除了位置偏见和词汇泄漏问题，但难度天花板仍然存在并需要解决。

Conclusion: 通过引入TasteBench和控制协议，研究成功地减轻了一些评分游戏的问题，但仍需要进一步的工作来克服难度天花板，确保基准测试能够准确地衡量专家在特定领域的判断力。

Abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

</details>


### [362] [Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14721)
*Tianle Liu,Gongbo Cheng,Chenggong Ni,Minming Gu,Tao Zhou,Fuyuan Hu,Fan Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SEGA 提出了一种结合属性级语义对齐和关系概念定位的框架，旨在提高在开放世界识别已知类别并检测未知类别时的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的 TTD 方法主要依赖于视觉聚类或原型对比，难以在开放世界场景中为发现的新类别提供解释。SEGA 的目标在于通过利用大规模语言模型生成属性丰富的描述，并构建关联属性锚点的视觉-语义空间，从而在测试时将匿名类别转换为可解释的语义概念。

Method: SEGA 使用大规模语言模型生成已知类别的属性丰富描述，并在训练时构建关联属性锚点的视觉-语义空间。在测试时引入关系语义定位（RSG），通过将未知样本与相似和不相似的已知类别锚点对齐，促使 LLM 生成候选概念并根据学习到的语义空间重新排序。最终，选定的概念用于置信引导的测试时语义稳定化。

Result: SEGA 在实验中显示了对于 TTD 基线的改进，并通过语义定位提供了开放世界场景下的可解释性。

Conclusion: SEGA 通过结合属性级语义对齐和关系概念定位，显著提高了 TTD 方法在开放世界中的表现，使得识别和检测新类别的过程更加可解释。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

</details>


### [363] [MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14727)
*Pengcheng Pan,Guoqing Ma,Yuhan Zhang,Yang Chen,Yichen Liu,Ziheng Li,Shan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MHWA（多时尺度层次世界-动作模型）通过减少全局上下文更新频率并使用上下文感知路由动态重新配置低层级专家，实现了在使用较少参数和计算量的情况下，在14个Atari游戏中表现优于基准模型，且IQM得分接近大型模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决自回归世界模型在执行过程中出现的累积偏差问题，通过引入多层次架构减少偏差传播，同时保持模型简单性和有效性。

Method: 引入MHWA模型，包含一个步进式高层上下文通道来降低全球上下文更新频率，并通过上下文感知路由动态调整低层专家，实现高-低层级间的灵活协调。

Result: 在14个Atari游戏中使用10%的离线数据和RLiable的种子游戏聚合方法，MHWA在77M参数下实现了0.884的IQM人类标准化得分，优于匹配的JOWA-70M基线（0.529），且参数量和计算量仅为JOWA-150M的一半。

Conclusion: MHWA通过多层次结构的优化设计，有效减轻了偏差传播问题，并在资源有限的情况下取得了接近大模型的性能。

Abstract: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

</details>


### [364] [Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14736)
*Zhongnian Li,Shi Xu,Peng Ying,Weikang Gong,Zhixiao Wang,Xinzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TASA通过利用LLM构建问题特定工具和策略引导自适应工具规划器，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择，从而提高解决方案质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化过程难以追踪，导致LLM无法充分利用先前迭代的信息，限制了解决方案的质量。

Method: TASA通过策略规划和策略引导自适应工具规划，利用LLM总结和利用优化轨迹，实现优化过程的可追踪性。

Result: TASA在共享候选评估预算下建立了局部收敛性，并支持其解决方案质量和策略引导搜索的可追踪性。

Conclusion: TASA通过规划策略和自适应工具规划提高了解决方案质量，并保证了策略引导搜索的可追踪性，克服了原始OPRO方法的局限。

Abstract: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

</details>


### [365] [SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14745)
*Xianglong Yan,Zenan Wu,Kewei Zhang,Kaicheng Yang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE 提出了一种新的 2 比特级量化方法，通过引入能量分层分区（ESG）和自适应位分配（ABS），在保持一定精度的情况下显著提高了模型性能和推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前量化方法在极低位宽（如 2 比特）下，特别是在保护敏感权重通道和合理分配资源等设计挑战方面存在局限，SAGE 旨在解决这些问题。

Method: SAGE 使用能量分层分区（ESG）和自适应位分配（ABS）策略，首先将具有不同能量级别的通道分组，然后在保持低激活权重重建误差最小的情况下分配位预算。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，SAGE 在 2 比特量化设置下实现了最先进的性能，达到 95.3% 的 BF16 模型平均基准得分，并通过自定义的 CUDA 内核实现高达 2.55 倍的推理速度提升。

Conclusion: SAGE 为极低位宽量化提供了有效解决方案，通过保护敏感通道和优化资源分配提高了模型的精度和效率。

Abstract: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

</details>


### [366] [Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14750)
*Gennadiy Chistiakov,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种结合平等信息重建控制、固定效用比较和预设下游安全栏的评估框架，应用于模块化交易架构，并在三组控制实验中测试了其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对模块化金融市场强化学习中难以准确归因的问题，即归因信号可能改进了组件损失但不提供决策相关信息或改善经济结果，研究提出了新的评估框架。

Method: 研究采用了对比和安全栏设置，通过模块化交易架构进行测试。

Result: 实验证明，基于残差的分配与公开接口下的普通损失预算控制相符；直接短缺监督提高了组件预测但未能保持解码后的结果；相较于固定效用，组件级批评监督导致了更高的风险条件下的CER和回撤。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了三种归因评价失败的情况：冗余的归因信号、表示导致的预测权衡，以及组件监督与下游风险结果之间的偏差，并提供了在部分观测、延迟反馈和经济风险约束下操作的专家系统评价方法。

Abstract: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

</details>


### [367] [GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14754)
*Junjie Li,Jiong Lou,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GateSight 提取了 GDN 层中基于 KV 缓存未来有用的信号，避免了重复的注意力权重计算，在缓存缩小至十分之一的情况下仍能提高预测准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于探索是否可以从已有的 GDN 层中提取 KV 缓存未来有用的信号，以减少缓存大小同时保持甚至提高预测准确性。

Method: 通过定义未来 KV 条目的有用性，GateSight 使用轻量级的 per-head 多层感知机 (MLP) 来学习这一信号，决定每个注意力层保留哪些条目。这种方法在不同模型和场景下展示了其有效性。

Result: 实验结果表明，GateSight 在 SCBench 和 RULER-4096 上的表现优于其他方法，尤其是在缓存容量限制较大的情况下。GateSight 在使用 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型时，在三个模型基准对中表现最佳，比其他方法提高了 9.5 到 47.2 个百分点。

Conclusion: GateSight 为缓存管理提供了一种高效的策略，能够在减少缓存大小的同时保持甚至提高预测准确性。

Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

</details>


### [368] [CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14763)
*Chenlu Ding,Jiancan Wu,Yanchen Luo,Tianyu Zhang,Yancheng Yuan,Xiang Wang,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CUSE （Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation） 提出了一种方法来更有效地进行多模态大型语言模型的遗忘操作，同时保留非目标内容，它通过构造反事实输入和自蒸馏过程，显著提升了遗忘集和保留集的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的遗忘方法通常采用统一的遗忘目标并依赖固定且离策略的监督，这导致了粗糙的令牌控制和与模型当前行为的不一致。为了改进这一现状，研究提出了CUSE框架。

Method: CUSE框架首先通过移除目标相关信息构造反事实输入，并通过这些变化来确定哪些令牌需要更强的遗忘。然后，它对当前策略采样的响应进行自蒸馏处理，以确定令牌级别的遗忘和保留目标。框架使用冻结的原模型作为教师模型，并结合遗忘和保留导向的特权上下文来辅助实现。

Result: 在MLLMU-Bench基准测试中，CUSE降低了遗忘集ROUGE-L分数的33.6%，同时比最强基准提高了1.2%的保留集ROUGE-L分数。

Conclusion: CUSE在保持非目标内容的同时更有效地执行了多模态大型语言模型的遗忘操作，展示了它在实际应用场景中的潜力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [369] [How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14772)
*Xiaofan Wu,Xi Zeng,Miaoxia Chen,Peishan Chen,Shuyan Li,Chen Wang,Jiyun Yao,Hanyong Zhong,Jiahao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种针对瞬时目标的双deadline架构，旨在解决相机主导代理面临的时间障碍。该架构包括一个快速的非语义路径、一个主动的记忆机制以及一个延迟的推理层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文探讨了视觉目标瞬时性的挑战，指出相机主导代理面临的最大问题是时间限制，而非识别能力。许多视觉目标是瞬时存在的，这意味着当代理完成整个推理过程时，目标可能已经消失。因此，研究提出了一个新的架构来解决这一问题。

Method: 该方法通过分离硬记忆截止点和软推理截止点，提出了一种双deadline架构。具体包括：一个持续运行、有界、非语义的快速路径；一个主动的记忆机制，能够在目标被覆盖前将其固定在持久性记忆中；一个延迟的推理层（包括多模态模型和相关工具）。此外，该方法在MOT17追踪窗口上实例化了感知截止期合约，并通过测量前沿模型延迟来校准单一路径基线。

Result: 通过双deadline架构，代理能够在目标消失前将其固定到持久性记忆中，并为后续推理提供了足够的信息。该方法验证了即使需要较长时间，答案也不能晚于证据消失的时间。

Conclusion: 本文提出的双deadline架构显著地提高了瞬时目标识别的效率，应对了相机主导代理所面临的挑战。

Abstract: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

</details>


### [370] [ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14774)
*Hao Li,Keqing He,Longtao Zheng,Junlong Li,Weihao Zeng,Qian Liu,Yuzhen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇文章介绍了ProgAgent，一个全面的程序化工具调用（PTC）训练栈，包括合成验证长时间任务的管道、轻量级的PTC运行时和两阶段的培训食谱。使用215个基于四个环境规模的任务，ProgAgent在四个基准测试中表现出更高的通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代理通常使用直接工具调用(DTC)，这可能会导致上下文衰退和协调失败。因此，研究引入了一种全新的基于程序化工具调用(PTC)的方式，来解决这些问题，以提高代理的训练效果和全局任务的处理能力。

Method: 这篇文章的方法包括几个方面：首先，开发了一个合成验证性长时间任务的流水线；其次，设计了一个轻量级的程序化工具调用运行时；最后，提出了一个两阶段的培训策略。所有这些组件结合起来构成了一个完整的PTC训练堆栈。

Result: 使用215个任务（在四个环境规模下），ProgAgent在四个基准测试中展示了比等效规模的其他基线更高的通过率。在LOCA-bench基准测试中，在64k-标记环境状态下，ProgAgent-14B达到了30.7%的通过率，而这些基线的得分为零。

Conclusion: 研究证明了程序化工具调用在解决代理训练中的上下文衰退问题及提高长时任务处理能力上具有明显的优势，这表明PTC训练有可能超越简单的接口性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

</details>


### [371] [LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14777)
*Ruichen Xia,Xiao Han,Dingyu Yang,Luwei Yang,Sai Wu,Dongxiang Zhang,Binhui Yao,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LYNX是一个多代理框架，通过计划、生成、验证和细化的闭环工作流程解决LLM驱动的数据分析中的模式和知识约束分析问题，其性能和效率显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在将自然语言指令转化为执行的分析程序时，难以保持领域语义和复杂模式的一致性，导致执行脆弱和语义不一致。

Method: LYNX利用计划、生成、验证和细化的闭环工作流程，结合Semantic-Structural Distillation和Stage-Aware Allocation技术，通过代理协作确保模式与语义一致性，提高执行正确性。

Result: LYNX在两个基准测试BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev和更具挑战性的Spider 2.0-Lite上表现出强大的性能和效率，超过了现有的最有效方法，执行准确性提高了10.66%到59.54%，同时减少了70.53%的令牌消耗。

Conclusion: LYNX框架展示了较强的泛化能力，适用于不同的基础模型，并在定量金融分析以及复杂多关系SQL工作负载方面展示了其健壮性、可扩展性和实际应用性。

Abstract: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

</details>


### [372] [Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14790)
*Zhongnian Li,Shi Xu,Mengting Xu,Peng Ying,Xinzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过分析局部生成和部署保证，推导出在资源受限的情况下，局部反思能够提供亚线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，同时保持原生控制器。进一步建立了资源敏感的转换界限，链接了政策获取与长期性能之间的质量、覆盖率和硬预算的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法虽然能在特定任务中表现出色，但在任务间的自适应性及长期性能保证方面尚存不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，为局部反思提供长期性能保障。

Method: 研究通过详细推导，提出资源敏感的转换界限来限制全状态部署差异，并验证政策获取与长期性能间的质量、覆盖率和硬预算之间的权衡关系。

Result: 研究结果表明，即使在资源有限的情况下，局部反思也能保证亚线性反事实遗憾，并且能够验证一个包含重复政策增长和不完美验证等条件的理论结果链。

Conclusion: 本文的结论指出，局部反思在资源受限的情况下仍能提供有效的长期性能保障，通过建立资源敏感的转换界限和验证具体的理论结果链，为适应性和长期性能的结合提供了一种途径。

Abstract: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

</details>


### [373] [GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14792)
*Attila Lischka,Ze Zhou,Xuegang,Ban,Balázs Kulcsár*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究开发了一个基于Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT)的动态定价与路径规划框架，用于应对在线订单中的家庭和户外配送选项。该框架可以在不断变化的条件下快速重新优化路径，并根据客户选择进行动态定价，从而提升利润。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决在线同日配送活动中，随着客户数量增加导致的配送成本上升问题，设计了一种综合路径优化和动态定价的方法。该方法旨在平衡递送费用和路径优化成本，引导成本较高的家庭递送需求转向户外递送。

Method: 该研究利用Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT)神经网络模型解决容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP），并结合Thompson抽样策略与Laplace近似后验方法来学习和适应客户偏好。

Result: 开发的GREAT-ESDD框架提高了大约11%的利润，同时在相似的定价决策时间预算下提供更有效的路径优化。此外，研究显示该框架能够在短时间内成功估计客户偏好，优于静态定价策略。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法能够在不断变化的配送环境中动态调整价格和路径规划，以提高同日配送服务的经济性。

Abstract: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions).
