Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior.
  In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. These data can be exported for visualization and analysis. Our approach demonstrates how instrumentation can be generalized beyond traditional hardware to support heterogeneous architectures, providing portability without modifying tool logic.
  By opening the black box of dataflow execution, DFIT establishes a foundation for new classes of performance analysis tools for AI accelerators. It provides a practical path toward reproducible, architecture-aware introspection across heterogeneous systems, bridging the long-standing visibility gap between compiler design, runtime scheduling, and hardware realization. Evaluation across Cerebras, SambaNova, and TPU shows practical overhead of 3.53%-13.62% across instrumentation modes with robust cross-platform portability.

</details>


### [477] [HADES: A Programmable Processing-Near-Memory Engine for Binary Similarity Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14677)
*Pranav M*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: HADES 通过将数据和程序结合在一个共享寄存器文件中，显著减少了数据移动成本，实现在特定工作负载下的高性能表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在小型二进制相似性与搜索工作中，数据移动通常会成为性能瓶颈。因此，设计了 HADES，通过将数据和程序存储在一个共享的寄存器文件中，减少数据移动带来的开销。

Method: HADES 设计了一个包含 12 个 16 位操作码、三个工作寄存器和一个 32 个插槽的程序，可以表达 10 种搜索负载，并通过特定指令（SCANP 和 SCANSEL）优化了多行和选择性扫描。

Result: Tiny Tapeout 实现后，时序可达到 40 MHz，使用标准单元 26,968 平方微米和宏单元 15,744 平方微米。在与 ESP8266 和 ESP32 微控制器以及理想主机的比较中，HADES 在处理批数据时获得了显著的速度提升，但单次查询的表现有所下降。Arduino Nano 运行受限子集。

Conclusion: 尽管 HADES 在特定条件下表现出色，但其控制和指令存储大小有限，目前仍需优化以负担更大的程序和数据。

Abstract: Moving operands to a processor can cost more than the arithmetic performed on them, and for small binary similarity and search workloads data movement can dominate. We present HADES, a programmable processing-near-memory engine built around one shared 32x32-bit 2R1W register-file macro that holds both data and program. Twelve 16-bit opcodes, three working registers and a 32-slot program express ten search workloads in 8 to 19 slots, and SCANP and SCANSEL shorten dual-row and selected scans. A post-layout 2x2 Tiny Tapeout implementation closes timing at 40 MHz with 26,968 square microns of standard cells beside a 15,744 square microns macro. All HADES results come from RTL or gate-level simulation of this implementation, and HADES energy is estimated. Against ESP8266 and ESP32 microcontrollers running plain C, and with an ideal host, HADES answers a resident query 10x to 32x and 2.2x to 11x faster, respectively. End to end, it wins at the evaluated batch sizes of B = 16 and B = 256 against both boards and loses the single-query (B = 1) runs to the ESP32. An Arduino Nano runs a restricted subset. Kernel power stays within about 2% of a spin loop on all three boards. These results hold for plain-C baselines under the evaluated conditions. At this scale the control and instruction storage fit around a shared memory macro, while the byte-wide interface and the loading path remain significant costs.

</details>


### [478] ["Is Low Power Enough?" Rethinking Energy Efficiency in High-Fidelity Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14714)
*Chae Young Lee,Lan Mei,Jesse Fonseca,Zerina Kapetanovic*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 研究提出，对于需要高 fidelity 数据的长寿命传感器节点，应采用更强大的微控制器，只要整个板子能够深度睡眠。实验证明，在完成观测过程中，STM32N6 能使用更少的能量并以更快的速度完成任务。对于推理任务，它也能使用更少的能量，并获得更准确的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着科学家们对高精度数据（如影像和音频）的需求增加，传统的低功耗传感器无法满足这一需求，其功耗问题显著。研究重新审视了早期传感器网络中的 '抢先睡眠' 和 '少说话' 原则，并为高精度数据和设备内 AI 提出了新的策略。

Method: 研究通过对比 STM32N6（配备了快速主频和神经加速器）与低功耗的 Apollo4 Plus 的性能，测试新策略的效果。

Result: STM32N6 虽然功耗较高（1.9 倍），但在完成一次观测（包含采集、存储、本地检测和 LoRa 传输）时，速度是低功耗 Apollo4 Plus 的 9.9 倍，因此在总体能耗上降低了 5.2 倍。在推理任务上能量节约效果更明显，能耗降低 3.2 至 11.4 倍，并且模型效果更准确，能准确覆盖 23 个以上数据点。

Conclusion: 在追求高精度数据的长寿命传感器节点中，完成任务的速度和迅速进入深度睡眠状态同样重要，同时仅发送必要的数据也有助于延长传感器寿命。

Abstract: For two decades, long-lived sensor nodes have been built from the lowest-power parts, because their scalar readings take only milliseconds to acquire and send. Scientists now want higher fidelity data from the field, such as images and audio, and these observations break that rule: a low-power microcontroller stays awake for seconds to read, store, and transmit each one, so low power is no longer low energy. We argue that long-lived, high-fidelity nodes should instead be built around a more capable microcontroller, provided the whole board sleeps deeply. We revisit two principles from early sensor networks, "race to sleep" and "talk less", for high-fidelity data and on-device AI, and test them by comparing the STM32N6, which pairs a fast core with a neural accelerator, against the low-power Apollo4 Plus. Although the STM32N6 draws 1.9x more power, it completes an observation (capture, storage, on-board detection, and a LoRa transmission) 9.9x faster and so uses 5.2x less energy. On the same model, it runs inference with 3.2-11.4x less energy, and it fits models over 23 points more accurate. A high-fidelity node lives longest when it finishes quickly, sleeps deeply, and sends only what matters.

</details>


### [479] [GaborFlow: Hardware-Software Co-Optimization of Gabor Filter Accelerator Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15003)
*Priyanka Agarwal,Pruthvi Parate,Raghav Khurana,Madhav Rao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一种名为GaborFlow的新型硬件-软件协同优化框架，通过神经网络与精确优化的多相器相结合，提高了脑肿瘤检测的准确性和能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑肿瘤分类对医疗影像至关重要，准确度直接关系到患者的治疗效果。现有的脑肿瘤检测方法准确性有限且缺乏能效，在此背景下，该研究旨在设计一种更准确、能效更高的脑肿瘤检测方法。

Method: 该方法基于GaborFlow框架，结合了经过贝叶斯超参数调优的软件优化和精确优化的硬件设计。具体而言，该研究提出了一种新型的Gabor滤波加速器，并将其与EfficientNet-B0骨干CNN架构相结合。

Result: 实验结果表明，GaborFlow加速器在脑肿瘤分类准确性、能效和占位面积上均优于现有实现方式。具体而言，其分类准确率达到98.6%，相比现有方法，能效提高了28.08%，占位面积减少了48.83%。

Conclusion: GaborFlow加速器在脑肿瘤检测领域的研究结论是，通过协同优化硬件与软件，医疗AI可以兼顾高准确性和高能效。未来的工作应进一步探索如何使该方法更广泛地应用于实际医疗场景。

Abstract: Brain tumor classification from MRI scans represents a critical challenge in medical imaging, where accuracy directly impacts patient outcomes. This paper introduces GaborFlow, a novel hardware-software co-optimization framework that revolutionizes the design of the Gabor Filter accelerator for generating feature maps to enhance brain tumor detection. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on fixed filter parameters, our method employs trainable Gabor coefficients within a carefully optimized range, integrated with an EfficientNet-B0 backbone CNN architecture. The innovation lies in the synergistic combination of software optimization through Bayesian hyperparameter tuning and hardware efficiency through precision-optimized multipliers. Our GF baseline accelerator achieves remarkable results, with 98.6% classification accuracy, 28.08% power benefits, and 48.83% footprint savings compared to state-of-the-art implementations, demonstrating that medical AI can be both highly accurate and energy-efficient. The hardware design files are made freely available for easy adoption and further usage by the researchers and designers.

</details>


### [480] [Programmable Data Layouts via On-The-Fly Data Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15193)
*Cole Strickler,Renato Mancuso,Manos Athanassoulis,Heechul Yun*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种硬件软件协同设计框架，利用Data Transformation Language (DTL)和Data Transformation Unit (DTU)来解决现代计算系统中由于处理能力与内存延迟之间的差距导致的性能瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算系统受到处理吞吐量与内存延迟之间差距的限制，尤其是当应用程序的数据访问模式与内存中的物理布局不匹配时问题更加明显。DTL和DTU的设计旨在通过重新组织数据布局来提高系统性能。

Method: DTL允许程序员简洁地表示复杂的数据布局重组织，编译器将其转换为高效的硬件路由配置。DTU是一个硬件引擎，位于Last-Level Cache (LLC)和主内存之间，能够实时评估这些配置，将分散的数据元素聚集到逻辑上连续的缓存行中。这种方法通过将显式的布局变换转化为虚拟视图来消除在软件中的显式数据材料化。

Result: 在基于RISC-V的四核SoC上使用FireSim评估DTU，显示出显著提高的执行速度和内存效率。

Conclusion: 结果显示该方法能够在现代硬件上改进性能，为未来的高性能计算系统设计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: The performance of modern computing systems is heavily bottlenecked by the widening gap between processing throughput and main memory latency, a problem exacerbated when an application's logical data access patterns misalign with the physical layout of data in memory. To address this, we propose a hardware-software co-design framework comprising the Data Transformation Language (DTL) and the Data Transformation Unit (DTU). DTL allows programmers to concisely express complex data layout reorganizations, which the compiler translates into efficient hardware routing configurations. The DTU, a hardware engine logically situated between the Last-Level Cache (LLC) and main memory, transparently evaluates these configurations on-the-fly to gather scattered data elements into dense, logically contiguous cache lines. By converting explicit layout transformations into virtual views, this approach eliminates the need for explicit data materialization in software. We evaluate the DTU within a quad-core RISC-V SoC using FireSim, demonstrating substantial improvements in execution speed and memory efficiency.

</details>


### [481] [MoSAIC: Learning DAG Scheduling Heuristics from Optimal Schedules through Motif-Aware Recovery and LLM-Guided Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15205)
*Shiva Ahir,Hashmath Shaik,Alex Doboli,Nadeem Yaseen,Simona Doboli*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MoSAIC是一种基于学习的方法，它结合了精确和启发式调度技术，利用大规模语言模型的推理能力，通过贝叶斯优化学习优先级调度函数，从而在保持低运行时开销的同时提高任务调度效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前在异构计算环境中，DAG基础应用的任务调度仍然是一个基本挑战，现有的精确和启发式调度方法各有优劣，MoSAIC试图通过学习优先级调度函数来克服这一问题，以期望在多种复杂多样的DAG应用中取得更好的调度效果。

Method: MoSAIC框架首先采用OR-Tools CP-SAT求解器生成优化调度，然后利用贝叶斯优化监督优先级调度函数的学习过程。学习到的启发式方法能够捕捉调度决策和结构图形特性之间的关系，从而构建跨不同DAG实例的可重用知识库。

Result: 实验结果表明，通过贝叶斯优化学习到的启发式方法优于经典方法如HEFT，同时保持了较低的运行时开销。这证明了将最优监督与基于学习的泛化结合起来对于可扩展且自适应的任务调度是实用的。

Conclusion: MoSAIC框架提供了一种实用的解决方案，能够在异构计算系统中实现可扩展且自适应的任务调度，通过结合精确和启发式调度技术，实现在多种复杂场景中的高效调度。

Abstract: Efficient task scheduling in heterogeneous computing systems remains a fundamental challenge in embedded and high-level synthesis flows. This paper presents MoSAIC (Motif-aware Scheduling with AI-driven Cognition), a learning-based framework that bridges the gap between exact and heuristic scheduling approaches for DAG-based applications. The system uses the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to learn the relationships between DAG structures and scheduling priority functions. The framework first leverages the OR-Tools CP-SAT solver [4] to generate optimal schedules, which are then used to supervise the learning of compact priority-based scheduling functions through Bayesian Optimization. These learned heuristics capture relationships between scheduling decisions and structural graph features such as rank, depth, and fanout, enabling the construction of a reusable knowledge base across diverse DAG instances. Experimental results across synthetic graph families and real-world benchmarks, including PolyBench and MachSuite, show that the learned heuristics consistently improve over classical approaches such as HEFT [2], while maintaining low runtime overhead. The results indicate that combining optimal supervision with learning-based generalization provides a practical approach for scalable and adaptive task scheduling.

</details>


### [482] [The Era of Vibe Tapeout: Dark Age or Golden Age for Analog Circuit Design?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15240)
*Kentaro Yoshioka*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 此研究通过两个实验场景验证了LLM在模拟电路设计中的应用：在开放PDK环境下成功设计了一款11位、5.12 MHz SAR ADC；在受控环境下，本地运行的LLM也取得了一定进展，但识别问题的能力有限。研究认为，对于熟知验证技能的设计师来说，这代表了模拟设计的一个黄金时期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在探索LLM技术在模拟电路设计中的应用潜力，通过实际案例验证其可行性与限制，并讨论其未来前景。

Method: 在开放PDK和本地受限环境中分别进行了两个实验，通过不同LLM的表现评估其在模拟电路设计中的效用。

Result: 开放PDK环境下，LLM实现了从规格到设计的完全自动化，并且设计结果达到了验证标准。在本地受限环境中，LLM虽未能完美通过所有测试，但在特定任务上表现出色。

Conclusion: 研究认为，LLM技术在智能电路设计中展现出巨大潜力，特别是在具备丰富验证经验的设计师手中。研究还指出，需要进一步提升LLM系统的鲁棒性和自我验证能力以应对潜在问题。

Abstract: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. The agents also identified the causes of post-PEX degradation (CDAC wiring coupling and common-mode-dependent comparator offset) by their own experiments. On the other hand, agents sometimes reported false passes, and verification independent of the design agent was essential. (B) A commercial PDK is under NDA and cannot be given to a cloud LLM. We therefore evaluated local LLMs running on university servers with a six-task benchmark on a commercial 65-nm CMOS PDK. Kimi K3 passed five of the six tasks, while MiniMax M3 passed two. Neither solved the debugging task, which requires finding the cause from symptoms. Finally, we discuss the prospects for extending vibe tapeout from ADCs to entire SoCs, and ask whether vibe tapeout is a dark age or a golden age for analog design. Our answer is that it is a golden age for designers who know what to verify.

</details>


### [483] [Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15392)
*Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该研究通过在单磁通量子(SFQ)逻辑中实现新型设计，绕过了状态和反馈，开发了一种无需状态的类条件流动匹配图像生成器，以促进神经网络中的热力学计算。这种设计减少了Josephson结的数量，并且不需要松弛路径平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了克服在超导单磁通量子逻辑中进行热力学计算的技术挑战，如状态、记忆、分叉和反馈等，研究团队开发了一种新的设计方法。

Method: 研究团队设计了一种基于类条件流动匹配图像生成器的模型，并将其与SFQ逻辑电路进行了协同设计。每一层模型都是由仅使用多路复用器操作的分劈单极性位流构建的蝴蝶因子化线性映射。此外，取代了在随机计算中需要的每个神经元上的计数器，研究团队采用了一种状态无门的AND-NOT门解决方案，该门使用SFQ门级流水线提供了一个时钟输入偏差。

Result: 与传统的基于计数器的设计相比，新设计将硬件嵌入阶段中的Jospheson结数量减少了40-47%，并且能够容忍更宽松的路径平衡。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了热力学计算在SFQ逻辑中的成功实现，并且展示了其在减少硬件复杂性和提高效率方面的潜力。

Abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. The model is a class-conditional flow-matching image generator, which transforms Gaussian noise into an image of the requested class along a short, deterministic path of four Euler steps; in hardware, these steps are unrolled into a feed-forward pipeline of stochastic bitstream operators, whose output is read out as a time average, as in thermodynamic computing, without any relaxation phase. Each layer of the model is a butterfly-factorized linear map built exclusively from multiplexers that operate on split-unipolar bitstreams. The ReLU activation, which in stochastic computing requires a per-neuron up/down counter (accounting for 60-70% of the JJs in a counter-based design), is replaced by a stateless AND-NOT gate whose one-clock input skew is provided at no cost by SFQ gate-level pipelining. The models are trained directly on the stream representation of the hardware, with a regularizer that bounds the stream gains. Synthesis with an SFQ design flow shows that stochastic streams tolerate relaxed path balancing, which reduces the Josephson-junction (JJ) count of a hard-wired stage by 40-47%.

</details>


### [484] [Integration, Enhancements and Evaluation of Memory Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15873)
*Pouya Esmaili-Dokht,Arash Yadegari,Victor Xirau,Julian Pavon,Hamid Sarbazi-Azad,Adrián Cristal,Eduard Ayguadé,Petar Radojković*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于评估集成仿真基础设施中内存系统性能的验证方法，通过内存模拟器、CPU-内存接口和模拟应用三个视角验证，纠正了内存模型的不匹配问题，使模拟结果更接近实际硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前针对集成仿真基础设施中的内存系统性能评估没有通用的方法或实践，导致不同研究采用不同的评估方法，从而得出互相矛盾的结论。为了统一评估标准，本文提出了新的验证方法。

Method: 本文从内存模拟器、CPU-内存接口和模拟应用三个角度对内存系统性能进行评估。这种方法有助于发现和理解由模拟器集成和微架构特征简化建模引起的问题，并提出了相应的解决方案，尤其解决了延迟响应的周期精确内存模拟器与ZSim之间的内存模型不匹配问题。

Result: 通过本文提出的方法，不同周期精确内存模拟器与实际硬件之间的带宽-延迟趋势一致。经过修正和增强后的模拟器，其模拟结果与实际硬件测量值之间的差距缩小至5%以内。

Conclusion: 本文的方法不仅适用于ZSim与其他模拟器的集成，还提供了所有主要公开的周期精确内存模拟器的解决方案，使它们的性能评估结果更接近实际硬件。

Abstract: Currently, there is no common methodology or set of practices for evaluating memory-system performance in integrated simulation infrastructures. As a result, studies adopt different evaluation approaches, which can lead to conflicting conclusions even for the same simulation infrastructure. We propose a validation methodology that evaluates memory-system performance from three complementary views: the memory simulator, the CPU--memory interface and the simulated application. We use these views to detect, understand and correct memory-simulation inaccuracies arising from simulator integration and simplified modeling of microarchitectural features. The methodology reveals that the application's perception of memory performance can become effectively decoupled from the detailed memory simulation. Most importantly, we identify and correct a fundamental memory-model mismatch between delayed-response cycle-accurate memory simulators and ZSim, a representative parallel CPU simulator. We demonstrate the broader applicability of these enhancements by applying them to ZSim integrations with Ramulator 2, DRAMsim3 and DRAMSys 4, covering all major public cycle-accurate memory simulators. After the corrections and enhancements, all integrations reproduce the main bandwidth--latency trends and key characteristics of the actual system. Across the evaluated simulators, STREAM bandwidth differs from actual-hardware measurements by less than 5% in most experiments, while pointer-chase latency remains 15--18% lower than on actual hardware. All simulator enhancements are released as open source.

</details>


### [485] [GarageWorks: A Shared Testbench Abstraction for Software Simulation and FPGA Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15925)
*Kazutomo Yoshii*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GarageWorks 是一个轻量级的 FPGA 测试框架，允许使用相同的 cocotb 测试脚本在软件 RTL 仿真和 FPGA 加速硬件仿真之间进行切换。该框架通过共享抽象层隐藏了后端特定接口，并通过可综合的 AXI 分发器提供了特定于 DUT 的控制和测试操作。GarageWorks 主要用于独立设计的裸机测试和片上处理逻辑的科学传感器，而不是全系统级原型设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GarageWorks 的设计旨在简化 FPGA 硬件测试，实现软件与硬件仿真之间的无缝转换，从而加速基于 FPGA 的原型设计和验证过程。

Method: GarageWorks 使用共享抽象层隐藏 FPGA 后端的特定接口，并利用可综合的 AXI 分发器来实现对 DUT 的特定控制和测试操作。

Result: GarageWorks 已经在 AMD Alveo V80 FPGA 上进行了初步验证，并且支持 AI 辅助生成针对特定 DUT 的测试组件。

Conclusion: GarageWorks 提供了一种轻量级的解决方案，可以加快基于 FPGA 的测试过程，并支持 AI 辅助的测试组件生成机制。

Abstract: GarageWorks is a lightweight FPGA testing framework that enables the same cocotb testbench to be used for both software RTL simulation and FPGA-accelerated hardware simulation. A shared abstraction hides backend-specific interfaces, while synthesizable Advanced eXtensible Interface (AXI) dispatchers provide design-under-test (DUT)-specific control and test operations on the FPGA. GarageWorks is intended for rapid bare-metal testing of standalone designs and on-chip processing logic for scientific sensors, rather than full SoC-level prototyping. The framework has been validated on AMD Alveo V80 FPGAs with several internal designs and provides initial support for AI-assisted generation of DUT-specific test components.

</details>


### [486] [LizTail: Unifying Shape Adaptation and Spatial Parallelism with Segment-Reconfigurable Systolic Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16159)
*Gang Liu,Chen Yang,Junyan Hu,Jianguo Chen,Lixin Duan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: LizTail是一种创新的多模式 systolic 数组架构，通过预定义的重构边界将128x128的阵列分割成32个固定的128x4的子阵列，并利用局部连接支持裁剪、长路径扩展和分布式执行，提高了CNN和LLM的性能和能量效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的固定结构二维阵列在处理不同卷积神经网络（CNN）和变压器基础大语言模型时，面临矩阵形状多样性与并行度之间的匹配度较低的问题。对于瘦矩阵、小批量自回归解码和带有多独立划分的操作尤其如此，导致了处理单元（PE）利用率低和空间重叠高。

Method: LizTail通过将128x128的阵列分割成32个固定的128x4的子阵列，并仅在预定义的端点间添加连接，实现了子阵列级别的受限重构。该架构支持裁剪、180度折返路径扩展以及分布式执行。每个子阵列也可以独立进行裁剪或扩展，同时配备了差异化PE数据路径和段感知CEB/SIB缓存，提供了所需的计算和数据传输灵活性。

Result: 针对代表性工作负载，LizTail在CNN推理性能上实现了5.02倍的加速，在LLM解码上达到了25.67倍的加速，同时将能效延迟积(EDP)降低了38.23倍。

Conclusion: LizTail提供了一种有效的方法来提高特定类型计算的效率，通过灵活的局部连接和分区机制满足了CNN和LLM对并行计算的需求。

Abstract: Systolic arrays are widely used to accelerate neural-network inference, yet fixed two-dimensional arrays struggle with the substantial diversity in both matrix geometry and available parallelism across CNNs and Transformer-based large language models. This mismatch is particularly severe for skinny matrices, small-batch autoregressive decoding, and operators containing multiple independent partitions, leading to low processing-element (PE) utilization and repeated spatial folding. Existing reconfigurable arrays typically improve either shape adaptation or distributed execution, whereas supporting both through fine-grained routing incurs considerable interconnect, buffering, and control overheads. We present LizTail (named after lizard tail autotomy, where predefined fracture planes allow segments to detach and remain independently active, analogous to LizTail's predefined reconfiguration boundaries), a multi-mode systolic array that enables constrained segment-level reconfiguration by partitioning a $128\times128$ array into 32 regular $128\times4$ segments and adding connectivity only at predefined endpoints. The resulting substrate supports trimming, long-path extension through $180^\circ$ turn-back connections, and distributed execution in which each subarray can itself be trimmed or extended. Differentiated PE datapaths and segment-aware CEB/SIB buffers provide the required compute and data-delivery flexibility without unrestricted PE-level routing. A hardware-constrained mapper selects the execution organization, dataflow, task partition, and tiling. Across representative workloads, LizTail achieves geometric-mean speedups of $5.02\times$ on CNN inference and $25.67\times$ on LLM decoding over a TPU-like array, while reducing EDP by up to $38.23\times$. LizTail is open-sourced at https://github.com/kmjbwxa/LizTail.

</details>


### [487] [SafeDSE: Joint Exploration of Safety Architecture Patterns, Mapping, and Scheduling for Dataflow Applications With Safety Arguments (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16213)
*Fatemeh Bahrami,Seyed-Hosein Attarzadeh-Niaki*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SafeDSE 是一种框架，用于探索同步数据流应用程序的设计空间，通过一个声明性的约束模型自动完成多个复杂设计决策，并提供验证和生成安全论证的功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入式平台上安全功能与非关键功能混合部署的需求，现有方法固定模式映射可能导致成本增加，SafeDSE 提供了一种更有效的解决方案。

Method: SafeDSE 使用一个声明性的约束模型来决定每个参与者的行为模式、放置、编排顺序、平台选择，并定价 SIL 优化。通过一个固定的图来激活选定的模式，节点潜力来编码吞吐量。

Result: SafeDSE 在 9 个基准实例下，在保守定价下，没有固定模式映射规则在所有约束下既总是可行又从不比联合探索更昂贵。生成的安全论证中的 49% 到 62% 的叶子节点引用了验证器检查；其余部分是无法用映射解决的声明。

Conclusion: SafeDSE 模型在所有合成图中都能证明最优性，进一步增加了验证器和生成器的细节，并提供了全面的实验数据和负面结果。

Abstract: Embedded platforms increasingly host safety-related streaming functions next to less critical ones. Whether a safety architecture pattern, such as a doer/checker pair, protects a function depends on the cores that run its components. Their schedule must meet the throughput requirement, and mixing safety integrity levels (SILs) on one core raises development cost. This report presents SafeDSE, a design space exploration framework for synchronous dataflow applications. One declarative constraint model decides the pattern of each actor, the placement that the fault model requires, the static-order schedule, and the platform, and prices SIL promotion. Guards activate the chosen patterns in a fixed graph that holds all of them, and node potentials encode throughput. An independent verifier re-checks every solution, and a generator turns its checks into evidence of a safety argument in Goal Structuring Notation. On 9 benchmark instances under period bounds, no rule that fixes patterns before mapping was both always feasible and never more expensive under conservative pricing, while joint exploration was. In the generated arguments, 49 to 62% of the leaves cite verifier checks; the rest are claims a mapping cannot discharge. Optimality within the model was proven for all synthetic graphs with up to 16 actors. This extended version adds the full model, the verifier and generator in detail, the complete catalog and parameters, and a proof of the potential characterization. It also reports every experiment per instance, a mutation analysis of the verifier, and the negative results of the development.

</details>


### [488] [FORGE: Procedural Weight Generation for Sparse MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16890)
*Chanyoung Moon,Travis Pence,Daisuke Yamada,Jiaqi Mo,Yanxin Zhang,Vikas Singh,Karthikeyan Sankaralingam*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: FORGE是一个在芯片内部生成稀疏混合专家模型权重的方法，通过少量的旋转参数在运行时再生专家权重，从而降低了内存带宽需求和节点间的通信量，提高了解码吞吐率和降低了用户解码延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的稀疏混合专家模型在解码时面临着内存带宽瓶颈和节点间通信量大的问题。通过减少需要存储的专家权重的数量，来缓解这些问题。

Method: FORGE使用一个紧凑的加速器（旋转生成单元RGU）在运行时从少量旋转参数再生专家权重。

Result: 通过在不同的稀疏混合专家模型中将30%的模块替换为FORGE方法，系统吞吐率提高了1.3到2.8倍，并且用户解码延迟降低了10%到15%；同时，KV缓存容量也增加了1.2到2.6倍。

Conclusion: 虽然使用FORGE会降低一些模型的性能，但它能够显著提高稀疏混合专家模型在处理大规模数据时的效率和吞吐率。

Abstract: We introduce FORGE (Fast On-chip Rotor Generation for Experts), a procedural weight generation system for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. Rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from HBM, we show how a compact accelerator inside each Streaming Multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from $O(\log^2 d)$ rotor parameters per projection. Per replaced layer, gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. This addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive Sparse MoE decode, where per-expert FFN operations are HBM-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node Expert Parallelism (EP) with all-to-all traffic. We realize the approach as the Rotor Generation Unit (RGU), a fixed-function datapath that generates FFN weight tiles without competing with Tensor Core execution. With 30% of the MoE FFN layers replaced across five Sparse MoE models, we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched GPU count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. In exchange, downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement, and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. FORGE also expands KV cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. It is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored, so it can compose with quantization. The RGU is fully implemented/verified in SystemVerilog at ~0.9% SM area overhead (0.032 mm^2/SM, 7nm).

</details>


### [489] [LocalTrain: Integer-Only Local Learning for Energy-Efficient CNN Training on Edge FPGAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17099)
*Shiqi Ding,Xuanyu Liang,Xinyang Liu,Boyang Li,Zhiqiang Que,Guosheng Hu,Jiayang Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该FPGA系统通过共享整数矩阵引擎训练CNN及其区域辅助分类器，实现高效的硬件加速，在不牺牲大量精度的情况下减少了能耗并提高了运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 减少跨层训练依赖性，提高局部学习效率，同时保持高准确度和能效。

Method: 利用FPGA系统中的共享整数矩阵引擎，通过将紧凑误差展开、逐块折叠梯度、利用历史缩放直接输出转换来执行高效的并行计算。

Result: 在200 MHz下，KV260原型在CIFAR-10上的准确率为76.57%，在SVHN上的准确率为91.85%，平均模块功率约为4.20 W。矩阵吞吐量分别达到31.22和31.57 GMAC/s。与Jetson Orin Nano上的相同整数方法相比，训练能耗分别降低了40.4%和42.1%，运行时间延长了1.86倍和1.82倍。

Conclusion: 该FPGA系统在保持高准确度的同时，实现了显著的能效改进和较低的运行时间开销。

Abstract: Local learning reduces cross-layer training dependencies, but an efficient accelerator must still retain operands, accumulate gradients, and select quantization scales. We present an FPGA system that trains a CNN and its regional auxiliary classifiers using a shared integer matrix engine. Compact errors are expanded on chip, gradients are folded tile by tile, and historical scales permit direct output conversion. At 200 MHz, the KV260 prototype achieves 76.57% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 91.85% on SVHN at approximately 4.20 W mean module power. Effective matrix throughput is 31.22 and 31.57 GMAC/s, respectively. Against the same integer method on Jetson Orin Nano, measured training energy is 40.4% and 42.1% lower, with $1.86\times$ and $1.82\times$ longer runtime; measurements use the respective platform power domains. Selected state checks and matching complete-run prediction counts support functional agreement with the software reference.

</details>


### [490] [When Is RTL Better? Auditing Evaluation Stability with Tool-Grounded Requirement Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17445)
*Bodong Hou,Zhixin Pan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该研究通过工具支持的需求配置文件来审计评估器稳定性，发现通用单元计数评估器在6/12对候选者中报告了不受支持的改进，并且只有一种评估器检测到所有注入的退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RTL生成研究更多关注功能正确性和后合成质量，而忽视了评估器本身作为实验变量的作用。

Method: 引入了工具支持的需求配置文件，并通过冻结候选者对并只改变其评估配置文件来进行审计。

Result: 结果显示，只有通用单元计数评估器在6/12对候选者中报道了50%的未受支持的改进，而匹配的评估器检测到了所有注入的退化。

Conclusion: 研究表明评估器配置是结论不稳定的一个可衡量和可审计的来源。

Abstract: RTL-generation studies increasingly report functional correctness and post-synthesis quality, yet the evaluator itself is rarely treated as an experimental variable. A candidate can appear better when a security rule, protocol obligation, target context, feasibility gate, uncertainty policy, or provenance constraint is omitted. We introduce tool-grounded requirement profiles: machine-readable contracts binding each requirement's meaning to its executable evidence and comparison rule, together with cross-requirement gates, uncertainty handling, and provenance. We audit evaluator stability by freezing candidate pairs and perturbing only their evaluation profile. In a preregistered controlled pilot with six designs, twelve pairs, three requirement families, six evaluator conditions, and 72 decisions, a generic cell-count evaluator reports unsupported improvement for 6/12 pairs (50%; Wilson 95% interval 25.4 to 74.6%; design-cluster bootstrap interval 25 to 75%). The matched evaluator detects all twelve injected regressions, whereas syntax, generic synthesis, context mismatch, and gate ablation each lose the required distinction for 12/12 pairs. In a separately frozen external validation of all 290 public RTLLM v1.1 text-only candidates, 81/215 evaluable comparisons (37.7%; task-cluster 95% interval 24.8 to 51.4%) yield unsupported scalar improvements, including 72 functional-gate reversals. Separately, 26 OpenROAD-flow-scripts runs show why timing context and activity qualification must be part of the contract. The study does not rank generators; it establishes evaluator configuration as a measurable, auditable source of conclusion instability.

</details>


### [491] [Formal-Verification-Guided Bayesian Optimization for Non-Intrusive Last-Mile Coverage Closure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17449)
*Chengjia Liu,Priyadarsi Mishra,David Kebo Houngninou,Michael Quinn,Aakash Tyagi,Jiang Hu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需修改原本功能覆盖率模型的非侵入式工作流，通过解析抽象语法树、追踪影响区域，结合贝叶斯优化和正式可达性分析，提高了功能覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代芯片设计中的末端功能覆盖率关闭过程成本高昂，原因是现有的UVM环境暴露了大量可控参数，而未命中剩余目标的情况较少。本文提出的方法旨在提高覆盖率，同时避免从设计规格中推导验证目标。

Method: 该方法首先通过抽象语法树解析和影响区域追踪来匹配各剩余目标与现有测试台控制项，然后使用贝叶斯优化（BO）与约束随机验证（CRV）或随机搜索结合，在相同空间内进行模拟预算测试。之后，正式可达性分析移除所有通过完全不可达证明支持的目标，剩余目标依据正式难度分类成组，再使用组内BO，再次进行模拟预算测试。

Result: 在OpenTitan AES实例上，该方法第一轮在减缩空间中达到了261/271覆盖率；在Entropy Source实例上，同样第一轮达到了2210/2277覆盖。通过正式分析清理后，整体有效覆盖分别提高到97.03% 和 97.49%。

Conclusion: 该研究合并了诊断与搜索的工作流程，通过难度分类、策略路由和特定组的BO进一步提高了覆盖率，但未单独评估这些改进因素的具体贡献。

Abstract: Last-mile functional coverage closure for modern chip designs remains costly because a mature UVM environment exposes many controls while direct hits on the remaining bins are sparse. We present a non-intrusive workflow that closes pre-defined bins in an existing, human-authored functional coverage model; it does not synthesize verification objectives from the design specification. The workflow first uses abstract-syntax-tree (AST) parsing and cone-of-influence (COI) tracing to map each residual target to existing testbench knobs. Under a matched 20-simulation budget, Bayesian optimization (BO) is compared with continued constrained-random verification (CRV) and random search over the same AST/COI-reduced space. Formal reachability then removes only targets supported by complete unreachability proofs, after which retained targets are grouped by formal difficulty and processed by group-specific BO under a second matched 20-simulation budget. Cleanup and grouping never add numerator bins; only simulator coverage artifacts do. On OpenTitan AES, first-pass reduced-space BO reaches 241/271 bins; formal cleanup removes two denominator bins; the integrated post-cleanup stage - difficulty grouping, policy routing, and group-specific BO - adds 20 simulator-confirmed hits, yielding 261/271 raw coverage (96.31%) and 261/269 effective coverage (97.03%). On Entropy Source, first-pass reduced-space BO reaches 2117/2277 bins; formal cleanup removes ten denominator bins; the integrated post-cleanup stage - difficulty grouping, policy routing, and group-specific BO - adds 93 simulator-confirmed hits, yielding 2210/2277 raw coverage (97.06%) and 2210/2267 effective coverage (97.49%). These results characterize the integrated diagnosis-and-search workflow; the present evaluation does not isolate the causal contributions of difficulty classification, policy routing, and post-cleanup BO.

</details>


### [492] [FPGA Based Design And Implementation of Neural Network Compensators for Nanocrystalline MEMS Pressure Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18136)
*Somsubhra Talapatra,Sudip Ghosh,C Roy Chaudhuri,Biplab K Sikdar,Hafizur Rahaman*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文利用神经网络算法补偿纳米晶体MEMS压力传感器的非线性和温度效应，通过背Propagation算法训练多层感知器前向网络，提高了温度下的误差处理能力，实现了一个智能传感器系统，可在FPGA上并行快速工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究纳米晶体MEMS压力传感器的温度和非线性误差补偿方法，以提高其在温度变化条件下的测量精度和响应速度。

Method: 使用神经网络算法对传感器的非线性和温度效应进行补偿，具体包括设计一个基于多层感知器前向网络的神经网络模型，并通过背Propagation算法进行训练。

Result: 通过神经网络补偿，温度引起的误差减少了98%，该系统实现了高速准确的压力测量。

Conclusion: 研究人员开发了一种基于FPGA的高性能智能传感器系统，适合生物医学等应用场景。

Abstract: In this paper the effects of nonlinearity and temperature of nanocrystalline MEMS pressure sensor have been compensated using neural network algorithm which has been implemented on a FPGA chip. The neural network employs back propagation algorithm to train the multilayer perceptron feed forward network that causes an error reduction due to temperature upto the level of 98%. It is realized on FPGA with pipelined architecture for parallel and fast sensing operation. The pressure sensor along with the FPGA based compensation results in an intelligent sensor system capable of high speed and accurate pressure measurement which has been tested for a typical biomedical application.

</details>


<div id='cs.PF'></div>

# cs.PF [[Back]](#toc)

### [493] [Simulate Before You Scale: High-Fidelity LLM Inference Planning Without GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14255)
*Dipanwita Guhathakurta,Mert Toslali,Srinivasan Parthasarathy,Jing Chen,Michael Kalantar,Nicholas A. Masluk,Vishakha Ramani,Asser Tantawi,Fabio Oliveira*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: BLIS 是一个确定性的、基于 CPU 的离散事件模拟器，能够全面模拟推理服务管道，包括准入、路由、调度、执行、KV 缓存管理和抢占。它通过使用分析基函数和从经验中学到的比例系数及开销项的一次性全局拟合，能够在不进行每模型或每 GPU 详细分析的情况下预测步骤延迟。实验结果显示BLIS在36次实验中保持了6.7%的中位端到端误差，运行速度比实际执行快约200倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型（LLM）推理部署需要联合选择硬件布局、并行策略、调度策略、准入控制和请求路由，以满足延迟和吞吐量目标。现有预测工具要么忽略批次和排队动态，要么仅模拟管道的一小部分，这限制了迭代探索的效率。

Method: BLIS 结合了分析函数和经验学习的缩放系数及开销项，实现了 CPU 上的离散事件模拟，能够预测推理服务管道的端到端延迟，且无需针对每个模型或每个 GPU 进行详细分析。

Result: 在36次实验中，BLIS针对六种模型和三种 GPU 类型，实现了6.7%的中位端到端误差，并且运行速度比实际执行快约200倍。在 Llama-2-70B 的420种服务配置下，找到4个 GPU 的部署方案满足300ms 的平均TTFT 服务水平目标，而竞争工具要么需要两倍的 GPU，要么推荐在高负荷下失败的配置。

Conclusion: BLIS 为大规模语言模型推理服务提供了一种高效且准确的方法，实验证明其能够在不进行详细分析的情况下提供可操作的服务策略。

Abstract: Deploying large language model (LLM) inference at scale requires jointly selecting hardware layout, parallelism strategy, scheduling policy, admission control, and request routing to meet latency and throughput targets. These choices interact: a routing decision that improves cache locality can concentrate load, and an admission threshold that triggers only at saturation allows queues to grow deep enough to degrade critical-tier traffic. Evaluating candidates on GPU clusters is too expensive for iterative exploration, yet existing predictive tools either ignore batching and queueing dynamics or model only fragments of the pipeline. In this paper, we present BLIS, a deterministic, CPU-only discrete-event simulator that models the full inference serving pipeline (admission, routing, scheduling, prefill/decode execution, KV-cache management, and preemption). BLIS pairs analytical basis functions with learned scaling coefficients and overhead terms, fit once globally, to predict step latency without per-model or per-GPU profiling. Across 36 experiments spanning six models and three GPU types, BLIS achieves 6.7% median end-to-end error while running around 200 times faster than real execution. In a configuration search over 420 serving configurations for Llama-2-70B, BLIS identifies a 4-GPU deployment that meets a 300ms mean TTFT service-level objective (SLO), whereas competing tools either require double the GPUs or recommend configurations that fail under load. Two policies evolved entirely in simulation were validated on real hardware and merged into llm-d, a widely adopted open-source platform for distributed LLM serving: an admission policy that reduces critical-tier TTFT P90 by up to 82%, and a flow-control policy that reduces E2E P50 latency by 32-48% on overloaded workloads.

</details>


### [494] [Compositional Performance Modeling of LLM Inference Clusters with Hierarchical KV Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15366)
*Ruiyang Ma,Sheng Qi,DaiKang Kuang,Teng Ma,Guojie Luo*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于分离本地服务成本和共享资源及KV可用性的组合离散事件模拟器，用于评估LLM推理集群的性能。通过验证，模拟误差在可接受范围内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在通过模拟来理解和优化大规模语言模型推理集群的性能，尤其是在考虑缓存层级结构和调度策略的影响时。

Method: 研究使用了一个组合离散事件模拟器，能够分离计算和传输模型，并在一致性的工作节点上复用这些模型进行策略和拓扑比较，从而无需为每个配置单独拟合延迟。

Result: 该模拟器在SGLang上的验证结果显示，对于问答任务的最大误差为1.34%，而对于编码会话任务的最大误差为6.36%。CPU模拟将重播的周转时间降低了15.33倍。实验表明，该模型有助于指导策略选择。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种有效的方法来预测和优化LLM推理集群的性能，为策略的选择提供了依据，同时能够显著减少重播的耗时。

Abstract: Design-space exploration of LLM inference clusters requires predicting how hardware and serving policies interact with hierarchical key-value (KV) caching. Isolated operation profiles alone do not determine cluster latency: reuse changes computational demand, while KV location, capacity, and contention govern execution order. We present a compositional discrete-event simulator based on separating local service costs from shared resource and KV availability. Compute and transfer models calibrated on one-prefill/one-decode (1P-1D) deployments are reused across compatible workers, enabling policy and topology comparisons without per-configuration latency fitting. Validation against SGLang covers Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on 1P-1D and 3P-1D clusters. Mean request end-to-end latency error is 1.34% for question answering and 6.36% for captured coding sessions, measured as mean absolute percentage error. CPU simulation reduces replay turnaround by 15.33 times on average; real replay includes prescribed arrival gaps. Measured session-affinity and simulated retention studies demonstrate how the framework guides policy selection by predicting the joint effects on computation, latency, and KV occupancy.

</details>


### [495] [DynaSPLIT: Strong tail-optimal scheduling for the M/G/n with heavy-tailed job sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17329)
*Zhouzi Li,Mor Harchol-Balter,Alan Scheller-Wolf*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 本文研究了具有重尾作业大小的M/G/n队列在高负载下的响应时间尾部性能，提出了首个在高负载下强尾部最优的调度策略DynaSPLIT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典M/G/n队列在高负载下尾部性能优化策略尚属空白，本文填补了这一研究空白，推动了强尾部最优策略在整条稳定区域内的应用。

Method: 通过分析和构建新的调度策略DynaSPLIT，证明了在高负载情况下，强尾部最优策略是可行的。

Result: 提出了DynaSPLIT调度策略，该策略在高负载下展示了强尾部最优性能。与以往研究结合，论文展示了重尾作业大小的M/G/n队列中强尾部最优策略的应用范围。

Conclusion: 研究结果证明，在具有重尾作业大小的M/G/n队列中，强尾部最优策略可以在整个稳定区域内实现，DynaSPLIT策略为此提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the asymptotic response time tail in the M/G/n queue with heavy-tailed (regularly varying) job sizes. For this setting, strongly tail optimal policies are known only at lower load, where n-1 servers suffice for stability. At higher load, the tail optimal scheduling has been open. This paper presents DynaSPLIT, the first strongly tail optimal policy at high load. Together with prior work, this result shows that strong tail optimality is achievable across the entire stability region of the M/G/n with heavy-tailed job sizes.

</details>


### [496] [AlignPred: Error-Controlled KV Cache Compression via Alignment and Predictive Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17970)
*Xu Yang,Jiapeng Zhang,Zhiwei Zuo,Yuxin Chen,Feiqiang Sun,Chengguang Xu,Feng Jin,Zhuo Tang*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: AlignPred通过结合局部对齐和预测编码，在保持较低重建误差的同时减小了持久缓存的存储需求，并且解码速度是CPU编解码器的1.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提高Long-running代理中关键值（KV）缓存的压缩效率，同时确保重建错误保持在一个可配置的预算内。

Method: AlignPred结合了局部对齐变换和预测编码。它通过将相关头或层对齐到公共坐标系来结合token级预测和相同token预测，并对残差进行误差限制编码。

Result: AlignPred在三个不同的注意力机制下，相对于评估的基线，在相似的重建误差下需要更少的存储空间。与评估的CPU编解码器实现相比，其解码速度至少快1.6倍，即使在编码时间上也有竞争力。在LongBench-Pro上的任务得分接近于原生操作点，上下文长度为128K。HiCache集成使持久目标-KV存储减少了42-72%，且延迟相似。

Conclusion: AlignPred为Long-running代理提供的KV缓存压缩技术，不仅降低了存储成本，还提高了解码效率，并且在压缩操作点上保持了接近原生的性能。

Abstract: Long-running agents retain KV caches across turns and sessions for hours or days. Compressing these persistent caches requires reducing storage while controlling reconstruction error. We present AlignPred, a codec that combines local alignment with predictive coding under a configurable KV reconstruction-error budget. Local orthogonal transforms align related heads or layers into a common coordinate frame, allowing AlignPred to combine token-wise prediction with same-token prediction across heads or layers. Residuals are quantized on an error-bounded lattice and entropy-coded, without learned predictors, encoder-side mode search, or large joint transforms. Across three attention mechanisms, AlignPred requires less storage than the evaluated baselines at comparable measured reconstruction error. Against the evaluated CPU codec implementations, it decodes at least 1.6 times faster while matching or improving encode time. AlignPred achieves near-native task scores at substantially compressed operating points on LongBench-Pro at 128K context. AlignPred's SGLang HiCache integration reduces persistent target-KV storage by 42-72% relative to native HiCache, with comparable latency.

</details>


### [497] [How Reliable Are Large Language Models for Soil Organic Carbon Assessment? An Australian Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18201)
*Yingxuan Cheng,Tong Li,Yayong Li,Yuchuan Fan,You-Gan Wang,Jinran Wu,Scott Chapman,Geoffrey J. McLachlan*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 该研究评估了七种通用语言模型配置在估算澳大利亚农田0-10厘米土层有机碳浓度和储量方面的准确性，发现虽然存在一些低估和场块特定的误差，但模型在特定条件下仍具有较好的准确性。研究强调需要针对任务的具体验证，并确保AI辅助的有机碳评估可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型广泛应用于预测土壤有机碳（SOC）含量，但其预测结果的准确性需经过验证，以确保在农业监测与管理中的应用效果。

Method: 研究设计了三个直接响应任务，通过与已知SOC测量值或确定性计算结果对比，评估了七种不同的大语言模型配置在SOC浓度、储量估计及田块对比较方面的表现。

Result: 研究发现，通过增加额外的土壤属性信息，可以显著降低SOC平均绝对误差（13-62%），但高SOC的低估问题和场块特定误差依旧存在。部分模型在计算SOC储量时表现出高准确性，尤其是在使用特定单位的情况下，但在使用物理等效替代单位时准确性下降。模型在田块配对比较中的准确性较高，但对展示顺序较为敏感。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了AI辅助SOC检测的三个不同要求：与测得的浓度值一致、单位一致的储量计算及可靠的场块间差异识别。研究结果强调，应进行任务特定验证，并确保使用语言模型输出的生态证据具有可审计性。

Abstract: Soil organic carbon (SOC) is an indicator of agricultural soil condition and carbon storage, but numerical outputs from large language models (LLMs) require validation before use in monitoring or management. We evaluated seven general-purpose LLM configurations on three direct-response tasks: estimating 0--10 cm SOC concentrations for 308 Australian paddocks under two information conditions, calculating SOC stock in 120 matched scenarios, and comparing 300 paddock pairs. References were measured SOC records or deterministic calculations; response validity, repeated-call dispersion and estimated API cost were assessed separately. Additional measured soil attributes reduced concentration mean absolute error by 13--62\% across configurations, although high-SOC underprediction and paddock-specific errors persisted. Six configurations were highly accurate in stock calculations using equation-native units without coarse fragments, but accuracy declined with physically equivalent alternative units. Pairwise accuracy was 90.5--94.6\% overall and 59.1--70.9\% for 52 closely separated pairs; some configurations were sensitive to presentation order. Nearly all outputs were parseable, without necessarily being correct. The benchmark identifies three distinct requirements for AI-mediated SOC assessment: agreement with measured concentrations, unit-consistent stock calculations and reliable discrimination between sites. These findings support task-specific validation and auditable calculations, rather than unverified use of LLM outputs as ecological evidence.

</details>


### [498] [Fast and Flexible Spiking Network Simulations on Massively Distributed On-Chip Memory Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18217)
*Catherine Mia Schöfmann,Jan Finkbeiner,Jan Vogelsang,Susanne Kunkel*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 该研究通过使用具有大量分布式片上内存的商业系统，实现了脑研究的加速，并引入了一种基于组的映射和通信策略来解决大规模分布式系统中的突触传递挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究目的是突破现有的模拟技术极限，以实现大规模实时大脑模型的仿真，特别是在可塑连接的情况下，需要比生物时间快得多的模拟速度，以便能够进行有效的迭代探索。

Method: 该方法采用了具有大量分布式片上内存的商业系统，特别是Graphcore的IPU，并引入了一种基于组的映射和通信策略来实时解决突发传递问题。

Result: 使用该策略，在Graphcore IPUs上，皮质微电路以22.7倍于生物实时的速度运行，并且具有可忽略的构建时间和可重用的编译图。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种通用策略，旨在推动神经模拟技术的发展，并展示了商业系统在加速脑研究方面的潜力。

Abstract: Studying brain function and dysfunction in spiking networks with realistic synaptic densities pushes simulation technology beyond its current limits. It requires simulations substantially faster than biological real-time to cover long model times and enable efficient iterative exploration, particularly when connectivity is plastic. The modelling community aspires to a $100\times$ speedup. Yet on conventional many-core systems this remains elusive, bounded by inter-node communication and memory access. So far, significant speedup has only been shown on a custom-built FPGA system. We demonstrate the potential of commercial systems with large distributed on-chip memory to accelerate brain research. To exploit the local SRAM, we introduce a group-based mapping and communication strategy tackling spike-routing challenges on massively distributed systems. On Graphcore IPUs, the cortical microcircuit runs at a record $22.7\times$ faster than biological real-time with negligible build times and a reusable compiled graph. By design, the algorithm makes no model- or hardware-specific assumptions, providing a general strategy for advancing neuronal simulation technology.

</details>


### [499] [PrismStencil: Transforming Stencil Computations into Matrix Multiplications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18382)
*Xianmeng Jiang,Yuan Liang,Zixuan Wang,Kun Li,Yunquan Zhang*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: PrismStencil通过引入新颖的矩阵与 stencil 栅格之间的映射方案，利用多维向量映射处理 stencil 计算的数据依赖，并采用统一的汇编-分散张量化方案来利用矩阵维度在 Tensor Core 操作中的相对大小，从而减少张量化引入的冗余计算。此外，它还引入了一种交叉积数据重用机制来进一步提高数据重用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的张量化方法在 stencil 计算中存在大量冗余计算和数据重用不足的问题，PrismStencil 的提出旨在解决这些问题。

Method: PrismStencil 采用了多维向量映射和统一的汇编-分散张量化方案，以及交叉积数据重用机制来优化 stencil 计算。

Result: 在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上，PrismStencil 在 FP64 和 TF32 精度下分别实现了 2.13x 和 2.17x 的速度提升。

Conclusion: PrismStencil 通过创新的算法设计，显著提高了 stencil 计算的效率，为高性能计算提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Stencil computations are a fundamental class of workloads in scientific and engineering applications. Although Tensor Cores offer new opportunities for stencil acceleration, existing tensorization methods suffer from substantial redundant computation and insufficient data reuse. We propose PrismStencil, a stencil tensorization algorithm that introduces a novel mapping scheme between matrices and stencil grid points. PrismStencil employs multidimensional vector mapping to accommodate the multidimensional data dependencies of stencil computations and a unified gather--scatter tensorization scheme to exploit the relative sizes of the matrix dimensions in Tensor Core operations, thereby reducing the redundant computation introduced by tensorization. Moreover, it introduces a cross-product data-reuse mechanism that exploits the overlap among neighboring stencil updates to further enhance data reuse. Across representative stencil kernels on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, PrismStencil achieves average speedups of 2.13x and 2.17x over state-of-the-art Tensor Core stencil methods with FP64 and TF32 precision, respectively.

</details>
